title: CRM Architect
description:
**About Avanade**
Avanade is the world’s leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7,000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft’s Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results.
  
  
Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60,000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165,000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to take overall architectural ownership of our CRM projects. This is a senior, functionally led role for someone whose career has been built on Dynamics 365 CRM — who understands how sales, service, marketing and field teams actually work, and can design a CRM solution that fits those processes rather than forcing them to fit the product.
  
  
You will lead solution design across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules and the Power Platform, run the functional conversation with business stakeholders, and give the technical team a design they can build.
  
  
The emphasis is on functional depth — process design, fit-gap, configuration-first solutions and adoption — backed by enough technical understanding to make sound decisions on integration, data, security and extension, and to hold the build team to a good standard. The role also carries a strong presales element: you will be the CRM solution lead on pursuits for Dynamics 365 and Power Apps opportunities — shaping the solution, demonstrating it, estimating it and helping us win it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Dynamics 365 CRM projects — from discovery and requirements through design, build, testing, go-live and hypercare.
* Lead business process workshops with client stakeholders, map current and future-state processes, and translate them into a Dynamics 365 solution design.
* Run fit-gap analysis against standard Dynamics 365 capability, favouring configuration over customisation, and make clear recommendations where gaps need Power Platform or custom extension.
* Design functional solutions across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules: Sales (lead-to-opportunity, forecasting, sales accelerator), Customer Service and Contact Center (case management, SLAs, entitlements, knowledge, omnichannel routing), Field Service (work orders, scheduling, resources, assets, inventory), Customer Insights – Journeys and Customer Insights – Data (marketing journeys, segmentation, unified customer profile), and Project Operations where project-based selling and delivery are in scope.
* Design the Dataverse data model and security model — tables, relationships, business units, security roles, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security — to match the client’s organisation.
* Design Power Platform extensions: model-driven apps for core CRM processes, canvas apps for task-focused and mobile scenarios, Power Pages portals for customers and partners, and Power Automate for workflow and automation.
* Bring Copilot and AI capabilities into the CRM solution where they add value — Copilot in Sales and Customer Service, Copilot Studio agents and AI-assisted productivity features.
* Define the integration approach with ERP, marketing, telephony, websites and third-party systems — at design level, with the technical team owning detailed build.
* Define data migration strategy from legacy CRM platforms (Salesforce, older Dynamics CRM versions or others) — mapping, cleansing, sequencing and reconciliation.
* Author and own solution design documents, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and architecture decisions, and walk client stakeholders through them.
* Guide functional consultants and developers during build, review configuration and design quality, and resolve functional and architectural escalations.
* Oversee testing strategy with QA and business teams — scenario coverage, UAT support and business sign-off — and support cutover and go-live readiness.
* Set ALM, environment and governance standards with the technical lead — solutions, environments, deployment approach and Power Platform governance.
* Lead presales solutioning for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps opportunities — understanding the client’s business problem, qualifying scope and shaping the right solution from the Dynamics 365 modules and Power Platform components.
* Run presales discovery workshops, business-process walkthroughs and high-level fit-gap to define the solution scope and approach.
* Build and deliver tailored solution demos and proofs of concept on Dynamics 365 and Power Apps, showing the client’s own scenarios rather than generic product tours.
* Prepare solution architecture, scope, assumptions, effort estimates, phasing and team structure for proposals, RFP/RFI responses and statements of work.
* Advise on Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing during presales and position the solution against competing platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow.
* Work with sales, bid management, delivery and Microsoft account and partner teams on pursuits, including Microsoft co-sell and funded programmes where applicable.
* Present the solution and delivery approach in client orals and executive presentations and support negotiation of scope through to contract and handover to delivery.
* Mentor CRM functional consultants and contribute reusable process models, demo assets and accelerators to the practice.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 11–15 years of overall experience, with the substantial majority focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement and its predecessor Dynamics CRM versions.
* Deep functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with strong working knowledge of at least one of Field Service, Customer Insights (Journeys / Data), Contact Center or Project Operations.
* Proven experience as solution or functional architect on multiple end-to-end Dynamics 365 CRM implementations, including at least two full lifecycle projects from design to go-live.
* Strong grounding in CRM business processes — lead and opportunity management, account and contact management, quote and order, case management, service scheduling and marketing journeys.
* Demonstrated ability to run discovery and process workshops, lead fit-gap analysis and produce clear solution designs and functional specifications.
* Strong command of the Power Platform: model-driven apps, canvas apps, Power Pages and Power Automate — knowing which to use for which scenario.
* Good understanding of Dataverse — data model, security model, business rules, business process flows and configuration capability.
* Technical implementation understanding sufficient to guide the build team: plug-ins and JavaScript extension points, integration patterns (APIs, connectors, Azure integration services), data migration tooling and ALM — hands-on development is not required.
* Experience designing data migration from legacy CRM platforms and managing data quality through cutover.
* Awareness of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing and how it shapes solution design.
* Strong client-facing skills — credible with sales, service and marketing leaders, and able to defend design decisions with business and IT stakeholders.
* Experience guiding and reviewing the work of functional consultants and developers on medium-to-large projects.
* Solid presales experience for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps based solutions — discovery, solution shaping, demos, estimation and proposal writing — with a track record of contributing to won deals.
* Understanding of the presales lifecycle from qualification through RFP response, orals and negotiation, and of how estimates and assumptions translate into commercial risk.
* Ability to build and deliver compelling Dynamics 365 and Power Platform demos tailored to the client’s industry and processes.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Microsoft certifications: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst (MB-280), Customer Service Functional Consultant (MB-230), Field Service Functional Consultant (MB-240), Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910).
* Hands-on experience with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and with Copilot Studio agents in a CRM context.
* Experience migrating clients from Salesforce or other CRM platforms to Dynamics 365.
* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central or SAP.
* Experience with Microsoft FastTrack or Success by Design reviews.
* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, professional services, healthcare or public sector.
* Exposure to Power BI reporting for CRM and to Customer Insights – Data for customer analytics.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment
* Experience with Microsoft partner motions — co-sell, Microsoft-funded engagements (e.g. Business Applications workshops and envisioning programmes) and joint pursuits with Microsoft account teams.
* Competitive knowledge of Salesforce, ServiceNow and other CRM platforms for positioning and migration pursuits.

title: Principal Software Architect - Next Gen Informatics
description:
**Job Requirements**
Job Description
  
  
Principal Software Architect is responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end architecture of high performant, scalable, resilient next-generation laboratory informatics software platform, including instrument connectivity, laboratory workflows, quality control (QC), result management, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong software engineering and architectural expertise with demonstrated experience in
**AI-native software development**
- requiring the ability to transform conventional engineering workflows into AI-enabled development practices using coding agents, automated code analysis, agentic workflows, AI-assisted testing, and continuous verification while maintaining architectural integrity, security, and product quality.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Enterprise and Solution Architecture**
Own the end-to-end software architecture, including system boundaries, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, deployment topology, and technology choices.
  
  
Define modular, extensible architectures supporting multiple instrument vendors, laboratory sites, product configurations, and deployment environments.
  
  
Establish architectural principles, design patterns, interface contracts, coding standards, and reference architectures.
  
  
Make informed build-versus-buy and architectural trade-off decisions considering reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and total cost of ownership.
  
  
Identify architectural risks, structural technical debt, scalability bottlenecks, and opportunities for platform simplification.
  
  
Guide architecture evolution and modernization of legacy systems without compromising existing customer workflows or data integrity.
  
  
**AI-Native Software Architecture and Engineering**
Define the technical strategy for integrating AI-native development practices across requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, and maintenance.
  
  
Design AI-enabled engineering workflows using coding agents, agentic development environments, codebase intelligence, and automated verification.
  
  
Establish architectural context, repository-level instructions, machine-readable specifications, and guardrails that enable AI agents to work safely within complex software systems.
  
  
Evaluate AI agent architectures, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and code graph technologies where appropriate.
  
  
Establish repeatable evaluations for AI-generated code, including correctness, architectural conformance, test effectiveness, security, maintainability, and regression risk.
  
  
Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity without compromising software quality or release integrity.
  
  
**Instrument Connectivity and Interoperability Architecture**
Define a reusable connectivity architecture for integrating diagnostic instruments from multiple vendors.
  
  
Establish abstractions for protocol adapters, device drivers, message parsing, normalization, acknowledgements, retry, buffering, and recovery.
  
  
Guide implementation of TCP/IP and serial communication, vendor-specific protocols, and relevant standards such as CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.
  
  
Defining canonical data models and interface contracts for instrument messages, results, QC data, device status, and configuration.
  
  
Design for intermittent connectivity, duplicate or malformed messages, out-of-order events, service restarts, and safe recovery.
  
  
Establish simulator-based testing and conformance strategies that reduce the cost and complexity of onboarding new instruments.
  
  
**Laboratory Domain and Data Architecture**
Translate laboratory workflows and domain requirements into explicit, testable architectural models.
  
  
Define architectures for QC management, Levey–Jennings charts, Westgard rules, result review, QC closeout, alerting, and audit trails.
  
  
Establish data models and persistence strategies for historical results, QC observations, configuration versions, rule changes, and operator actions.
  
  
Ensure deterministic processing, traceability, historical reproducibility, and appropriate handling of concurrent updates.
  
  
**Key Technical Skills And Experience**
**Software Engineering**
15+ years in software engineering, including significant experience in software architecture and technical leadership
  
  
Strong proficiency in C#, .NET / .NET Core, object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and software design patterns.
  
  
Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, SQL databases, and fault-tolerant high-performance scalable applications.
  
  
Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or comparable frontend frameworks.
  
  
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, automated testing, CI/CD, debugging, security, and production issue resolution.
  
  
**Domain Experience - Mandatory**
Deep expertise in laboratory middleware systems, instrument drivers, message translation.
  
  
Clinical laboratory workflows, QC processes, result review, and instrument integration.
  
  
Laboratory instrument communication standards, including ASTM, CLSI LIS01/LIS02 and HL7 v2.
  
  
Healthcare IT, LIS, laboratory middleware, diagnostic software, or IVD product development.
  
  
Applicable healthcare software lifecycle, quality-management, risk-management, and cybersecurity standards.
  
  
**AI-Native Development - Mandatory**
Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools in real software delivery projects.
  
  
Ability to design and implement AI-enabled engineering workflows spanning requirements analysis, codebase exploration, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and documentation.
  
  
Practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent agentic development environments.
  
  
Experience creating and maintaining repository-level AI instructions, reusable agent workflows, project context, and engineering guardrails.
  
  
Understanding of agent tool use, context windows, structured outputs, model limitations, and techniques for grounding AI-generated changes in actual code and specifications.
  
  
Experience integrating AI agents with source control, work items, build pipelines, test frameworks, and other engineering tools.
  
  
Ability to establish automated verification & human review mechanisms for AI-generated code.
  
  
Demonstrated understanding of AI failure modes, including hallucinated APIs, incorrect assumptions, insecure code, incomplete test coverage, and unintended architectural changes.
  
  
Practical knowledge of secure AI usage, confidential-data protection, access controls, auditability, and software licensing considerations.
  
  
Experience building custom coding agents, agentic workflows, or multi-agent engineering systems.
  
  
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and codebase indexing.
  
  
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, or equivalent mechanisms for exposing engineering systems to AI agents.
  
  
Experience with code graphs, dependency analysis, semantic code search, and repository-scale reasoning.
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**

15+ years of professional experience in SW product development
  
  
Sound knowledge of SDLC and agile practices.
  
  
Other Attributes
  
  
Excellent spoken & written communication skills

title: Principal Software Architect- High Performance Computing
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Our Team**
Our team is developing a high-performance computing solution for low-latency and high throughput image processing and deep-learning workload that enables our Chip Manufacturing process control equipment to offer differentiated value to our customers.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
As an architect, you will get the opportunity to grow in the field of high-performance computing, GPU compute infra, complex system design and low-level optimizations for better cost of ownership.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibility**

* As a Software Architect, you will be responsible for design and implementation of robust, scalable infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs).
* You will analyze and partition workloads to the most appropriate compute unit, ensuring tasks like AI inference and parallel processing runs on specialized accelerators, while serial tasks run on CPUs.
* You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Algo engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
* You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
* You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers in the HPC domain.
* You will be expected to profile entire cluster of nodes and each node with profilers to understand bottlenecks, optimize workflows and code and processes to improve cost of ownership.
* Conduct performance tuning and capacity planning, monitoring GPU metrics (e.g., using NVIDIA DCGM) for reliability
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
* Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
* Ensure that software systems are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.
* Your primary focus will be on ensuring that the software systems are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost effective.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
Someone who is passionate about and has deep understanding and experience in design and development of cutting edge HPC systems and heterogenous computing infrastructure. He should have very good hands-on experience in parallel programming (CUDA) and AI inference infrastructure. He should be able to multi-task and switch contexts based on business needs.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12 to 18 years of experience in implementing robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions combining diverse processors (CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs)
* Working experience of GPU inference server like Nvidia Triton.
* Very good knowledge C/C++, Data structure and Algorithms and complexity analysis.
* Experience in developing Distributed High Performance Computing software using Parallel programming frameworks like MPI, UCX etc.
* Experience in GPU programming using CUDA, OpenMP, OpenACC, OpenCL etc.
* In depth experience in Multi-threading, Thread Synchronization, Inter process communication, and distributed computing fundamentals.
* Experience in Inter Process communication using Shared memory and Pipes.
* Experience in performance profiling at application and system level (e.g. vtune, Oprofiler, perf, Nividia Nsight etc.)
* Experience in low level code optimization techniques using Vectorization and Intrinsics, cache-aware programming, lock free data structures etc.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization technologies (docker/singularity) and low latency Message queues.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to mentor and coach junior team members.
* Experience in Agile development methodologies.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Experience in HPC Job-Scheduling and Cluster Management Software (SLURM, Torque, LSF etc.)
* Good knowledge of Low-latency and high-throughput data transfer technologies (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand)
* Good Knowledge of Parallel processing and DAG execution Frameworks like Intel TBB flowgraph, OpenCL/SYCL etc.

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes
  
  
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Diverse Experiences

description:
**AI Tech Lead / AI Architect**

**Location - PAN India (Hybrid) | Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time | Hands-on GenAI Delivery Leadership**

**About Us**

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM's 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT—a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world's leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025—Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on
**AI Architect/Tech Lead**
to lead one or more Generative AI delivery pods for a financial-services client. The role sits between our Senior AI Engineers and the Engagement Manager.

You own the technical direction and day-to-day delivery of your pod: you design the architecture, review the work and unblock it, and you are the technical voice with client architects, platform and security teams. You turn business asks into designs, plans and estimates, and you are accountable for what goes to production.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

1. **Solution Architecture:**
   Own the architecture for GenAI applications (RAG, agentic workflows, document intelligence, evaluation and guardrails) on Azure: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, APIM or an AI gateway.
2. **Engineering Standards:**
   Set and enforce branching and PR reviews, testing, IaC (Terraform), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), observability, security and cost practices.
3. **Trade-off Decisions:**
   Make and document the calls on model choice and routing, retrieval design, latency and cost, and build versus buy, so the team and the client can follow them.
4. **Evaluation & Guardrails:**
   Build evaluation in from the start: golden datasets, regression gates on every prompt or code change, LLM-as-judge where it fits, content filters and human review for high-risk outputs.
5. **Production Readiness:**
   Run release readiness: UAT support, release notes, rollback plans and production hand-off.

**People, Delivery & Client Leadership**

* **Pod Leadership:**
  Lead a pod of 4-8 engineers (AI, backend, data, full-stack): plan sprints, allocate work, review code and designs, and grow each person. You are the first escalation point for your pod.
* **Delivery Ownership:**
  Estimate, plan and track delivery; surface risks and dependencies early (environments, access, client approvals) and drive them to closure.
* **Client Technical Lead:**
  Act as the senior technical point of contact with client architects, platform, security and governance teams; lead design walkthroughs, demos and technical decisions.
* **Scoping & Communication:**
  Translate vague business asks into scoped solutions and phased plans, push back with options when a request is not feasible, and work with the Engagement Manager on scope, staffing and status.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* **Overall Professional Experience:**
  8-12 years in software or data/ML engineering, with progressive technical leadership.
* **AI/ML & GenAI Experience:**
  3+ years building and shipping Generative AI applications to production.
* **Team Leadership:**
  At least 2 years leading engineers: allocation, reviews, mentoring and delivery accountability.

**Core Technical Competencies**

* **Generative AI & LLMs:**
  Hands-on depth in LLM application patterns (RAG, hybrid search and re-ranking, agents and tools/MCP, structured outputs) and evaluation/observability tooling (RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse or similar).
* **Azure AI Platform:**
  Production experience with Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, Functions / App Service, Key Vault, private networking and Entra ID / managed identity. AWS experience is acceptable with a clear path to Azure.
* **Responsible AI & Security:**
  Content filters and guardrails, prompt-injection and data-leakage risks, PII handling, access control and audit logging in a regulated (financial services) environment.
* **Backend & DevOps:**
  Strong Python (FastAPI, AsyncIO), Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and environment promotion (dev / UAT / prod) with rollback.
* **Communication:**
  Clear written and spoken communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience & Education**

* Financial services or asset-management domain experience.
* AI gateway / API management (APIM, Kong), model routing and cost control; document intelligence and OCR (Azure Document Intelligence / Content Understanding).
* Working knowledge of React for chat and operations UIs.

**Recognition & Achievements**

* We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest's North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM's PeMa Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025.
* In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services.

For more information, please visit our Website: https://www.straive.com/

title: Senior Staff Engineer — Intuit Agent Ready Platform, PDX
description:
**Overview**
ARP assesses if Intuit internal platforms are "agentic-ready" for end-to-end AI agent development. Its Eval engine normalizes top use cases, spawns agents in virtualized environments, executes plans, auto-files issue for friction (e.g., missing docs/APIs), and re-runs checks on CI/CD deploys to prevent regressions. This role belongs to the Core Platform Framework team, which builds the Eval platform and requires research-minded engineers focused on agent orchestration and LLM tooling, distinct from the Operations/Adoption team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The selected responsibilities for the Senior Staff Engineer role encompass leading and driving key architecture initiatives for the Eval platform:
  
  

* Core Platform Architecture: Owning and evolving the virtualization/harness layer, the agent plan-then-execute engine, and the friction detection and auto-ticketing pipeline.
* Model Orchestration & Cost Efficiency: Transitioning from single static models to dynamic, step-level orchestration that routes tasks to cost-effective models (including open-source options and Claude) while monitoring cost and performance per step.
* Telemetry & Auditability: Designing scalable logging, cost, and telemetry systems to ensure full auditability and cost accountability for agent runs.
* Use-Case Normalization: Setting technical standards to normalize agent-readable use cases across differently-documented capability platforms.
* Cross-Team & Strategic Collaboration: Partnering with capability, operations, and adjacent platform teams on friction reporting, PRD-to-action pipelines, RAG-backed architecture context, and OPA policy validation.
* Roadmap Leadership & Governance: Guiding the roadmap from foundational tooling (plugins, RBAC, alerting) to automation (auto-fix agents, continuous re-runs) and governance visibility.
* Mentorship & Technical Standards: Mentoring engineers and elevating engineering standards through design reviews, architecture documentation, and hands-on contributions.

**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, focused on large-scale distributed systems or developer platforms.
* Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent systems (orchestration loops, tool use, plan-and-execute patterns).
* Strong systems programming background (Python, Java) with virtualization, sandboxing, or IaC experience.
* Proficiency in Python, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, and React.
* Applied AI and prompt design skills for reliable, cost-aware LLM behavior.
* Proven Staff+ capability setting cross-team technical direction.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity in a research-driven, next-gen engineering environment.

**Preferred**

* Building or contributing to LLM or agent evaluation/benchmarking frameworks.
* Policy-as-code , RAG pipelines, or vector databases for enterprise agent grounding.
* Cost/token optimization and multi-model routing.
* Intuit experience or internal developer tools (CI/CD, Jira automation, developer portals).

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a Solution Architect to architect and solution large-scale digital solutions built on the DIGIT platform, with a primary focus on Public Finance Management (PFM).

The role sits at the intersection of product, technology and government—translating complex business and policy requirements into scalable, reusable and implementation-ready solutions. You will work with government stakeholders, development partners, product and engineering teams, and implementation partners across the lifecycle from discovery and solution design through development, UAT, go-live and stabilisation.

The role also provides technical advisory to governments and development partners and contributes to the architecture and evolution of DIGIT Studio and shared DIGIT platform capabilities.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. PFM Solution Architecture & Product Solutioning**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for PFM products and digital solutions on DIGIT.
* Work with government, development partners, product and programme teams to understand business processes, user needs, data requirements and operational constraints.
* Translate requirements into scalable solution designs covering services, APIs, data models, workflows, integrations, security and auditability.
* Determine whether requirements should be addressed through existing DIGIT capabilities, configuration, product extensions, reusable components or new services.
* Define HLDs, solution blueprints and, where required, LLDs for complex components and integrations.
* Ensure solutions are modular, API-driven, configurable, reusable and interoperable, with minimal implementation-specific customisation.
* Identify key architectural risks, dependencies and trade-offs and document significant decisions through Architecture Decision Records.

**2. DIGIT Platform & Studio Architecture**

* Drive reuse of DIGIT core services and shared platform capabilities across Products and other solutions.
* Define and review patterns for service boundaries, APIs, workflows, data exchange, identity and access management, notifications, audit, persistence, search and external integrations.
* Ensure implementation-specific requirements are addressed through configuration or reusable extensions wherever possible.
* Contribute to the evolution of DIGIT Studio as a platform for configuring, composing and extending DIGIT-based applications.
* Review Studio architecture for extensibility, configurability, multi-tenancy, performance, accessibility, security and integration.
* Define how Studio-configured solutions interact with DIGIT core services and shared platform capabilities.
* Identify common capabilities that can become reusable platform components.
* Ensure architecture supports sustainable evolution, versioning and upgrades without platform fragmentation or tight coupling.

**3. Technical Advisory & Partner Governance**

* Act as a technical advisor to government departments, development partners and programme leadership during discovery, solution definition and implementation planning.
* Explain solution options, technical trade-offs, dependencies, integration requirements, security considerations and operational implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, architecture reviews and technical discussions.
* Provide technical direction to internal engineering teams and implementation partners.
* Review partner architecture, solution designs, API contracts and key technical decisions, and provide architecture sign-off where required.
* Establish architecture checkpoints across design, development, UAT and production readiness.
* Ensure implementation partners adhere to agreed architecture, engineering, quality and production-readiness standards.
* Work with product and programme teams to identify technical dependencies, sequence delivery and define critical paths.

**4. Non-Functional Architecture, Security & Operations**

* Define and validate requirements for scalability, availability, performance, resilience, disaster recovery, observability, backup/restore and capacity planning.
* Define integration patterns covering retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, asynchronous processing, reconciliation and schema/version management.
* Ensure solutions incorporate appropriate security, privacy, access control and auditability requirements.
* Work with InfoSec, DevOps and engineering teams to identify and address architecture-level security and operational risks.
* Ensure solutions are designed for reliable operation in large-scale, multi-tenant and multi-instance production environments.

**5. Architecture Standards & Engineering Enablement**

* Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable patterns, solution templates, design guidelines and architecture checklists.

* Conduct architecture and engineering enablement sessions for internal teams and implementation partners.

title: Software Architect OT (f/m/d)
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
The Software Architect OT shapes the Industrial Digital Foundation and Software-Defined Automation architecture across Digital Products and Solutions (DPS). The role defines how industrial assets, control systems, edge platforms, operational data and knowledge, enterprise services, and AI capabilities work together in a secure, governed, and reusable architecture. Combining deep OT expertise with cross-portfolio architecture leadership, the role guides technology convergence and turns strategic direction into practical standards, roadmaps, and scalable solutions.
  
  
Create and scale an Industrial Digital Foundation that reduces product-specific engineering, enables reusable software-defined automation and edge capabilities, and provides trusted operational context for digital services and AI-enabled energy systems across components, assets, plants, fleets, and enterprise platforms.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Architecture leadership: Define, maintain, and govern target and reference architectures, principles, reusable patterns, technical standards, and guardrails for OT, edge, industrial data, and automation across DPS.
* Industrial Digital Foundation: Establish shared asset, system, equipment, semantic, and state models that can be governed once and reused across engineering, operations, digital services, analytics, and AI.
* Software-defined automation: Decouple control applications and engineering artifacts from specific hardware while preserving deterministic behavior, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, availability, and lifecycle support.
* Edge and distributed runtime: Define resilient architectures connecting industrial assets, control workloads, edge services, enterprise platforms, cloud services, and AI. Address local processing, offline operation, store-and-forward, remote lifecycle management, observability, and graceful degradation.
* OT/IT integration and interoperability: Drive secure, open, multi-vendor integration across plant networks, industrial DMZs, edge, cloud, and enterprise environments using appropriate protocols, APIs, brokers, gateways, and information models.
* Trusted industrial data: Define consistent approaches for acquiring, timestamping, validating, buffering, normalizing, contextualizing, and securely transporting industrial data, including metadata, lineage, data quality, and time synchronization.
* Cybersecurity and compliance: Embed defense in depth, segmentation, secure remote access, identity, certificate and secrets management, hardening, vulnerability management, auditability, and applicable industrial cybersecurity requirements into architecture decisions.
* Architecture governance: Lead architecture reviews, document significant decisions and trade-offs, resolve cross-domain conflicts, and ensure agreed guardrails are reflected in product and platform roadmaps.

**Technology & Business Leadership**

* Translate the Industrial Digital Foundation into prioritized technology roadmaps and cross-product adoption plans.
* Identify high-value opportunities, validate them through prototypes, site evidence, and customer feedback, and move successful concepts into scalable portfolio and platform initiatives.
* Guide technology selection and integration based on interoperability, security, scalability, operational resilience, lifecycle sustainability, cost, and business value.
* Build strategic partnerships and ecosystems that close capability gaps, accelerate adoption, and create reusable technology and business opportunities.
* Increase engineering productivity through reusable components, shared patterns, reference implementations, and systematic reduction of product-specific solutions.
* Mentor engineers and architects, build critical competencies, and align product, platform, controls, cybersecurity, data, and AI teams.
* Communicate complex architecture choices clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and represent DPS Technology & Innovation with customers, suppliers, partners, standards bodies, and industry communities.
* Define governance and assurance principles for AI agents and agent-based architectures, including safe tool access, human oversight, operational boundaries, and integration with trusted industrial context.

**What You Bring**

* Education and experience: Master’s degree in automation, electrical or control engineering, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Extensive experience in industrial automation, industrial software, digital platforms, or critical infrastructure is expected.
* OT and control systems: Deep knowledge of PLC, DCS, SCADA, historian, protection, and condition-monitoring environments, including plant operations, high-availability and safety constraints, long asset lifecycles, brownfield integration, and controlled change.
* Industrial connectivity: Practical experience with relevant protocols, standards, and integration patterns such as OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP, PROFINET, IEC 61850, Asset Administration Shell, ISA-95, and comparable vendor interfaces.
* Edge and platform engineering: Strong working knowledge of Linux, containers, Kubernetes, edge gateways, distributed runtimes, fleet anagement, remote updates, observability, resilient systems, and hybrid on-premises/edge/cloud architectures.
* Industrial data, semantics, and digital twins: Experience with time-series data, asset hierarchies, metadata, semantic models, contextualization, data lineage, digital twins, and the creation of governed, discoverable, reusable data products.
* Cybersecurity, safety, and reliability: Strong working knowledge of industrial network architecture, defense in depth, functional safety and reliability, secure communications, and relevant requirements such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, and the Cyber Resilience Act where applicable.
* Software and delivery: Experience with modern software engineering, APIs, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, versioning, and secure software lifecycle practices. Ability to move solutions from discovery and proof of concept through validation, rollout, and lifecycle support.
* Architecture methods and leadership: Demonstrated success defining reference architectures, documenting decisions, resolving cross-domain trade-offs, and driving adoption across products and teams without direct authority.
* Industry and communication: Ability to express technical choices in business and engineering terms and align global multidisciplinary teams. Fluency in English is required; experience in power generation, grids, energy management, or adjacent critical infrastructure is strongly preferred.

In DPS, our software products already cover a wide range of categories, and we see many opportunities for growth: Asset Performance Management, Energy Management, Asset Monitoring, Asset Health Prediction, Customer Portal & AI-assisted Applications, Connectivity & Edge, Backend Core / Domain / Platform Services, and Professional Services.

title: C++ Architect / Adaptive autosar
description:
* Job Description

**Company Description**
We are a consulting company with a bunch of technology-interested and happy people!
  
  
We love technology, we love design and we love quality. Our diversity makes us unique and creates an inclusive and welcoming workplace where each individual is highly valued.
  
  
With us, each individual is her/himself and respects others for who they are and we believe that when a fantastic mix of people gather and share their knowledge, experiences and ideas, we can help our customers on a completely different level.
  
  
We are looking for you who want to grow with us!
  
  
With us, you have great opportunities to take real steps in your career and the opportunity to take great responsibility.
  
  

* JOB DESCRIPTION:
* Note: Exp - 10 + Years

Seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer specialising in C++ and Adaptive
  
  
AUTOSAR to join their ADAS development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL). Your primary goal will be to decouple high-level ADAS perception and planning algorithms from the underlying vehicle hardware and communication protocols, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and safety-critical performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect & Develop VAL: Design and develop robust Vehicle Abstraction Layers that provide a standardised interface for ADAS applications to interact with vehicle actuators (steering, braking, acceleration) and sensors.
* Adaptive AUTOSAR Implementation: Develop and integrate software components within an Adaptive AUTOSAR framework, focusing on Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and SOME/IP communication.
* C++ Software Engineering: Write high-performance, memory-efficient, and MISRA-compliant C++ code (C++14/17/20) optimised for embedded automotive platforms.
* Communication Protocols: Implement and manage data exchange between high-level ADAS controllers and low-level ECUs using protocols such as SOME/IP, DoIP, CAN/CAN-FD, and Ethernet.
* Hardware Abstraction: Develop drivers and abstraction logic to hide hardware complexity, enabling easier porting of ADAS software across different vehicle platforms.
* Safety & Standards: Ensure all software development adheres to functional safety standards (ISO 26262) and automotive coding guidelines (MISRA C++, AUTOSAR).
* Testing & Validation: Perform unit testing, integration testing, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) testing to validate the VAL's reliability and timing constraints.

**Required Technical Skills**
Programming: Advanced proficiency in C++ (C++ 11/C++14/C++17 preferred) and understanding of low-level memory management and concurrency. Strong understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns.
  
  
Middleware: Hands-on experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR stack (e.g., Vector MICROSAR Adaptive, EB Tresos, or similar).
  
  
Architecture: Strong understanding of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and the concept of Vehicle Abstraction Layers.
  
  
Automotive Networking: Deep knowledge of SOME/IP, Ethernet communication, and traditional CAN/CAN-FD protocols.
  
  
OS Knowledge: Experience working with POSIX-based operating systems (e.g., QNX, Linux/RTOS).
  
  
Tools: Proficiency with Git, CMake, GDB, and debugging tools (Lauterbach, CANalyzer, or CANoe), and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in ADAS/AD functionalities (e.g., ACC, LKA, AEB, or Automated Parking).
  
  
Knowledge of ISO 26262 (ASIL D) functional safety processes and documentation.
  
  
Experience with hypervisors or virtualisation in automotive computing platforms.
  
  
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for embedded software development.
  
  
**Soft Skills**
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
Excellent communication skills to collaborate in a cross-functional, global environment.
  
  
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, agile development setup.

****AI-native semiconductor company****
. You will define not just tools, but
****how engineering itself is done****
, and directly impact the speed, quality, and innovation of our products.
  
  
****Location****
Hybrid / On-site – Bengaluru
  
  
**About TYLsemi, Inc.**
The Opportunity
  
  
The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem:
****how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?****
That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the
****chiplet infrastructure IP****
— the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks — that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.
  
  
****This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.****
Why Now
  
  
The Market Window
  
  
The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:
  
  

* Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
* Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI — they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
* IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.
* Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.

Culture & Team: How We Work
  
  
No Politics, No Bureaucracy
  
  
There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.
  
  

* If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
* No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  
  

* US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
* India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products
  
  
We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
  
  
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.
  
  
What We Value
  
  

* Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.
* Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.
* Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
* Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask
  
  
If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.
  
  
We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.
  
  
**Here's Why You Should**

* The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.
* The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.
* The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
* The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

****This is the bet.****
Join us and build something that matters.
  
  
Or stay comfortable. No judgment.
  
  
But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.
  
  
****READY TO JOIN?****

title: Storage Systems Architect
description:
Location – Bangalore / Pune / Kolkata / Indore

Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Storage Systems Architect to design and build storage software for AI workloads: NVMe and NVMe-oF data paths, flash tiering for KV cache and vector data, and GPU-to-storage paths. You will work with SSD vendors, AI platform companies and customer engineering teams, lead development, and contribute to presales.

Key Responsibilities

* Architect storage data paths for AI training and inference: NVMe, NVMe-oF (RDMA/TCP) and GPUDirect Storage.
* Design and build flash tiering for inference: KV cache offload and vector indexes (DiskANN-class) on SSD.
* Benchmark and characterize storage: latency, tail latency, IOPS and bandwidth using fio, SPDK perf and AI storage workloads.
* Lead C/C++ development in the Linux storage stack or in user space (SPDK).
* Evaluate new storage technology (Gen5/Gen6 SSDs, FDP/ZNS, CXL memory) and turn it into PoCs and customer offerings.
* Contribute to presales: solution design, technical proposals and customer architecture discussions.
* Mentor engineers and lead design reviews.

Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering or computer science, Electronics, Electrical, (or equivalent experience).

Experience

* 10 to 16 years in storage product engineering.
* Hands-on design or coding.

Must-Have Technical Skills

* Storage product development (block, file or object), not only storage administration.
* Linux I/O stack (blk-mq, NVMe driver, io\_uring) or SPDK.
* NVMe and NVMe-oF.
* C/C++ systems programming and performance analysis (perf, eBPF).
* Data protection fundamentals: replication, snapshots, RAID/erasure coding.

Good-to-Have Technical Skills

* GPUDirect Storage, RDMA (RoCE/InfiniBand).
* KV cache offload frameworks (LMCache, NVIDIA Dynamo KVBM) and vLLM.
* Vector databases and ANN indexes (Milvus, DiskANN).
* Parallel or distributed file systems (Lustre, WEKA, DAOS, Ceph).
* SSD internals: FTL, FDP, ZNS.
* CXL memory tiering; Python.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
description:
**Req ID:**
395525
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
  
  
Senior Solution Architecture Role | Primary Skill: Finance | Secondary Skill: Controlling
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to serve as the senior subject matter expert and central solution authority for SAP Finance within NTT DATA. This role requires deep expertise in Financial Accounting, supported by strong working knowledge of Controlling, and will provide leadership across assessments, advisory engagements, implementations, conversions, and optimization programs.
  
  
The architect will work directly with CFOs, controllers, finance leaders, business process owners, enterprise architects, and SAP delivery teams. The individual will help clients understand finance processes and SAP capabilities, analyze complex requirements and pain points, answer solution questions, evaluate options, and define scalable SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions aligned with standard functionality and clean-core principles.
  
  
This is a client-facing and practice leadership role for a hands-on architect who can operate across business process advisory, solution design, delivery governance, presales support, and issue resolution. Manufacturing industry experience is required, together with experience in one or more additional industries.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SAP Finance Solution Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the senior SAP Finance SME across SAP S/4HANA transformation, assessment, implementation, and advisory engagements.
* Own the Finance solution strategy and architecture across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Selective Data Transition programs.
* Lead end-to-end solution design for Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
* Provide architecture-level oversight for Controlling and management accounting, ensuring full integration with the Finance solution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex Finance design, integration, data, reporting, and delivery issues.
* Establish reusable Finance architecture principles, design standards, and leading practices across client engagements.

Finance Solution Design and Architecture
  
  

* Lead solution architecture and detailed design for core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities, including:
* General Ledger, Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, currencies, and document splitting
* Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner, and payment processing
* Asset Accounting, bank accounting, tax, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany accounting
* Financial close, statutory and management reporting, embedded analytics, and SAP Fiori for Finance
* Credit, collections, dispute management, cash management, and Treasury integration
* Translate business, accounting, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Evaluate solution alternatives, articulate trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to business and project leadership.
* Ensure alignment with SAP standard capabilities, S/4HANA simplifications, clean-core principles, and future-state enterprise architecture.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversion designs, and integration specifications.

Client Advisory and Finance Transformation
  
  

* Engage with CFOs, controllers, finance directors, process owners, and business users to understand current processes, business challenges, controls, and strategic priorities.
* Lead finance assessments, discovery sessions, Fit-to-Standard workshops, and future-state process design sessions.
* Help clients understand SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and explain complex solution concepts in clear business language.
* Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved reporting.
* Develop finance transformation roadmaps, solution options, implementation strategies, business cases, and executive recommendations.
* Advise on finance operating models, shared services, close optimization, governance, chart of accounts harmonization, and organizational design.

S/4HANA Transformation and Delivery
  
  

* Assess the impact of S/4HANA simplifications on finance processes, configuration, reports, interfaces, controls, and custom developments.
* Guide decisions related to ledger and currency strategy, parallel accounting, document splitting, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, and financial reporting.
* Lead or advise on Finance data migration for balances, open items, assets, bank and tax data, cost objects, and historical data.
* Assess RICEFW requirements and challenge unnecessary customization to support a clean-core solution.
* Provide solution oversight through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Support test strategy, defect resolution, mock conversions, financial reconciliation, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

Integration and Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate closely with MM, SD, PP, QM, EWM, PM, PS, HCM, Treasury, Group Reporting, planning, data, security, and technical teams.
* Ensure accurate and complete financial integration across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Project-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, and Record-to-Report.
* Provide Finance leadership for account determination, valuation, settlement, allocations, intercompany processing, and reporting across integrated business processes.
* Collaborate with ABAP, integration, data, analytics, workflow, and Fiori teams on enhancements and interfaces.
* Ensure the Finance solution aligns with the broader SAP and non-SAP landscape and enterprise architecture.

Controlling and Manufacturing Finance Support
  
  

* Provide architecture-level guidance for Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ensure Controlling design is integrated with Financial Accounting and aligned with business reporting and performance management needs.
* Support manufacturing finance requirements such as inventory valuation, standard and actual costing, production variances, production order settlement, and profitability reporting.
* Partner with specialized Controlling consultants for detailed configuration or complex industry-specific scenarios.

Practice and Team Leadership
  
  

* Act as the central SAP Finance solution authority and trusted advisor within NTT DATA.
* Support client assessments, pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
* Mentor Finance consultants, workstream leads, and architects and provide guidance on complex design and integration topics.
* Develop reusable assessment frameworks, solution standards, design principles, and leading-practice content.
* Work effectively within global onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models and manage multiple priorities across concurrent engagements.

**Required Skills And Experience**
Primary Skill: SAP Financial Accounting
  
  

* 20+ years of SAP experience with deep functional, advisory, and solution architecture expertise in SAP Finance.
* Strong hands-on and architecture experience in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, parallel ledgers and currencies, document splitting, tax, statutory reporting, and financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Finance architecture, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, financial close, and SAP Fiori.
* At least 3-5 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA transformation or implementation programs in a Finance Solution Architect, Finance Lead, or equivalent senior role.
* Experience designing Finance solutions across multiple legal entities, currencies, countries, and accounting standards.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, compliance, statutory requirements, and management reporting.

Secondary Skill: SAP Controlling
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of SAP Controlling and its integration with Financial Accounting.
* Experience with Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ability to provide architecture-level guidance for Controlling while partnering with specialized CO consultants for detailed design and configuration.
* Understanding of manufacturing cost flows, inventory valuation, production variances, actual costing, settlement, and profitability reporting.

Finance Transformation and Industry Knowledge
  
  

* Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, financial close, reporting, compliance, internal controls, and process governance.
* Significant industry experience in manufacturing, including discrete and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Experience in one or more industries such as Life Sciences, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Products, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, or High Technology.
* Experience supporting global organizations with multiple legal entities, currencies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
* Ability to understand industry-specific finance requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.

Architecture, Advisory, and Leadership Skills
  
  

* Proven ability to assess complex finance requirements and develop practical, scalable solution recommendations.
* Experience leading assessments, Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization, and future-state solution design.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences.
* Strong understanding of Finance integration, data migration, reporting, security, controls, and custom development considerations.
* Proven experience leading SAP Finance teams in large, complex transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive presence, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification and experience with SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience with SAP Central Finance is highly desirable.
* Experience to Group Reporting, Advanced Financial Closing, SAP Analytics Cloud, Treasury, FSCM, or Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Experience with RISE with SAP, SAP Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM, and clean-core governance.
* Experience supporting presales, solution architecture reviews, assessments, proposals, and estimates.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent is an advantage.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, advisory, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to effectively engage with CxOs
* Ability to translate complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Confidence working with senior finance leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic architect and a hands-on solution advisor.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and client-service mindset.

Location and Work Model
  
  

* Location:
* Work model: Hybrid, onsite
* Travel may be required based on client and delivery needs.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. CareerArc Code
  
  
CA-JY

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer to design the architecture that delivers trusted data at scale — and to build the AI products that put it directly in the hands of the business. This is a hands-on, senior role for someone who can set the technical blueprint, build the agents on top of it, and act as the bridge between business needs and technical reality.
  
  
You will work closely with the Director and Enterprise Architect, serve as technical lead and advisor to the team, and partner with the Senior AI Data Engineer to take designs from blueprint to production. Success is measured by the trust, scale, and adoption of the data and AI products that ship — and by the business outcomes they unlock.

* Architecture for Scale (Primary Focus) — Design the reference architecture and delivery patterns that take governed data from the semantic layer to every downstream consumer — dashboards, applications, and AI agents — reliably and at scale, with the build-vs-buy calls and standards that let the platform grow without painful rework.
* AI Data Products & Agents — Architect and build the Data Agent, the natural-language interface that lets business users query governed data without writing SQL; design agentic workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.

* Strong communication and the ability to lead through execution in a fast-moving environment.

* Cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* CI/CD and modern engineering practices for data and AI systems.

* Snowflake Cortex / Snowflake Intelligence, or production text-to-SQL systems.
* Prior technical-lead or principal-engineer role with mentorship responsibility.
* Background bridging pre-sales / solution engineering and hands-on delivery.

title: Technical Director
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
  
  
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
  
  
**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**
We are seeking a highly accomplished Technical Leader to define and drive the architectural vision for Cohesity's next-generation distributed storage platform, filesystem architecture, data access layer, and high-performance datapath services.
  
  
This is one of the most senior individual contributor roles at Cohesity. You will shape the long-term technical strategy for how data is stored, protected, accessed, moved, and analyzed across on-premises, cloud, and AI-native environments. As a recognized expert in large-scale storage systems, you will influence product direction, guide critical architectural decisions, and mentor engineering teams across the organization.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, filesystems, performance engineering, data services, cloud-scale storage, and AI-enabled data management, helping build the foundation powering Cohesity's growth for years to come.
  
  
**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Define and own the multi-year architecture roadmap for Cohesity's distributed storage platform, filesystem technologies, and datapath services.
* Drive the evolution of core storage subsystems including metadata management, caching, indexing, replication, deduplication, compression, snapshots, and recovery workflows.
* Author foundational architecture documents and technical strategies that influence multiple engineering organizations.
* Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving platform, cloud, security, AI, product, and customer-facing teams.
* Serve as a technical authority and represent Cohesity's storage architecture vision with customers, partners, and industry leaders.
* Drive architectural decisions that improve scalability, resiliency, performance, operational simplicity, and cost efficiency.

**Filesystem & Storage Platform Innovation**

* Design and evolve highly scalable distributed filesystem architectures capable of handling exabyte-scale workloads.
* Lead development of next-generation metadata services, namespace management, storage virtualization, and data placement algorithms.
* Drive innovations in SmartFiles, Data Access Layer, data indexing, and advanced file services across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Architect storage solutions optimized for structured, unstructured, backup, archive, and AI training workloads.
* Improve storage efficiency through advanced data reduction techniques including deduplication, compression, erasure coding, and intelligent tiering.
* Establish best practices for filesystem consistency, fault tolerance, recovery, and self-healing capabilities.
* Drive adoption of modern storage technologies including NVMe, object storage, cloud-native storage services, and software-defined storage architectures.

**Datapath & Performance Engineering**

* Own the technical vision for Cohesity's end-to-end datapath, including ingestion, storage, retrieval, replication, recovery, and analytics workflows.
* Design high-throughput, low-latency data movement frameworks capable of supporting petabyte-scale deployments.
* Optimize CPU, memory, networking, and storage subsystems to maximize platform performance and efficiency.
* Lead architecture initiatives for workload balancing, caching strategies, intelligent prefetching, and IO scheduling.
* Drive performance benchmarking and capacity planning across large-scale customer environments.
* Develop strategies to improve system observability, telemetry, diagnostics, and operational excellence across the datapath stack.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex scalability and performance bottlenecks.

**AI-Driven Data Platform Innovation**

* Drive the storage architecture required to support emerging AI and GenAI workloads.
* Design data access patterns and retrieval architectures optimized for AI applications, vector workloads, and large-scale analytics.
* Collaborate with AI platform teams to enable efficient data pipelines, feature stores, vector indexing, and retrieval systems.
* Define strategies for AI-assisted storage optimization, workload prediction, anomaly detection, and automated performance tuning.
* Influence the architecture of data services that support RAG, intelligent search, and AI-powered data discovery.

**Engineering Excellence & Mentorship**

* Raise the technical bar through deep design reviews, architecture evaluations, code reviews, and hands-on technical leadership.
* Mentor senior and principal engineers across storage, platform, and cloud infrastructure organizations.
* Establish engineering standards for performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Lead technical investigations, proof-of-concepts, and adoption of emerging storage technologies.
* Partner with engineering leadership on roadmap planning, talent strategy, and technical succession planning.

**WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
**Required**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in storage systems, distributed systems, filesystems, or cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Proven Principal, Distinguished, or Staff+ level impact delivering large-scale storage or distributed systems that operate in production at significant scale.
* Deep expertise in distributed filesystem architecture, metadata management, storage services, and large-scale data platforms.
* Extensive experience building highly available, fault-tolerant, and horizontally scalable systems.
* Strong understanding of storage fundamentals including filesystems, object storage, block storage, distributed storage architectures, data protection technologies, and replication and recovery systems.
* Hands-on experience with datapath optimization, performance engineering, profiling, and scalability analysis.
* Strong systems programming expertise in one or more of: C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Deep understanding of operating system internals, concurrency, memory management, networking, and performance tuning.
* Experience designing and operating cloud-scale distributed services.
* Demonstrated ability to drive technical alignment and influence across multiple organizations without direct authority.

**Preferred**

* Experience with data protection, backup and recovery platforms.
* Strong background in SmartFiles, Data Access Layer architecture, storage virtualization, or global namespace technologies.
* Experience building storage solutions for AI, machine learning, analytics, or high-performance computing workloads.
* Expertise with NVMe, RDMA, high-speed networking, Kubernetes storage, or software-defined storage platforms.
* Familiarity with modern cloud storage ecosystems including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Contributions to storage-related open-source projects, standards bodies, or industry publications.
* Patents, technical papers, or recognized industry contributions in distributed systems or storage technologies.
* Experience driving architecture for multi-tenant SaaS data platforms.
