title: Senior Director
description:
**Sr. Director – AI & Software Engineering**

**India |Data, Analytics & AI | Full-time| Hands-on technical leadership**

**Location - Bengaluru/Gurgaon/Noida/Pune/Mumbai/Chennai/Hyderabad**

**Straive is seeking a hands-on technology leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our AI, analytics, and software engineering solutions.**

About the Role:

You will set technical direction, resolve complex engineering challenges, and move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. The role combines architecture and execution leadership including a mandate to improve enterprise AI economics through fit-for-purpose frontier, open-source, and smaller models.

This is not a conventional delivery-governance role. You will remain close to the technology, lead critical design and code reviews, mentor teams, and take accountability for high-stakes technical outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production-Grade Engineering

* Own engineering standards across architecture, development, testing, deployment, security, observability, and documentation.
* Ensure prototypes have a credible production path; introduce architecture and code reviews, automated testing, quality gates, and release-readiness checks.
* Close gaps in scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, and security from design through deployment.

2. AI Architecture and Economics

* Define scalable, reliable, and cost-effective AI/GenAI architectures based on accuracy, cost, latency, privacy, and deployment needs.
* Lead selection, evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment of frontier, open-source, small, and domain-specific models.
* Reduce operating cost through model routing, caching, quantization, batching, retrieval and prompt optimization; design robust RAG and agentic systems with evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and human oversight.

3. Technical Architecture and Platforms

* Serve as the final escalation point for complex architecture, performance, security, and deployment issues.
* Guide modular applications, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, AI services, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.
* Promote reusable components and strong cloud-native, CI/CD, observability, data governance, and secure-development practices.

4. Team Capability

* Mentor architects, engineering leads, data scientists, and developers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical workshops.
* Build independent problem-solving capability, identify skill gaps, and support targeted hiring and development.
* Create a culture of engineering ownership, technical rigor, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

5. Client Solutioning and Innovation

* Partner with commercial, consulting, and delivery teams on client workshops, proposals, due diligence, and solution design.
* Assess feasibility, architecture, effort, risk, and operating cost; translate business problems into pragmatic technical roadmaps.
* Develop reference architectures and accelerators that strengthen Straive's differentiation and delivery speed.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* 12–18 years across software engineering, architecture, data platforms, AI/ML, or related roles, including experience in a startup, product company, or similarly fast-moving environment.
* Proven ownership of enterprise-grade software, data, or AI products from architecture through production adoption.
* Strong hands-on engineering background, preferably in Python and modern backend/frontend technologies.
* Practical GenAI experience spanning RAG, vector search, agentic workflows, model evaluation, safety controls, and production monitoring.
* Strong command of distributed systems, APIs, microservices, cloud-native architecture, enterprise integration, and at least one major cloud platform.
* Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, secure development, and modern data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to improve solution cost, latency, scalability, reliability, and engineering quality.
* Experience mentoring senior technical professionals and communicating complex decisions to business and client leaders.

Preferred Experience

* Multi-tenant platforms, reusable AI accelerators, MLOps/LLMOps, model governance, or regulated and security-sensitive environments.
* Technical pre-sales, client workshops, proposals, solution estimation, and technical due diligence.
* A track record of taking multiple AI or software products from concept to sustained production use.

Leadership Profile

* **Hands-on and accountable:**
  Stays close to code and architecture and drives critical issues to resolution.
* **Commercially pragmatic:**
  Balances technical ambition with client value, speed, maintainability, and cost.
* **Constructive challenger:**
  Identifies weaknesses early, challenges assumptions, and raises engineering standards.
* **Capability builder:**
  Develops strong, independent teams rather than becoming the sole source of expertise.

Why Join Straive?

You will shape how enterprise-grade AI solutions are architected, built, and scaled with the mandate to influence technical strategy, strengthen engineering practices, develop high-performing teams, and deliver differentiated solutions for global clients.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive & Manufacturing
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Automotive and Manufacturing team is looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possesses a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with some of the world's largest automotive and manufacturing firms, AWS Sales and other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.
  
  
This role will drive AWS technology adoption and revenue growth across assigned automotive and manufacturing customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the Senior Solutions Architect will work directly with leading industrial manufacturers as they reimagine how things are designed, built, and operated. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate architectural decisions across connected vehicle platforms, digital twins, smart factory/Industry 4.0 initiatives, supply chain optimization, and software-defined vehicle (SDV) strategies.
  
  
As a key member of the Account Team, you will guide customers' architectural choices across use cases involving IoT, edge computing, high-performance computing (HPC), security, data lakes and analytics, AI/ML, simulation, and robotics — as well as foundational services spanning compute, storage, and networking. You will provide technical design guidance and thought leadership, contribute to best-practice knowledge sharing within the broader AWS Solutions Architecture community, and help develop reusable industry reference architectures.
  
  
The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology architecture or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  

* Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for connecting with, educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for automotive and manufacturing customers.
* Have a strong understanding of large-scale, mission-critical solutions in the automotive and manufacturing industry. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems engineer/architect in the automotive or manufacturing sector. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned Automotive and Manufacturing accounts, engaging Director-level engineering leaders and senior technical stakeholders.
* Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions for industry-specific workloads including connected vehicle data platforms, digital twin environments, MES/SCADA cloud integration, and smart factory deployments.
* Bridge IT and OT — connect traditional enterprise IT architectures with operational technology (OT) environments on the shop floor and at the edge, leveraging AWS IoT, edge, and hybrid services.
* Develop and execute technical account plans aligned with customers' business objectives and digital transformation roadmaps.
* Lead proof-of-concept engagements and architectural reviews to accelerate customer adoption and de-risk production deployments.
* Provide customer feedback to AWS service teams and advocate for industry-relevant feature development.
* Contribute to industry thought leadership — create reference architectures, blog posts, and reusable technical assets for the vertical.
* Present at AWS events (re:Invent, Summits, industry conferences) and participate in customer technical workshops.
* Share knowledge and best practices with peers in the Solutions Architecture community, contributing to technical community development.
* Stay current with industry megatrends (electrification, SDV, Industry 4.0, sustainability) and connect them with AWS capabilities to drive customer outcomes.

**About The Team**
The Automotive and Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is a specialized group of technologists passionate about helping the world's leading vehicle manufacturers, industrial companies, and mobility innovators transform through cloud. We work at the intersection of current technology and physical-world engineering — from the factory floor to the connected car to the autonomous future. Our team values deep industry expertise, intellectual curiosity, and a builder mentality.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
* Working knowledge of at least two of the following domains: IoT/edge computing, data analytics/data lakes, AI/ML, HPC, DevOps/CI-CD, or application modernization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with automation and any version control tools, or experience with web-based applications and HTTP and experience in any Bigdata architecture
* Familiarity with Industry 4.0 concepts: digital twins, predictive maintenance, computer vision for quality inspection, and manufacturing execution systems.

title: Director Software Eng
description:

**while respecting real‑world operational, security, and regulatory constraints**
. Success is measured by validated learning, speed‑to‑insight, and successful transition of ideas into core product organizations. The role is expected to be hands-on with 40% time dedicated to Software Development and the rest on the remaining responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Innovation & Idea Incubation Leadership**

* Own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of idea incubation from problem discovery and hypothesis framing to prototyping, validation, and graduation or termination.
* Establish repeatable incubation frameworks using design thinking, Lean Startup, and experiment‑driven development.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, learning velocity, and evidence‑based decision‑making in high‑ambiguity environments.
* Ensure early‑stage experimentation incorporates domain realities from Buildings, Security, and Industrial contexts, avoiding innovation that cannot transition to real deployments.

**Technical & Architectural Leadership**

* Provide technical direction across incubated initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and production‑ready.
* Guide teams in selecting and applying emerging technologies including cloud‑native platforms, SaaS, AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, and edge computing.
* Ensure architectural decisions explicitly address non‑functional requirements such as availability, scalability, security, compliance, and operational resilience.
* Partner with Architecture and SRE leaders to ensure smooth transition of incubated solutions into enterprise‑scale delivery models and long‑lived product platforms.

**AI SDLC + SW Engineering Skills**

: Data → model → deployment → monitoring
  
  
**MLOps / LLMOps + CI/CD**
: Pipelines, versioning, automated deploy & testing
  
  
**Data & Model Engineering**
: Data pipelines + LLMs/RAG + model optimization
  
  
**Software Engineering Fundamentals**

* API design, microservices
* Clean code, testing
* System design

**Cloud-native Architecture**
: Kubernetes, Docker, scalable AI services
  
  
**Domain‑Driven Engineering Leadership**

* Ensure engineering teams deeply understand and design for domain‑specific constraints and requirements, including:

+ Buildings (commercial buildings, campuses, multi‑site operations, 24×7 uptime expectations)
+ Security (cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory compliance, secure‑by‑design principles)
+ Industrial / OT (manufacturing, process industries, legacy systems, safety‑critical environments)

* Drive domain‑driven design practices so incubated solutions reflect real operational workflows, asset models, and system boundaries.
* Validate that domain requirements are explicitly captured and tested during incubation, not deferred to later product teams.

**Buildings Domain Knowledge**

* Has led engineering innovation for software platforms that integrate with Building Management Systems (BMS) such as HVAC, lighting, energy, fire, and life‑safety systems.
* Ensure incubated solutions support multi‑site and multi‑tenant building deployments and can scale reliably beyond pilot environments.
* Drive interoperability across heterogeneous OT devices, protocols, and vendor ecosystems common in building environments.
* Ensure experimentation and pilots account for continuous operations and minimal disruption expectations in live buildings.

**Security & Privacy Knowledge**

* Own security‑by‑design and privacy‑by‑design accountability across all incubated software initiatives.
* Ensure security requirements align with industrial and OT security standards (e.g., ANSI/ISA‑62443) and enterprise security policies.
* Require and oversee:

+ Threat modeling and secure architecture reviews
+ Strong authentication, authorization, and role‑based access control
+ Secure handling of credentials, secrets, and certificates
+ Audit logging and traceability for security‑relevant actions

* Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and completion of required Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) prior to graduation of incubated solutions.
* Partner closely with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure incubated ideas are viable in regulated environments.

**Industrial & OT Engineering Knowledge**

* Led incubation of software solutions for industrial and OT‑centric environments, including manufacturing, energy, and process industries.
* Ensure platforms can integrate with industrial control systems (ICS) such as SCADA, PLCs, edge devices, and legacy systems.
* Drive architectures that support deterministic performance, high‑frequency telemetry, and near‑real‑time decision support where required.
* Balance innovation speed with production continuity, safety, and reliability expectations in live industrial environments.
* Ensure solutions are designed for long asset lifecycles, staged rollouts, and controlled upgrade windows typical of industrial customers.

**Organization & Talent Leadership**

* Build, mentor, and retain high‑performing engineering leaders and senior technologists.
* Develop engineering managers and tech leads capable of balancing experimentation speed with technical rigor and domain responsibility.
* Foster an inclusive, high‑accountability culture emphasizing ownership, craftsmanship, and engineering judgment.

**Business & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Product, UX, Data, OT, and Business leaders to align incubated ideas with strategic priorities and domain realities.
* Translate technical and domain insights into compelling narratives for senior leadership.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on innovation strategy, platform evolution, and technology investment decisions.

**Execution & Governance**

* Define success metrics for incubation including validated learning, domain readiness, and transition viability.
* Ensure disciplined execution through lightweight governance, clear decision points, and risk transparency.
* Own budget, capacity planning, and vendor strategy for innovation initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Preferred Experience & Skills**

* Experience with Buildings, Industrial, SaaS, or platform‑based businesses.
* Exposure to OT environments, cybersecurity, or regulated systems.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Staff Software Development Engineer
  
  
**Department, Level:**
VoD Video Engineering, X31
  
  
**Location:**
Onsite, Bangalore
  
  
**Work Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Job Summary**
:
  
  
As a Staff Software Development Engineer in the VoD Video Engineering team, you will own and drive the architecture and delivery of critical backend systems that power our Video-on-Demand platform at massive scale. You will design and build the services that enables seamless ingestion, transcoding, packaging, and delivery of video content to hundreds of millions of viewers. This role sits at the intersection of high-throughput distributed systems, media processing pipelines, and cloud-native architecture — offering a rare opportunity to make a deep technical impact while shaping the future of video streaming at scale.
  
  
**About the Team:**
VoD Video Engineering team is the backbone of our streaming platform — responsible for the entire lifecycle of on-demand video content, from ingest and transcoding through packaging, storage, and delivery. We own mission-critical systems that process thousands of hours of video daily, serving a global audience with reliability, low latency, and the highest quality of experience. Our team operates at the forefront of media technology, collaborating closely with CDN, playback, and content operations teams to continuously raise the bar on performance and scalability. If you're passionate about large-scale distributed systems and the technology behind modern video streaming, this is the team to be on.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture and delivery of VoD backend systems — from content ingest, transcoding, and ABR packaging to metadata management and delivery orchestration.
* Design highly scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems for video processing, ensuring high availability and low-latency content delivery at global scale.
* Lead the design and evolution of video processing pipelines including codec selection, container formats (MP4, fMP4), ABR ladder optimization, and DRM/encryption workflows.
* Define and implement APIs and microservices that integrate the VoD platform with internal services such as CMS, CDN, entitlements, and analytics systems.
* Drive technical strategy and roadmap for the VoD engineering domain, partnering with product and content operations to align engineering investments with business goals.
* Establish engineering best practices including system design reviews, code quality standards, observability patterns, and SLA/SLO frameworks for production systems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (streaming, playback, data engineering, DevOps) to deliver seamless end-to-end user experiences.
* Identify and drive performance improvements — optimizing throughput, reducing processing costs, and improving time-to-publish for new content.
* Mentor and grow senior and mid-level engineers; lead design discussions, architecture reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives across the team.
* Champion reliability engineering: drive incident response, post-mortem culture, and system resilience improvements across the VoD stack.

Skills and attributes for success:
  
  

* 7+ years of professional backend software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in large-scale distributed systems or media/streaming platform roles.
* Expert-level proficiency in Go, Python, or Java with a strong command of software engineering fundamentals, design patterns, and performance optimization.
* Understanding of video processing technologies: codecs (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1), container formats (MP4, fMP4, CMAF), and adaptive bitrate streaming protocols (HLS, MPEG-DASH).
* Strong proficiency in distributed systems design — message queues (Kafka, SQS), workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions), and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, or GCP) and containerized deployments using Kubernetes and Docker in production environments.
* Proficiency with observability and monitoring tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Datadog) and experience building production-grade reliability practices.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams

Preferred education and experience:
  
  

* Bachelors/master's in computer science or a related field with 7-9 years of professional experience
* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. MS or PhD a plus

**About JioStar**
Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

title: Senior AI Solution Architect
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
  
  
As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.
  
  
Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
  
  
This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.

* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

* Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
* Experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Master's degree or above in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing
* Deep Agentic AI expertise - Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and guardrails using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or AWS AgentCore; proficiency in responsible AI tooling including AWS Clarify, Guardrails for Bedrock, model explainability, and bias detection

title: Software Architect
description:
**Purpose of this position / Position summary :-**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Application Software Architect to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in back-end and front-end system design, data model design, API design, cloud-native design, and secure-first design principles (including OWASP, cloud security, and cryptography). They will also possess a strong understanding of software engineering, Agile practices, cloud architecture, Generative AI and prompt engineering, as well as the modernization of existing systems through maintenance, reverse engineering, and refactoring of legacy applications.

This role requires excellent documentation skills, the ability to mentor and extract work from the development team, and strong design articulation skills. Proficiency in development using .NET Core framework, C#, Python along with exposure in both Linux and Windows environments is essential. Experience with Azure, micro-frontends (including Module Federation), and the usage of Generative AI tools for code and test generation is highly preferred.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

* **Key Responsibilities**
  **System Design (Back-end & Front-end):**
* Develop and implement robust system architectures (services, integrations, and UIs) that meet business requirements and align with industry best practices.
* Own end-to-end architecture from front-end to back-end and data layers.
* Front-end System Design & Micro-Frontends:
* ***Design scalable front-end architectures using modern frameworks (e.g., Angular or React).***
* Architect and implement micro-frontend solutions, including Webpack Module Federation, to enable independently deployable UI modules.
* Define contracts, composition strategies, routing, and shared library strategies for micro-frontends.
* **Data Model Design:**
  Design efficient and scalable data models to support application functionality and performance.
* **API Design:**
  Create and maintain well-documented, secure, and scalable APIs.
* **Cloud-Native Design:**
  Architect cloud-native solutions leveraging Azure services to ensure scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
* **Secure-First Design (OWASP, Cloud Security & Cryptography):**
* Apply OWASP guidelines and secure coding practices throughout the SDLC.
* Design and review cloud security controls (identity and access management, network security, secrets management, compliance).
* Define and implement cryptographic practices (data-at-rest and in-transit encryption, key management, tokenization where applicable).
* **Software Engineering:**
  Apply solid software engineering principles to develop high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code.
* **Agile Practices:**
  Participate in Agile ceremonies, contribute to sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features.
* **Cloud Architecture:**
  Design and implement cloud infrastructure and services, with a strong understanding of Azure and its security services.
* **Legacy Systems – Maintenance & Modernization:**
* Analyze, maintain, and enhance existing and legacy applications to ensure stability, performance, and security.
* Perform reverse engineering of poorly documented or legacy systems to understand architecture, data flows, and integration points.
* Plan and execute refactoring and modernization initiatives (e.g., migration to microservices, micro-frontends, and cloud-native architectures) while minimizing business disruption.
* Introduce automation, monitoring, and observability to improve reliability and maintainability of legacy and modernized systems.
* **Refactoring & Code Quality:**
  Lead refactoring efforts to improve code quality, modularity, testability, and adherence to architecture guidelines and patterns.
* **Documentation:**
  Produce clear and comprehensive documentation for system designs, APIs, front-end and micro-frontend architecture, legacy system understanding, and development processes.
* **Mentoring:**
  Mentor and guide junior developers, providing technical leadership and fostering a collaborative team environment.
* **Design Articulation:**
  Effectively communicate design concepts and decisions to stakeholders and team members.
* **Generative AI, Agentic AI & Prompt Engineering:**
* Utilize Generative AI tools for code generation, test generation, and documentation assistance to enhance productivity and code quality.
* Apply prompt engineering techniques (prompt design, chaining, context management, and evaluation) to get reliable, secure, and high-quality outputs from AI tools.

title: Software Architect
description:
The opportunity
  
  
**The EMR Architect is a core architect of Experity's vision to become the indispensable operating system for on-demand healthcare.**
By diagnosing the legacy WPF monolith and mapping a domain-by-domain path to the modern web stack, this role transforms a rigid, single-threaded system into modular, workflow-aligned services that clinicians can move through faster and clinics can build on. This position ensures Experity's core clinical record isn't just stable—it becomes the foundation the rest of the platform can modernize around.
  
  
We're modernizing a legacy Windows/WPF-based EMR into a new web stack. This is a hands-on architecture role—you'll spend real time in the existing codebase, not just reviewing it from above, debugging multi-threaded WPF code paths and tracing real-time data flows to build an accurate picture of what's actually broken.
  
  
You'll own the architecture story for this migration end to end: diagnosing what's wrong with the current system, communicating that visually to engineers and leadership, and mapping a domain-driven path from monolith to modular web app aligned to real clinical workflows.
  
  
This role demands someone who can go deep on legacy Windows internals one day and present a migration roadmap to executives the next—thriving on ambiguity, incomplete documentation, and a codebase that predates most of the team.
  
  
Business impact
  
  

* Reduces patient-record risk and clinician downtime by replacing a fragile, single-threaded WPF core with a stable, modular architecture that can scale with clinic volume.
* Speeds care delivery by decomposing the EMR into workflow-aligned domains (vitals, exam, charting), cutting the friction clinicians hit moving between tasks in a shared screen and shared thread.
* Improves engineering velocity and lowers migration risk by producing a domain-by-domain roadmap that lets teams modernize incrementally instead of a high-risk, all-at-once rewrite.

What you will own
  
  
Architecture diagnosis
  
  

* A visual architecture diagnosis (diagrams, not docs) mapping the current WPF/.NET system's failure points, including thread contention and real-time data flow issues.

Domain boundary mapping
  
  

* A domain boundary map splitting the EMR into workflow-aligned pieces (e.g., vitals intake, full exam, charting) instead of one monolithic screen and thread.

Migration roadmap
  
  

* A domain-by-domain migration roadmap sequencing the move from legacy WPF to the modern web stack, with near-term stabilization fixes called out separately from the long-term rebuild.

Architecture communication
  
  

* A set of before/after architecture diagrams usable at both engineer and executive review, showing tradeoffs at each migration stage.

What you'll do
  
  

* Diagnose and visually communicate problems in the current WPF/.NET architecture (diagrams, not just docs).
* Debug and reason about Windows/WPF applications, including multi-threaded and real-time data (WebSockets, live push) code paths.
* Balance near-term performance and sustainability fixes with a long-term web-stack migration plan.
* Analyze the codebase to identify domain boundaries, and propose splitting the EMR into pieces aligned to workflow personas (e.g., nurse taking vitals vs. PA doing a full exam).
* Produce a go-forward roadmap for migrating the legacy EMR domain-by-domain to the new stack.

What we're looking for
  
  
**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in one of the STEM fields or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Hands-on experience with Windows/WPF application development and debugging.
* Hands-on C# multi-threaded debugging experience (race conditions, UI freezes, thread contention).
* Strong visual communication skills—can explain complex architecture and tradeoffs through diagrams at any audience level (engineer to exec).
* Experience with domain modeling and breaking down monolithic systems into bounded domains.
* Solid .NET fundamentals, including async/await and efficient sync-to-async call patterns.
* Experience with WebSockets or real-time data push architectures.

Nice to have
  
  

* Prior experience on an EMR, healthcare, or other high-reliability enterprise application.
* Experience leading or contributing to a legacy-to-web-stack migration.
* Solid, hands-on experience with TypeScript, Next.js, and modern web architecture.
* Experience designing for concurrent request handling from UI through to DB in large-scale systems.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

title: NFC FW Architect
description:
*NFC‑based platforms are at the heart of secure connected experiences across mobile, wearables, automotive, and IoT ecosystems. They span domains such as secure NFC transactions, digital wallets, infrastructure services, platform enablement, and low-level silicon integration. As a Firmware Architect in the NFC Firmware organization, you will contribute to defining and delivering robust firmware architectures that operate close to silicon and enable reliable product execution across multiple NFC use cases.*
*This role focuses on platform firmware architecture and execution for PCRM, low-level platform software, tapeout readiness, and post-silicon bring-up, while collaborating across hardware, systems, validation, and firmware development teams.*
*We are looking for a hands-on firmware technologist with strong embedded/firmware roots, good understanding of real-time systems and SoC platforms, and practical experience translating system and hardware requirements into clean, scalable firmware designs.*
**Your Responsibilities**

* She/He shall work as an NFC Firmware Architect and contribute to new product development, debugging, bring-up, and maintenance of NXP's embedded firmware for NFC products.
* Define and support firmware architecture for RISC-V/ARM platform.
* Derive firmware requirements from system, hardware, PCRM, and customer specifications.
* Design firmware sub-systems and low-level software components to meet functional, performance, memory, timing, and power requirements.
* Review design and code contributions, provide technical guidance, and help maintain quality of firmware deliverables.
* Own one or more firmware modules or platform software sub-systems from design through integration and bring-up.
* Define and write firmware design specifications, interface specifications, and low-level platform software documentation.
* Support definition of validation and bring-up environments for pre-silicon, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon phases.
* Contribute to firmware test strategy at unit, integration, system, and silicon bring-up levels.
* Support tapeout readiness activities by reviewing firmware dependencies, register/interface assumptions, boot flows, and hardware-software integration risks.
* Closely interact with hardware development teams, system architects, validation teams, and component technical experts to resolve low-level integration issues.
* Collaborate effectively with partner teams and ensure firmware architecture considers product, platform, and silicon constraints.
* Define firmware design guidelines, development flows, debug approaches, and bring-up checklists for platform software.

**Your Profile**

* Mandatory:

+ 8-12 years of embedded firmware development experience, preferably in SoC, mobile, secure embedded, or RTOS-based embedded systems.
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics from reputed institute with strong academic records.
+ Embedded software design and development on 8/16/32-bit platforms, preferably RISC-V and ARM architectures.
+ Excellent C programming skills, exposure to assembly with hands-on development experience.
+ Must have experience in low-level firmware programming, including boot flows, boot loaders, interrupt handling, memory maps, clocks, power states, SPI/I2C/UART drivers, RF interfaces, and embedded RTOS concepts.
+ Hands-on knowledge of RTOS, its concepts and usage.
+ Good knowledge of SoC hardware IP datasheets, register-level programming, hardware-software interfaces, and low-level driver development.
+ Hands-on exposure to PCRM topics, platform configuration, reset/clock/power management, and low-level initialization flows.
+ Experience supporting tapeout and bring-up activities, including pre-silicon validation on RTL, FPGA/emulation usage, post-silicon debug, and issue triage with hardware teams.
+ Exposure to IDEs like LPCXpresso, Keil, Eclipse
+ Experience in using Debuggers. (TRAC32/J-LINK/LPC-LINK)
+ Exposure to change management / configuration management, bug tracking tools.
+ Hands-on with AI based efficiency gaining tools.

* Optional

+ Exposure to C++ / C#, Perl/Python is an added advantage
+ Good understanding of NFC technology.

* Personality

+ Excellent analytical, problem solving, debugging skills & influencing skills with go-to attitude
+ Self-motivated, proactive, good verbal and written communication.
+ Sufficiently mobile and flexible, work location based out of Bangalore
+ Experienced in requirements derivation, low-level design, high-level design, and hands-on implementation in platform firmware domains.
+ Empathic communicator, able to see things from the other person's point of view and a good team player with cross functional, cross cultural & Global teams

***Desired Skill Set***

* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) for embedded firmware development
* Knowledge of embedded platforms, low-level platform software, and close collaboration with hardware teams is preferred.
* Understanding of tapeout milestones, silicon bring-up planning, debug instrumentation, and hardware-software readiness criteria.
* Know-how of smart card Contact less Proximity Standards such as ISO14443, ISO15693, ISO18092, ISO7816 etc.
* Near Field Communication Standards.
* Willing to travel to other countries on need basis

**Responsibilities**

to lead major components of our Payments technology transformation. You will architect, design, and implement mission‑critical distributed systems while driving adoption of agent‑powered engineering using tools such as

title: Staff Engineer, Revenue Experiences
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Commercial Experiences Engineering team is part of the Commerce Systems organization at Stripe. We focus on ensuring that our users, both internal and external, have a best-in-class experience with billing at Stripe. This includes working on the systems and processes needed to bill our largest and most complex customers, as well as designing and delivering experiences to help guide users through their billing, from fee explainability to deep diving on product usage optimization. We are a cross-functional technical team that seeks to bring clarity to a complex space. The team is at the crux of all Stripe products and builds user-facing as well as internal infrastructure.
  
  
We build platforms and services to define and manage pricing, calculate and collect Stripe's revenue, and empower Stripe and our users to understand and manage revenue and costs. We work on customer-facing experiences, internal platforms, and data pipelines to empower Accounting, Finance, Strategy, Sales, and Stripe's Products to drive business value across the entire user and product lifecycle.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join our India-based team and drive the technical roadmap for Commercial Experiences Engineering, collaborating deeply with partner teams across Commerce Systems in the US, EMEA, and India. In this role, you will work closely with engineering managers, senior engineers, and cross-functional partners to help design architecture, ensure technical excellence, and break down complex problems to make them more tractable with engineering teams. You will be involved in the building of the technical bench, mentoring and growing the next senior engineers within the broader organisation.
  
  
You will work cross-functionally to align on the business challenges in delivering excellent billing and accounting experiences to our users. Often this will include influencing across organizations and grounding your arguments in solid data and a technical roadmap. As such, you will have excellent technical leadership and communication skills.
  
  
You will also be hands-on in building key systems, while mentoring and leading other engineers. Join us in driving change in an area with tremendous opportunity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage the technical leadership, execution, and roadmap for Commercial Experiences Engineering.
* Work cross-functionally with business leaders across the company as well as partner engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering, product, and design leadership to define our product strategy and user experience.
* Ensure our platform solutions and user billing data are high quality, meet the needs of our internal users, and position us to meet Stripe's growth.
* Drive interoperability across platforms in User Billing and integrations across Stripe with product, accounting, sales, finance, and data science teams.
* Scrutinize billing interfaces and data models, elevating our focus on correctness and ease of use within User Billing.
* Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable the team to execute effectively.
* Foster a culture of learning and data-driven decision making on the team and to influence the broader organization.
* Mentor and support the growth of engineers at different levels in their careers.

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience building large-scale, distributed systems.
* Proven track record of building large-scale, complex distributed systems; identifying shortcomings and optimization opportunities; and making data-driven cost performance tradeoffs to influence design decisions.
* Experience building and operating infrastructure and tools that empower developers/product teams to deliver business value.
* Experience influencing company strategy at the intersection of business needs and technology (you measure your success in terms of business impact, not lines of code).
* Experience leading and creating strong technical teams that balance operational excellence, collaboration, and user needs.
* Strong collaboration skills to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Are effective in giving and receiving constructive feedback to/from peers and team members.
* Past experience mentoring and investing in the development of engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the financial technology space, particularly in payment processing, accounting, or financial reporting.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Pega Senior System Architect
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business - from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Pega Senior System Architect (SSA) in our Digital Sales Experience domain, you’ll play a key role in designing, developing and supporting enterprise-scale Pega applications. This role is primarily focused on
**Pega platform engineering, integrations, security and operational excellence**
, with some involvement in
**Pega Customer Decision Hub (CDH)**
to support outbound customer communications.
  
  
You will work across the full application lifecycle, delivering scalable and resilient solutions while ensuring adherence to Pega best practices and enterprise standards. Working within an Agile environment, you’ll collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality customer and business outcomes.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Acacia - Manyata Tech Park, Bangaluru
  
  
Work Hours: Regular**
**What will your day look like?**
As a Senior System Architect, you will
  
  

* Design, develop and maintain enterprise applications on Pega Platform.
* Build and support Pega components including Activities, Data Transforms, Data Pages, Report Definitions, Job Schedulers, Queue Processors and Data Flows.
* Develop and maintain integrations using REST APIs, SMTP for Email, SMPP for SMS, Event streams and File-based interfaces.
* Configure and support secure access by implementing authentication, authorization, access groups, roles, privileges and application security controls.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to improve platform stability and performance.
* Support data movement and processing across enterprise applications, ensuring reliable system integration and operational efficiency.
* Configure and maintain outbound communications including email and SMS treatments, templates and schedules within the CDH ecosystem.
* Partner with business and delivery teams during testing, release activities and production deployments.
* Contribute to release planning, environment management and deployment activities across development, test and production environments.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical design discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor team members and provide technical leadership to support engineering capability growth.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* 5-8+ years hands-on experience delivering solutions on Pega Platform.
* Strong expertise in Pega application development, platform engineering and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience developing and supporting Activities, Data Transforms, Data Pages, Report Definitions, Job Schedulers, Queue Processors and Data Flows.
* Proven experience implementing and supporting REST, Email, SMS, Events and File-based integrations.
* Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, access management and application security principles.
* Experience supporting and troubleshooting production environments, including performance tuning and issue resolution.
* Exposure to Pega Cloud environments and deployment processes across multiple environments.
* Working knowledge of Pega Customer Decision Hub, including Next-Best-Action Designer (NBAD), Actions, Treatments, Outbound Schedules, Engagement Policies
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.

**Good to have skills:**

* Experience with Pega SendGrid integrations and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SMS and digital messaging channels.
* Banking and Financial Services industry experience.
* Experience supporting large-scale outbound communication campaigns.

**Mandatory Certifications:**

* Certified System Architect (CSA)
* Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA)
* Certified Pega Decisioning Consultant (CPDC)

**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

title: BSW MCU Senior SW Architect
description:
We are looking for a
**BSW MCU Senior Software Architect**
. You will join the Base Software (BSW) Architecture team of a major OEM, designing the next generation of real-time, safety-critical ECUs based on automotive microcontrollers, and owning the software architecture, interfaces, and integration strategy for Classic AUTOSAR-based ECUs across a next-generation vehicle software platform.

**Engagement details**
:

* Location: Bengaluru, India
* Working model: Hybrid
* Start date: ASAP
* Employment type: Contractor / Permanent EoR contract

**Responsibilities**
:

* Own scalable, modular software architecture for multi-feature MCU-based ECUs, applying SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean layering so independent features stay decoupled and reusable across platforms and variants
* Model software architecture using SysML/UML (Rhapsody), keeping full requirement-to-architecture traceability
* Define the BSW architecture and requirements for MCU-based ECUs across Classic AUTOSAR layers, MCAL, OS configuration, watchdog, diagnostics, memory, and bootloader strategies
* Architect and specify low-level drivers and hardware-near components for MCU peripherals (PWM, DIO, SPI, ADC, CAN-FD, UART, I2C, GPT, WDG, GPIO)
* Design real-time execution models, including scheduling, interrupt handling, timing budgets, and resource constraints for ASIL-rated control units
* Define ECU start-up sequences, fault-recovery mechanisms, degraded-mode strategies, and power management policies for MCU platforms
* Collaborate with hardware architects on MCU selection, memory layouts, safety mechanisms, and system partitioning
* Lead integration of BSW modules (COM, DEM, DCM, CSM, E2E, NvM, PduR, etc.) ensuring consistency across the AUTOSAR stack
* Drive ASPICE- and ISO 26262-compliant architecture work products, including software architecture documents and requirement specifications
* Participate in cross-domain discussions to ensure seamless integration between MCU ECUs and SoC/HPC domain controllers

**Qualifications**
:

* Proven experience designing modular, scalable software architectures — hands-on application of SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture for ECUs integrating multiple features (not configuration or integration only)
* Proficiency in SysML/UML architecture modelling (Rhapsody mandatory; PREEvision a plus)
* 5+ years of experience in embedded software architecture for automotive microcontrollers
* Strong expertise in Classic AUTOSAR (BSW, RTE, MCAL) and AUTOSAR specifications
* Deep experience with automotive MCU architectures and low-level driver design
* Experience with real-time systems, task scheduling, interrupt design, and timing analysis
* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 (ASIL-B/D) for MCU-based ECUs
* Experience with requirement management tools such as IBM DOORS Next Generation (DNG)
* Solid knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet gateway basics)
* Experience working in ASPICE-aligned development environments
* Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills in a global multicultural organization

**Next Steps**

* Click Apply.
* We will review your application.
* If qualified, you’ll be accepted into the Hashlist network and considered for this and other relevant projects.

title: Staff/Principal Engineer Core Team
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We are looking for a Staff/Principal Engineer to join the team.
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**AI Gateway**
is the control plane of five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solve some of the most complex Engineering problems and drive it alongside a team of engineers & ML researchers.
* Build a deep, holistic understanding of the TrueFoundry platform across all components and shape the product vision and implementation.
* Act as the technical face of engineering for customer-related discussions and escalations
* Guide and unblock engineers across projects in the US region
* Partner closely with our CTO and India-based engineering team to drive system design, architecture, and implementation of complex products
* Lead technical design, critical customer problem-solving, and platform scalability initiatives end-to-end

This is a high-ownership, high-impact role designed for an engineer who loves combining world-class systems thinking with real-world execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop deep expertise across TrueFoundry’s platform stack: infrastructure, deployment systems, LLM/ML orchestration, observability, cost optimization, and more
* Drive the system architecture and design for complex, distributed, cloud-native systems
* Act as the technical point-of-contact for enterprise customer engineering needs and escalations
* Lead and participate in design reviews, code reviews, and critical incident responses
* Collaborate closely with the CTO on architectural decisions, scaling strategies, and technical roadmap prioritization
* Identify and drive technical debt cleanup, performance improvements, and resilience upgrades across the platform
* Bring a product engineering mindset, ensuring that customer needs and feedback translate into scalable engineering solutions

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years of strong backend/systems engineering experience at top technology companies or startups
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and scalable system design
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and infrastructure engineering
* Practical experience building or deploying ML/GenAI applications (or closely working with ML/DS teams)
* Skilled in programming languages such as Python, Golang, TypeScript, and Node.js
* Solid understanding of system observability, resiliency design, and SRE practices
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills — able to work with both customers and engineering teams
* Ability to think strategically while also executing hands-on when required

Perks of Working at TrueFoundry
  
  

* Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The Job**
At AVEVA, we’re looking for an experienced R&D Principal Technologist to join the Predictive Analytics product team. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role focused on designing and evolving enterprise software that works with large-scale industrial and time-series datasets, delivers advanced analytics, and provides rich web-based user experiences.
  
  
The role requires strong full-stack engineering expertise across C#/.NET and modern JavaScript/TypeScript technologies, including Angular, combined with experience building scalable, high-performance applications that process and present large volumes of data.
  
  
You will provide technical direction across the product lifecycle, lead complex feature development and architectural decisions, and collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, QA, DevOps, and other R&D teams. You will operate at both the strategic and hands-on engineering levels—shaping technical direction while remaining close to the code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the architecture and technical direction for Predictive Analytics, with a focus on scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and modernization.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of complex features spanning C#/.NET backend services, APIs, data processing, and Angular-based user interfaces.
* Design solutions capable of efficiently handling large-scale datasets and high-volume time-series data.
* Drive performance engineering across the data, backend/API, and UI layers, applying techniques such as query optimization, caching, pagination, asynchronous processing, batching, and efficient data transfer.
* Design and evolve distributed and cloud-connected solutions using appropriate patterns including microservices, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, resiliency patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
* Drive product modernization and evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches through technical discovery and proof-of-concepts.
* Champion engineering excellence through strong practices in software design, code quality, automated testing, security, observability, and CI/CD.
* Lead technically complex initiatives, identify and mitigate technical risks, and coordinate dependencies across teams and shared platforms.
* Partner with Product Owners and R&D leadership on backlog shaping, estimation, technical roadmaps, and delivery planning.
* Mentor and coach engineers, promote knowledge sharing, and raise the technical capability of the broader engineering team.
* Contribute to production readiness, performance diagnostics, troubleshooting, release risk assessment, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience delivering enterprise software products.
* Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, including enterprise applications, APIs, and services.
* Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular for modern enterprise web application development.
* Proven full-stack development experience across backend, frontend, APIs, and supporting services.
* Strong experience designing applications that process large-scale datasets, with an understanding of data access performance, scalability, memory utilization, and efficient data processing.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean architecture, API design, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing scalable and resilient systems using concepts such as microservices, asynchronous/event-driven architectures, and fault-tolerance patterns.
* Working knowledge of cloud-native application development, including Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and service-based deployment architectures.
* Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including automated testing, Git, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, secure development, and observability.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, with the ability to lead complex initiatives, influence technical decisions, and mentor engineers.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Experience building data-intensive, analytics-driven, or time-series applications where data volume, processing performance, and UI responsiveness are critical.
* Experience optimizing performance across data access, APIs, backend processing, caching, and frontend rendering.
* Experience working with on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures.
* Familiarity with Azure services and technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, AKS, and related cloud services.
* Experience with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT.
* Experience modernizing monolithic enterprise applications toward modern .NET, Angular, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Strong understanding of software security, dependency management, vulnerability remediation, and secure development lifecycle practices.
* Experience with technical discovery, prototyping, and evaluating architectural and technology trade-offs.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and developer productivity.
* Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time-series data, or other data-intensive industrial software is an advantage.
* Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams.

**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Staff Engineer, Systems Design/Architecture Engineering
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead the architecture, development, and integration of SystemC/TLM-2.0 virtual platforms for complex multi-core SoCs, including processors, interconnects, memory subsystems, peripherals, accelerators, and custom IPs.Own individual IP modeling and lifecycle maintenance, ensuring alignment with evolving specifications.
* Define and own the virtual platform modeling strategy, methodology, coding standards, and reusable model libraries across programs.
* Serve as technical lead for multiple IP models and full-system platforms, managing them from specification through release and lifecycle maintenance.
* Drive shift-left enablement by delivering virtual platforms early for firmware, driver, OS, and application bring-up ahead of RTL and silicon availability.
* Architect models of complex system behavior, including memory-mapped transactions, interrupts, DMA, cache coherency, power management, security, and bus protocols
* Define model validation and RTL correlation strategies, including co-simulation and hybrid emulation flows, regression infrastructure, and quality metrics.
* Integrate virtual platforms with third-party and open-source ecosystems such as QEMU, Synopsys Virtualizer, Cadence, Siemens, and Arm Fast Models, as well as debuggers and CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with architecture, hardware, software, verification, and product teams to set VP requirements, milestones, and deliverables aligned with program schedules.
* Lead post-silicon validation and debug support by reproducing field and silicon issues on virtual platforms, performing root-cause analysis, and feeding results back into models and specifications.
* Mentor and technically guide P1–P3 engineers through design and code reviews and technical growth.
* Represent the modeling team in cross-site technical forums, customer engagements, and industry standards discussions

**Position Requirements:**

* Minimum B.E./B.Tech or MS/M.Tech/Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Science.
* B.E./B.Tech with 8–12 years, MS/M.Tech with 6–10 years, or Ph.D. with 4+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Expert-level knowledge of SystemC, TLM-2.0, C, and modern C++ (C++14/17), including model performance optimization.
* Proven track record of architecting and delivering full-system SoC virtual platforms used in production software development.
* Deep experience with ARM and/or RISC-V processor architectures, including ISS/CPU model integration, boot flows, and software bring-up (bare-metal, RTOS, Linux).
* Strong understanding of SoC architecture, memory hierarchies, coherency protocols, interconnects, and hardware/software co-design.
* Experience with commercial or open-source VP tools and frameworks (e.g., Synopsys Virtualizer, Arm Fast Models, QEMU, GreenSocs/QBox).
* Experience with RTL co-simulation, hybrid emulation, or model-to-RTL correlation methods.
* Proficient in Python and build systems (CMake) for automation, model generation, and validation.
* Hands-on experience with software development practices and tools such as Agile, DevOps, Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and code-quality tooling.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional initiatives, and influencing architecture decisions.
* Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware/software boundaries.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including presenting technical strategy to stakeholders and management.
* Ability to work across a geographically dispersed team and deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.Strong debugging, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self-motivated team player with the ability to collaborate with team members of varying skillsets
* Ability to work effectively as part of a geographically dispersed team

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*
*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*
