title: Associate Solutions Architect (GTM)
description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is currently implementing a number of large enterprise transformation programmes, to fundamentally transform our Lead to Support processes. As part of this, end to end solutions architect roles to enable different commercial services to be onboarded through both digital channels as well as through our enterprise Platforms are critical to our success.
  
  
As an employee at Thomson Reuters, you will play a role in shaping and leading the global knowledge economy. Our technology drives global markets and helps professionals around the world make decisions that matter. Whether solving for today’s challenges or tomorrow’s aspirations, you will work with the industry’s brightest thinkers on diverse projects, creating next-generation solutions that deliver powerful results. As the world’s leading provider of intelligent information, we want your unique perspective to create the solutions that advance our business—and your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Be a Technical Leader: Research and recommend technical standards and best practices. Work with technology teams and beyond to realise their implementation
* Be an efficient Stakeholder Manager: collaborate and engage with external and internal stakeholders such as business teams, product owners, project management in defining roadmap for products and processes. Act as point of contact in resolving stakeholder issues
* Be a Decision Maker: make quick and effective date driven decisions, with good problem solving and analytical skills to infer qualitative and quantitative data, and roll out strategy that aligns with company goals
* Be a Team Player – ability to work in a collaborative team-oriented environment, share information, value diverse ideas, partner with cross functional and remote teams
* Be Curious & Innovative – continuously update yourself with next generation technology, development tools, and contribute to process development practices
* Be an Agile Person – with strong sense of urgency and a desire to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment to deliver solutions against strict timelines.
* Be an Effective Communicator – ability to clearly articulate complex technical issues, and share ideas, participate in peer-reviews, and exhibit strong listening skills. Work with the business owners to translate requirements into actionable architectures.
* Architecture Strategy & Roadmap - define and update solution roadmaps for the architectures in which you are involved
* Architecture design for future and existing enterprise transformation programmes, ensure that technology components used fit with the overall technology strategy. Ensure also that the architecture is communicated, understood and adhered to.
* Architecture Governance – work as part of the Design Authority structure , work vendor partners and participate in the Solution Review board to ensure that solutions are governed appropriately.

**Required Qualifications**

* Have a wide variety of Solutions Architecture experience – across multiple business contexts
* Have consulting experience with a strong track record at a leading IT consultancy or large corporate
* Have experience working with agile teams and methodologies and globally distributed teams.
* Have Solid experience techniques in the following areas: key features and capabilities provided by the market leading CRM and Self Service platforms, integration of CRM to Self Service platforms, integration of CRM to ERP, Middleware and Web Content Management Systems, and application security best practice.
* Have a solid track record of experience within Blue Chip clients
* Ideally have a Development/Systems background with experience across the full project lifecycle
* Have experience in developing solution architectures, preparing and maintaining Business process, Data Model, system, sequence and process flow diagrams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Have experience in working with diverse teams, including multi country and company teams
* Have experience managing or directing work of others to contribute to a shared goal
* Have strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Have a self-motivated, proactive mindset
* Have an organized and methodical approach
* Experience in defining target architecture designs and roadmaps
* Experience in data migration between systems and be able to analyze and support in addressing the application performance issues
* Required degree level (BA/BSc/MSc/BEng/MEng) in a Technical/Business discipline
* Preferred – certification in TOGAF or other architecture framework
* Creates and oversees the architectural design of small to medium sized projects consistent with long term IT strategy.
* Ensures the architecture is communicated, understood and adhered to by the project team.
* Works on multiple projects and manages time effectively, proactively assessing risk and dependencies
* Partners with peer architects on large projects to provide ongoing architecture oversight throughout the development lifecycle, after the overall architecture has been developed and communicated.
* Evaluates and recommends emerging trends in software design and development strategies and evaluate their use in the development environment.
* Evaluates and makes recommendations for buy versus build decisions.
* Ensures consistency with architectural standards for assigned projects.
* Provides and/or collaborates on design recommendations, application development constructs and integration solutions.
* Writes design specifications and other technical documentation
* Demonstrates design and technology approaches via prototypes
* Acts as an expert for a specific technology domain.
* May have a small team of technical specialists to coach and/or manage.
* Troubleshoots and resolves a variety of complex problems and technical issues taking a holistic and preventive perspective across systems and technologies.
* Technical lead or part of technical team in project planning sessions with senior clients, business analysts, and team members to analyze development requirements and provides design recommendations for complex systems.
* Supports and champions technical change initiatives.
* Identifies technical risks and supports mitigation.
* Communicates solutions, technical designs through formal and informal means to business unit executives, technology management, peers and development staff, and other colleagues.
* Partners with project manager(s) to incorporate technical dimension to project status reports and communicates timely and accurate status information to project leaders.
* Collaborates in setting development guidelines.
* Reviews technical designs to ensure compliance to standards.

description:

**(\*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - An AI platform for underwriting, claims, and insurance decision automation.)
  
  
**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**
BFSI, insurance, lending, Payments, Java, Springboot, Spring Boot, Kafka, Apache Kafka, Microservices, Domain Driven Design, DDD, System Design, HLD, LLD, Event Sourcing, Agentic AI, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, CQRS, Immutable ledgers
  
  
**An AI platform for underwriting, claims, and insurance decision automation. is Looking for:******
**THE ROLE**
As Engineering Lead for the Backend Platform, you will spend the majority of your time writing production
  
  
code, designing distributed systems, and solving the hardest engineering problems on the platform.
  
  
Alongside that, you will provide technical direction and mentorship to 2–5 backend engineers - reviewing
  
  
their code with architectural depth, leading design sessions, and helping them grow.
  
  
**Architecture & System Design**

* Own architecture decisions for backend platform components end-to-end - from design through

deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You are not reviewing someone else''s design you are making
  
  
the call.
  
  

* Design and implement event-driven insurance workflows - claims processing pipelines, underwriting

decision loops, policy lifecycle state machines - with write-path reliability as the non-negotiable
  
  
constraint.
  
  

* Define and enforce system decomposition principles: domain-driven boundaries, bounded contexts,

and coupling/cohesion trade-offs. Evaluate when not to over-engineer and make that call in code.
  
  

* Lead schema evolution strategy for long-lived insurance data: additive-only changes,

Liquibase/Flyway migration scripts, event versioning for immutable audit logs, and zero-downtime
  
  
rollout planning.
  
  

* Be the technical escalation point for complex distributed systems problems - Kafka pipeline failures,

distributed transaction consistency, performance degradation at scale, data integrity across service
  
  
boundaries.
  
  
**Hands-On Engineering**

* Write production-quality Java/Spring Boot code at a level that sets the bar for the engineers around

you - not prototype code, not proof-of-concept code.
  
  

* Implement and maintain Kafka-based event streaming pipelines: exactly-once semantics, dead letter

queues, consumer group management, partition strategy for insurance domain event volumes.
  
  

* Build for failure: implement the Transactional Outbox Pattern, Saga orchestration with compensating

transactions, Resilience4J circuit breakers (closed/open/half-open), and idempotent consumers across
  
  
every service boundary.
  
  

* Integrate AI capabilities into the insurance platform backend - LLM-powered claim assessment,

RAG-based policy retrieval, agentic underwriting workflows - wherever the product roadmap demands
  
  
it.
  
  

* Own observability: design distributed tracing, structured logging, and Prometheus/Grafana metric

strategies so the team sees failures before customers do.
  
  
**Technical Standards & Code Quality**

* Conduct deep, architectural code reviews - not style reviews. Catch distributed systems anti-patterns,

consistency model violations, and write-path risks before they reach production.
  
  

* Define and enforce engineering standards: schema migration practices, API versioning discipline, test

coverage requirements for write-critical paths, and production readiness criteria.
  
  

* Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for every significant technical call - what you chose, what

you rejected, and what the consequences are. Build the institutional technical memory.
  
  
**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES - TEAM TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP (20–30%)**
This is not a management role. You will not own hiring decisions, run performance review cycles, or manage
  
  
engineering budgets. The technical leadership responsibilities below are about multiplying the impact of the
  
  
engineers working alongside you - not about administration.
  
  
Technical Mentorship
  
  

* Provide technical direction to 2–5 backend engineers - help them understand the distributed systems

trade-offs behind every architectural decision, not just the decision itself.
  
  

* Pair on hard problems, review designs before implementation begins, and give feedback that teaches

rather than corrects.
  
  

* Identify skill gaps in the team proactively and address them through pairing, structured learning, or

technical deep-dives - not through escalation.
  
  
Design Reviews & Technical Governance
  
  

* Run design review sessions for significant backend changes - ensure domain boundaries are

respected, write-path reliability is considered, and the team is building something maintainable.
  
  

* Set the standard for what ''good'' looks like on this platform. Engineers should be able to look at your

code and your reviews to understand what the bar is.
  
  

* Contribute to technical hiring as a subject matter expert - evaluate candidates'' technical depth in

design discussions when needed, without owning the hiring process.
  
  
**Non-Negotiable**

* 8–12 years of software engineering experience with a strong and continuous Java/Spring Boot

production track record. You are still writing code every day in your current role.
  
  

* Currently in or coming from a technical lead or senior engineer role - not transitioning out of a

management role back into IC. The expectation is that you are at the peak of your technical output
  
  
right now.
  
  

* Apache Kafka production depth - consumer group management, partition strategy, exactly-once

semantics, DLQ design, and write-path reliability. Not configuration-level familiarity.
  
  

* Distributed systems ownership at implementation level - you can describe the schema of the outbox

table you built, the three states of the circuit breaker in your production system, and the specific failure
  
  
mode your Saga compensates for.
  
  

* Independent architectural reasoning - unprompted identification of failure modes, trade-off analysis

before being asked, and first-person design decisions with documented reasoning.
  
  
Insurance, payments, or lending domain experience - the regulatory compliance, audit trail
  
  
requirements, and data integrity constraints of BFSI systems are directly applicable to Anaira''s
  
  
platform.
  
  

* Production AI integration - RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, agentic workflows, or vector search in a

financial/insurance context. Anaira''s product is AI-native the engineering team will be integrating
  
  
LLMs into critical insurance workflows.
  
  

* CQRS and Event Sourcing production experience - read model projections, command handlers,

immutable event logs with upcasters. Directly applicable to Anaira''s audit and compliance
  
  
requirements.
  
  

* DDD (Domain-Driven Design) applied to a real system - not textbook. Bounded context decisions with

the trade-offs documented.
  
  

* Business process engine experience - Camunda, Flowable, or custom state machine implementations

for multi-step financial or insurance workflows.
  
  

* Open-source contributions, technical writing, conference talks, or public ADRs that demonstrate how

you think about engineering problems.

title: AI Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Rakuten India is the Development Centre and key technology hub of the Rakuten Group, Inc. We enable our businesses with our depth of knowledge in multiple streams of technology such as Mobile and Web Development, Web Analytics, Platform Development, Backend Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence and much more. Our unique 24/7 support center ensures reliability and sustenance of the Rakuten Ecosystem. With dedicated centres of excellence for Mobile Application Development, Data Analytics, Engineering, DevOps and Information Security, we ensure the success of multiple units of Rakuten Group, Inc. With 1700+ employees and growing, Rakuten India is housed in Crimson House Bangalore in the heart of the city.

**About Rakuten's BSS Engineering Team:**

Rakuten is at the forefront of innovation, and our in-house BSS engineering team is driving the future of telecommunications and digital services. We operate a cutting-edge, cloud-native microservices-based BSS platform serving both B2B and B2C customers globally. Our ambitious vision is to achieve
**Agentic SDLC**
and
**Agentic BSS**
, transforming our entire value chain through intelligent, autonomous agents. We're looking for a visionary and hands-on AI Architect to lead this charge.

**The Opportunity:**

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of how we build, deploy, and operate our mission-critical BSS platform. You will be instrumental in designing and implementing the architecture for our next generation of AI-powered autonomous agents, driving efficiency, innovation, and agility across our Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Business Support Systems (BSS). While BSS domain knowledge is a plus, your deep expertise in AI/ML, distributed systems, and a hands-on approach are paramount.

**What You'll Do:**

As our AI Architect (Agentic Systems), you will:

* **Architect Agentic Systems:**
  Design end-to-end architectures for intelligent agents that automate complex tasks within our SDLC (e.g., code generation, testing, deployment, security) and BSS (e.g., order fulfillment, customer support, service assurance, billing).
* **Drive Strategy & Roadmap:**
  Lead the technical strategy and roadmap for our Agentic SDLC and Agentic BSS initiatives, translating business needs into actionable AI/ML solutions.
* **Hands-on Prototyping & Development:**
  Be a hands-on contributor, developing proof-of-concepts, building core agent components, and guiding the implementation of AI solutions. You won't just design; you'll build.
* **LLM & AI Model Integration:**
  Architect the integration and orchestration of various AI models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) like Claude Code, Codex, and potentially open-source alternatives, into our agentic frameworks.
* **Data & MLOps Infrastructure:**
  Design and implement robust data pipelines, feature stores, and MLOps practices essential for agent training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous learning within our cloud-native environment.
* **Microservices & Cloud-Native Integration:**
  Ensure seamless integration of agentic systems with our existing cloud-native microservices architecture, leveraging Kubernetes, service meshes, and event-driven patterns.
* **Define Agent Interaction & Collaboration:**
  Design how agents interact with each other, with human users, and with external systems, focusing on robust communication protocols, feedback mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* **Performance & Scalability:**
  Ensure agentic solutions are designed for high performance, scalability, and reliability in a production environment serving millions of B2B and B2C customers.
* **Security, Governance & Ethics:**
  Incorporate security best practices, data privacy, and ethical AI principles into the design and implementation of all agentic systems.
* **Mentor & Evangelize:**
  Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and foster a culture of AI-driven innovation within the engineering team. Evangelize the vision and benefits of agentic systems across the organization.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a dedicated AI/ML Architect or Lead ML Engineer role.**
* **Deep hands-on expertise in designing, building, and deploying complex AI/ML systems into production.**
* **Proficiency in Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).**
* **Extensive experience with Large Language Models (LLMs):**
  Understanding of LLM architectures, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and integrating LLMs via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) or open-source models.
* **Proven experience with agentic frameworks or multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom implementations).**
  Demonstrated ability to build and orchestrate autonomous agents.
* **Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) automation tools and practices:**
  Including Git, CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD), static code analysis, and automated testing frameworks.
* **Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures:**
  Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, APIs, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka) in a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* **Experience with MLOps principles and tools:**
  Model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, data pipelines for ML workflows.
* **Proven ability to architect and implement robust, scalable, and secure distributed systems.**
* **Excellent problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic and outcome-oriented approach.**
* **Strong communication and collaboration skills:**
  Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):**

* Experience in the BSS (Business Support Systems) or telecommunications domain.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or relevant publications.

*“Rakuten is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and connectedness. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team and inclusive workforce. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and Rakuten’s achievement as well. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of their education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran’s status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs”*

title: Principal Architect - Payments & Ledger
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:

* The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators
* Money movement correctness -  Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own
* Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it
* FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available
* Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought
* Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners
* Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities
* Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current
* Partners and vendors - Technical evaluation and ongoing oversight of card processors, scheme connectivity, banking and settlement partners, FX liquidity providers, payout partners, KYC and screening vendors, and core infrastructure. You'll know their systems' failure modes as well as their own architects do
* Growing technical leaders - You'll mentor tech leads and senior engineers from day one and lead mostly through influence. As the function matures, you'll build and lead a small architecture group

**Requirements**

* Deep payments and ledger experience (essential) - You've designed or substantially rebuilt a production financial ledger. You can speak from real experience about journal design, posting models, balance consistency and correction strategies, including what happens when they go wrong
* Card issuing expertise - Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations (ideally Mastercard), issuer processing, authorisation flows, clearing files, and disputes
* A builder, not just an advisor - You've written production code at scale, and your work sits behind systems that handled real traffic and real money. Your authority comes from having shipped
* Range from system to field level - You're equally comfortable designing distributed settlement flows and deciding the type and precision of a single amount field, often in the same week
* Regulated-environment fluency - Experience with safeguarding and customer fund segregation, payment and e-money licensing, data residency, auditability and technology risk requirements, ideally including MAS and other Asia Pacific regulators. You design ahead of regulatory and scheme changes instead of reacting to them
* Multi-market experience - You've built systems that operate across several countries, currencies and regulators at once
* Strong writing - Clear, structured, opinionated documents that remain useful long after the meeting ends. Documentation is part of the work, not a follow-up task
* Opinions you can defend - Clear positions on design patterns, standards and trade-offs, explained just as well to a new graduate as to the board
* Credibility with partners - You can tell when a vendor's recommendation serves them more than us, and you can make that case with evidence
* Experience with Golang, event-driven architectures and cloud-native infrastructure is a plus

What This Role Is Not

This isn't a diagramming role, and it isn't a review gate that approves other people's work without contributing to it. It's also not an engineering management role with large headcount or delivery ownership, though its influence is comparable. If you're looking to run a large organisation, we have other roles for that.

What You Can Expect From Us

* The chance to shape the core money platform of Asia Pacific's leading multi-currency wallet, used by millions of people and businesses
* Some of the most interesting payments challenges in the region, across multiple markets, currencies, partners and regulators
* A company that is committed to getting the architecture right, not just shipping fast
* A culture that values technical craft, direct feedback and getting things done

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Responsibilities**
Business Impact
  
  

* Coaches the team on operating to required operational excellence and proven practice standards across all engagement stages, activities, and tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, consumption tracking, time tracking).
* Leads the team in orchestrating across Microsoft account teams, specialists, partners, and customer teams to deliver on-strategy Data & AI outcomes and increase customer and partner satisfaction.
* Oversees the team in anticipating and managing business and technical risks for data and AI workloads — including data quality, data governance, model performance, cost, and Responsible AI considerations — applying governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize risk.
* Leads the team in delivering solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., value-based deliverables [VBDs], architecture design sessions, technical validation, training), ensuring proven patterns are followed so customers are operationally ready to run data and AI workloads in production.
* Coaches the team on guiding customers toward well-architected (secure, resilient, governed, AI-ready), cost- and performance-optimized data platforms and AI solutions that increase retention and expansion opportunities.
* Drives the team to proactively identify cross-solution opportunities for Data & AI consumption, usage, and Unified expansion (including Enhanced Solutions) — such as data estate modernization, analytics migration to Microsoft Fabric, generative AI and agentic applications, and Copilot extensibility — based on clear business value to the customer.
* Guides the team on articulating the value of Unified and partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with the right Data & AI services. Leads feedback to the Unified Delivery team on Data & AI VBDs to refine and further develop content.
* Leverages change management proven practices (or engages the change management team) to help customers drive long-term organizational adoption of data and AI solutions, including data literacy and AI adoption.
* Drives the team on anticipating, identifying, escalating, and mitigating blockers — such as data readiness, platform limits, capacity and quota, security reviews, and skills gaps — to accelerate deployment, value realization, and consumption.
* Leads the team to capture opportunities in appropriate systems and tools, working collaboratively across the organization in alignment with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.

Customer Centricity
  
  

* Coaches the team to focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery and a seamless, connected customer experience; drives realization of customer conditions of success.
* Leads the team in anticipating and resolving customer dissatisfaction through customer confidence calls, and in executing strategies to improve experience, value realization, and speed of transformation.
* Supports the team in translating customer business problems into Data & AI solutions aligned with Microsoft's platform strategy — explaining how they meet business outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals through proofs of concept, minimum viable products (MVPs), and rapid prototypes, relative to competitive offerings.
* Coaches the team on building trusted relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C-suite — including Chief Data Officers (CDOs), Chief Data & Analytics Officers, Chief AI Officers, CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs — and bridging understanding between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs).
* Elevates engagements with CXO stakeholders on data governance, data privacy, security, compliance, and Responsible AI requirements, engaging additional subject matter experts where deeper expertise is required.
* Leads the team in acting as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and technical input with Engineering, Product, and internal communities. Coaches the team on identifying patterns across customers to develop actionable insights and on presenting business cases that influence product roadmaps and bug-fix prioritization.

Partner Specialization
  
  

* Actively orchestrates initiatives, leveraging an expansive knowledge of the Data & AI partner ecosystem to select and champion the most qualified partners for complex customer projects.
* Collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) stakeholders and Partner Technology Specialist (PTS) leadership to translate Data & AI opportunities into action, fostering technical and solution coherence across Microsoft partner and sales ecosystems.
* Concentrates on identifying and prioritizing opportunities that align with the organization's strategic revenue and consumption goals, directing partner and sales support through proofs of concept and technical pre-sales guidance.

People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  

* Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
* Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
* Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual's capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Leads the team in identifying gaps through delivery and connecting patterns across business and technology areas to drive improvements to products, intellectual property (IP), and practices that enable Data & AI solutions to scale across customers.
* Coaches the team on contributing to Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Cloud Adoption Framework for data and AI, Well-Architected Framework, Responsible AI Standard).
* Leads the team in contributing to and building reusable IP — reference architectures, accelerators, and solution patterns — especially where no IP exists yet (e.g., generative AI, AI agents, Copilot extensibility, RAG, and real-time intelligence scenarios).
* Enables the team to lead and assemble virtual teams (v-teams) around Data & AI technologies and customer challenges, sharing insights with technical communities across the field using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and the competitive landscape (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud).
* Drives recognition for Microsoft Data & AI solutions by leading and encouraging the team's participation in internal and external events (e.g., Ignite, Build, Fabric Community Conference, Tech Connect, meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons).
* Uses market insights and demand signals to help leadership prioritize up-skilling and accreditations. Drives the team to role-model technical readiness — depth in Data & AI (data engineering, analytics, data science, MLOps/LLMOps, generative and agentic AI) and breadth across CSU priorities such as security, resilience, and AI.
* Ensures team members dedicate time to continuous learning and certification, monitoring progress and providing guidance where appropriate.

**Qualifications**
Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in data platforms, analytics, AI/machine learning, cloud technologies, technology consulting, software development, solution architecture, and/or practice development; OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects, consultants, or technical specialist teams.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with hands-on experience designing and delivering data and AI solutions.
* 6+ years of experience leading technical projects, teams, or functions.
* Strong working knowledge of modern data and AI architectures (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh, real-time analytics, MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents) and Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Power BI, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, and Azure OpenAI.
* Understanding of data governance, security, and Responsible AI principles and tooling (e.g., Microsoft Purview).
* Technical certifications in data and AI (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent).
* 5+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects or consulting practice managers.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Business Solution Architect
description:

You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a dynamic
**Business Solution Architect**
to join our team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong financial background, an understanding of technology ecosystems, and a passion for driving innovation through data-driven solutions. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally across multiple lines of Conduent’s commercial business to design and implement solutions that deliver measurable value to clients, aligning with market trends and organizational strategy.

**Flexible Working**

**Working for You**

At Conduent, we are united by a shared mission. We understand that our success is driven by the success of our associates. When you join us, you’ll find opportunities to:
  
  

* Bring your authentic self to work every day.
* Grow and thrive both personally and professionally.
* Make a meaningful impact with our clients, in our communities, and for the millions of people we serve.

With over 50,000 associates in 24 countries, you’ll be part of a global team that’s shaping the future — for the company and for yourself.

title: ServiceNow Presales Solution Architect
description:

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12801
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead the end-to-end solutioning of ServiceNow opportunities—from client discovery and solution design through estimation, proposal, bid defence, and transition to delivery. The role converts business and service-management needs into a practical platform roadmap, implementation approach, managed-services model, and measurable value case.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead qualification, discovery workshops, solution design, estimation, proposal development, demonstrations, bid defence, and delivery handover.
* Assess client processes, platform maturity, pain points, governance, data readiness, user experience, and transformation priorities.
* Design fit-for-purpose solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management.
* Translate requirements into process designs, user journeys, platform capabilities, integrations, scope, roadmap, and operating model.
* Define assumptions, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, effort, team structure, commercials, and delivery approach.
* Create RFP responses, statements of work, solution narratives, estimates, benefit cases, and executive presentations.
* Work with technical, delivery, commercial, partner, and client teams to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, commercially sound, and delivery-ready.
* Develop reusable propositions, estimation models, workshop assets, and industry-specific ServiceNow solutions.

Presales & Solution Expertise
  
  

* Strong IT service management process design experience and practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned operating models.
* Deep functional knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, and Strategic Portfolio Management / ITBM, with broader awareness of adjacent ServiceNow workflows.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow implementation, development, upgrades, maintenance, platform administration, and technical architecture.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, client and server-side components, security rules, flows, notifications, import sets, and custom applications.
* Deep integration knowledge covering REST, SOAP/WSDL, JSON, MID Server, Integration Hub, authentication patterns, error handling, monitoring, and integration support.
* Experience defining service catalogs, request models, CMDB governance, service mapping outcomes, asset processes, metrics, SLAs, dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics requirements.
* Understanding platform implementation lifecycle, upgrades, release governance, testing, training, organizational change, adoption, and managed-service operations.
* Proven experience estimating functional scope and identifying cost drivers, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and conditions required for a credible commercial model.

**Qualifications / Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of IT experience with significant ServiceNow consulting, process transformation, solutioning, or presales responsibility.
* 5+ years of IT service management process design experience and strong exposure to ServiceNow implementations or transformations.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator preferred; one or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials strongly preferred.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred; process, architecture, agile, project, change-management, or business-analysis certification is advantageous.
* Experience in at least 2-3 end-to-end ServiceNow implementation or major transformation and multiple complex presales pursuits is preferred.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.
* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

**Experience**
10+ years in IT, including strong ServiceNow consulting, process design, solutioning, and presales experience
  
  
Primary focus
  
  
Platform architecture, integration, security, data, automation, technical estimation, and end-to-end presales, service design, and value realization
  
  
Key domains
  
  
ITSM, ITOM, SPM/ITBM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management as relevant
  
  
**Location:**
Flexible, with travel as required
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.**
**Role Overview**
**Salesforce is currently seeking a Sr Manager, Technical Consulting (Insurance and Financial Services) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team. We are key players in this objective, as they can use Industry Cloud functionality to deliver customer requirements quickly with minimal customization.**
**In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Insurance and Financial Services practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.**
**This role is 25% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Comms Cloud**
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll have up to 35 reports under your scope of responsibility. You will be required to deliver technical work (as a senior technical architect) on Financial Services domain projects at 25% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants, Architects and Managers.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants onTelecom/Comms so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous upskilling across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Insurance and Financial Services consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our Communication clients leveraging Salesforce Comms Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

title: Customer Success Technical Architect
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Customer Success Technical Architect (CSTA), you will be a trusted technical advisor to Confluent (an IBM Company) customers after they adopt our platform. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.
  
  
You will work as part of the broader customer account team and partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering. The role combines technical depth, customer leadership, structured execution, and the ability to translate complex architecture and operational topics into clear business outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own customer-facing technical execution for a portfolio of strategic customers, aligning activity to customer goals, adoption plans, and desired business outcomes.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from practitioners and architects to senior leaders.
* Provide proactive guidance on Confluent and Apache Kafka architecture, workload optimization, operational practices, upgrades, reliability, security, governance, and adoption.
* Maintain a regular customer operating rhythm via office hours, quarterly reviews, health checks, roadmap alignment, and enablement.
* Assess technical health, identify adoption blockers and emerging risks, and create clear action plans with owners, milestones, and follow-through.
* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

**Preferred Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or comparable practical background.
* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Success Architect, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, or equivalent.
* Ability to discuss application architecture, APIs, networking, security, observability, data integration, and production operations with technical stakeholders.
* Hands on knowledge of one or more key cloud vendors (AWS, GCP and Azure)
* Solid understanding of cloud networking and security technologies (e.g. VPC, Private Link, Private Service Connect, TLS/SSL, SASL, Kerberos, etc.)
* Experience prototyping and analyzing code for client solutions in multiple languages (e.g. Java, Python, Go, etc.)
* Experience with Java Virtual Machine (JVM) tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with operating Linux, you know how to configure, tune and troubleshoot both RedHat & Debian based distributions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead structured conversations with both technical teams and executives.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, create clarity in ambiguous situations, and drive actions to completion.
* A proactive, consultative mindset focused on preventing issues and creating customer value rather than only reacting to incidents.
* Willingness to continue learning in a rapidly evolving technical domain and to share knowledge with peers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience helping customers build distributed systems or streaming solutions that use Apache Kafka alongside technologies such as Spark, Flink, Hadoop, Cassandra, etc
* Experience with Apache Kafka & Apache Flink
* Confluent or Apache Kafka certification
* Experience working with global customers

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
****Job Type:**
Full-time**
**About The Team**
**At eBay, Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, and highly available traffic systems that support our global commerce platform. This role sits at the center of networking, platform engineering, performance optimization, and production reliability. The team is focused on building intelligent traffic management solutions, advancing PoP and caching strategies, improving observability and cyber resilience, and enabling eBay to innovate at internet scale.**
**Role Summary**
**We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of eBay’s traffic engineering platform. This is an L26-level role for an experienced technical leader who can operate beyond a single component or team, drive design across multiple functional areas, influence technical direction, and improve engineering effectiveness across the organization. You will combine deep systems and networking expertise with strong execution, mentoring, and multi-functional leadership to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance traffic solutions for eBay’s global platform.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery for traffic engineering systems spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, and caching infrastructure.
* Design and build resilient, secure, and high-performance distributed systems using C/C++ and Go, along with modern cloud-native platform patterns.
* Own technical decisions across multiple functional areas, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, maintainability, and time-to-market tradeoffs.
* Drive platform evolution on Kubernetes, including networking integrations such as CNI, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment patterns.
* Establish and improve engineering metrics aligned to team and business goals, using observability and production insights to drive reliability, efficiency, and customer impact.
* Lead incident prevention and operational excellence through strong observability, cyber security controls, performance tuning, and robust system design.
* Partner with product, infrastructure, security, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmaps, resolve cross-team dependencies, and drive technical consensus.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads through design reviews, code reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on problem solving, setting the standard for engineering quality across the team.
* Act as a technical multiplier by improving platform capabilities, team productivity, development practices, and long-term architectural direction.
* Contribute to eBay’s innovation culture through open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking technical exploration in networking and traffic systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with significant depth in networking, traffic engineering, distributed systems, or cyber security.
