title: R&D Solution Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are currently seeking a highly skilled and motivated R&D
**Tech Solution Lead**
to join our team and take charge of designing, developing, building, and implementing technology solutions across R&D.; In this role, you will provide technical leadership across applications and products, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure, software engineering, modern programming practices, and the effective use of Artificial Intelligence.
  
  
You will be instrumental in solving complex technical challenges and ensuring the smooth functioning, scalability, security, and maintainability of R&D; technology solutions.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Leading the design, development, and implementation of technology solutions across R&D; by defining solution architecture, designing and coding software components, and ensuring functionality, usability, scalability, security, and adherence to engineering standards
* Providing hands-on technical leadership across Microsoft Azure services, cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, application development, and DevOps practices
* Developing, reviewing, and guiding software solutions using programming languages and technologies such as React, Java, JavaScript, and other relevant modern development frameworks
* Working with product teams, business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and external partners to translate business requirements into secure, reliable, and scalable technology solutions
* Addressing and resolving complex bugs, integration issues, performance concerns, and technical risks across R&D; applications and platforms
* undefined
* Evaluating and recommending appropriate technologies, frameworks, Azure services, and infrastructure components to enhance solution efficiency, resilience, and scalability
* Exploring and applying Artificial Intelligence capabilities to relevant R&D; use cases, while considering responsible AI, data privacy, security, compliance, and business value
* Supporting engineering governance through design reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, quality controls, and adherence to the system development lifecycle
* Proactively identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, technical debt reduction, and modernization across R&D; technology solutions.

**Validation & Compliance (GxP)**

* Ensure all configuration and deployment activities comply with GxP, validation, and audit requirements.
* Support creation and maintenance of validation documentation, including:
* Configuration specifications
* Impact assessments
* Test evidence and traceability
* Participate in audits, inspections, and compliance reviews as needed.

**Operational Support & Issue Resolution**

* Support Level 2 / Level 3 incidents, defects, and change requests related to Vault configuration and deployments.
* Troubleshoot configuration and environment‑related issues in collaboration with Veeva, internal teams, and vendors.
* Ensure timely resolution of issues impacting business operations.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, QA, and Business SMEs to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
* Support UAT execution and coordinate defect resolution.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders on release readiness, risks, and deployment status.

**Documentation & Tools**

* Maintain accurate documentation for:
* Configuration changes
* Deployment activities
* Validation deliverables
* Use Jira, ALM, or equivalent tools for change tracking, defect management, and release coordination.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of relevant IT experience in software engineering, solution design, and product delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure across application hosting, integration, security, monitoring, data, and automation; a relevant Azure certification is preferred.
* Strong programming and application development experience with React, Java, JavaScript, APIs, modern frameworks, and related technologies.
* Experience designing, developing, integrating, and implementing enterprise applications and scalable technology solutions, including SaaS platforms.
* Sound understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI, including practical applications, responsible AI, data privacy, and security.
* Experience with DevOps and Agile engineering practices, including CI/CD, source control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, monitoring, release management, and the system development lifecycle.
* Sound understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, data privacy, and risk management, preferably in a regulated pharmaceutical or life sciences R&D environment.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder collaboration, communication, and technical leadership skills, with a hands-on approach and the ability to adapt to evolving technology and business needs.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced Microsoft Azure certification relevant to solution architecture, application development, or DevOps engineering
* Experience with Azure AI services, machine learning services, generative AI solutions, or AI-enabled application development
* Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or other SaaS platforms used in Pharma and Life Sciences
* Knowledge of integration technologies, APIs, microservices, containers, cloud security, and modern application architecture.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-10
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description: When you join VerizonYou want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.What You’ll Be Doing…As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists. Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives. Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems. Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments. Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders. Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka. Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle. Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies. Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation. Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain. Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.What We’re Looking For...You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…") Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience. Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments. One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows). Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks. Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design. Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality). Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka. Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics. Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing. Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders. Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…") Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments. Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression). Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure. Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems. Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications. Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.Where you’ll be workingIn this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.Scheduled Weekly Hours40Equal Employment OpportunityVerizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Application Program Lead, Enterprise AI
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
At
**Lam Research**
, the LIDAS (Lam India Data Analytics & Sciences) team partners with Global Operations to solve complex business challenges through advanced analytics, enterprise applications, automation, and AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will directly contribute to transforming business processes by designing and delivering scalable, intelligent applications that improve operational efficiency, accelerate decision-making, and support Lam's growth across semiconductor manufacturing and supply chain operations.
  
  
**The impact you’ll make**
As a Software Application Engineer at Lam, you’ll be at the forefront of driving innovation and adoption of our software products. You’ll support fast product evolution through agile processes by analyzing, designing, programming, testing, debugging, and enhancing software applications. With your expertise and initiative, you’ll turn ideas into great products that support advancements in Lam’s semiconductor technology.
  
  
In this role, you will have a significant impact on the innovation and efficiency of Lam's products and services. By developing enterprise grade software applications, you will enable data-driven decision making, optimize workflows, enhance user experience, and improve quality and performance of Lam's hardware and processes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and architect end-to-end enterprise application solutions integrating AI capabilities, enterprise systems, automation platforms, and diverse data sources including SQL Server, Lakehouse, Data Lake, and cloud platforms.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Define application architecture, system components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and technology frameworks to ensure performance, security, maintainability, and scalability.
* Lead proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to evaluate emerging technologies and validate solutions for complex business problems.
* Provide technical guidance to development teams, conduct design reviews, and promote engineering best practices, coding standards, and architecture governance.
* Drive the adoption of modern technologies including Generative AI, Copilot, OpenAI/GPT-based solutions, automation platforms, and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaborate with global cross-functional teams to deliver applications using Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering principles.
* Communicate technical decisions, solution trade-offs, and implementation roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* \*Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience in enterprise software application development, architecture, or solution delivery.
* 4+ years of experience leading large-scale application development programs or enterprise solution initiatives.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on expertise in one or more technologies such as .NET, Angular, Python, or similar enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience integrating applications, APIs, automation solutions, and enterprise data platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* \*Experience designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions leveraging Generative AI, OpenAI, GPT technologies, or enterprise AI platforms.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse architectures, Data Lakes, and modern analytics ecosystems.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git, and Jira.
* Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform, RPA platforms, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Experience supporting semiconductor, manufacturing, supply chain, operations, or quality business functions.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, security frameworks, OAuth, REST APIs, JSON, and modern architecture design principles

**Our commitment**
We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.
  
  
Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.
  
  
*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) IRC306872
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a high-caliber Principal / Lead Cloud AI Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern Enterprise AI paradigms. In this hybrid hands-on and customer-facing role, you will lead the architecture, design, and deployment of scalable microservices, distributed systems, and cutting-edge GenAI/Agentic solutions.
  
  
You will own the complete solution lifecycle—from direct client discovery and architectural design to hands-on implementation and production deployment—translating complex, ambiguous business problems into secure, high-performance Cloud AI systems.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Core Development Track (Python or Java)

Strong, hands-on enterprise-level expertise in EITHER Python OR Java (Tracks are evaluated separately; expertise in at least one is mandatory).
  
  
Proven track record building enterprise microservices, REST APIs, and distributed event-driven applications.
  
  
  

* Technical & Cloud Architecture

Deep technical knowledge of distributed system design, enterprise application integration, and relational/non-relational database technologies.
  
  
Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) core services: Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.
  
  
Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and enterprise CI/CD automation pipelines.
  
  
  

* GCP AI & Machine Learning Ecosystem

Hands-on proficiency in building and deploying models via Vertex AI and integrating foundation models via the Gemini API.
  
  
Demonstrated experience constructing end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and configuring Vertex AI Vector Search for embeddings and semantic search.
  
  
Practical experience designing agentic AI workflows and establishing automated evaluation metrics (“evals”) for enterprise AI applications.
  
  
  

* Client & Leadership Capabilities

Experience in customer-facing roles, driving technical discovery, solutioning, and executive-level technical discussions.
  
  
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills with a track record of optimizing application performance.
  
  
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical complexity and business strategy.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, Healthcare, Enterprise SaaS) with strict security and compliance considerations.
  
  
Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost-optimization strategies for large-scale GenAI workloads.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & System Design: Architect and implement resilient, scalable, and high-throughput enterprise systems and microservices using GCP-native cloud frameworks.
  
  
GenAI & Agentic Engineering: Build and deploy enterprise GenAI applications leveraging Vertex AI, Gemini API, Vertex AI Vector Search, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. Establish automated evaluation loops (“evals”) to measure model performance, drift, and accuracy.
  
  
Full-Lifecycle Engineering: Lead end-to-end delivery—including technical requirement gathering, architectural blueprints, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), production integration, deployment, and performance optimization.
  
  
Cloud & DevOps Orchestration: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and manage containerized microservices across Google Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery using Docker and Kubernetes.
  
  
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the technical authority in direct client engagements, translating business requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps and conducting technical deep dives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guide engineering teams through design and code reviews, mentor junior engineers, establish best practices, and drive technical excellence across cross-functional initiatives.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: SAP S4 BTP Architect
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description: SAP BTP Architect Lead, AI Architecture & Governance**
**3M Health Care is now Solventum**
**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**
**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
**SAP BTP Architect Lead – AI Architecture, Governance & Innovation**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP BTP Architect Lead**
to define and lead the enterprise AI architecture strategy within the SAP ecosystem. This role will be responsible for establishing the AI framework, governance model, architecture standards, and technology roadmap that enable scalable, secure, compliant, and business-driven AI solutions across the enterprise.
  
  
The ideal candidate will serve as the strategic bridge between Enterprise Architecture, SAP Platform Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, and Business Functions to ensure that AI capabilities are delivered responsibly while maximizing business value.
  
  
This leader will drive adoption of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Joule, Generative AI, AI Agents, Process Automation, Integration Suite, and Data & Analytics capabilities to accelerate business transformation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define and maintain the enterprise AI architecture roadmap for SAP BTP and adjacent platforms.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, and technology standards for AI-enabled business solutions.
* Lead architecture decisions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Datasphere, SAP Joule, SAP Build, SAP Integration Suite, and AI services.
* Develop enterprise standards for AI Agents, Intelligent Automation, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solutions.
* Partner with business leaders to identify strategic AI opportunities and prioritize high-value use cases.

**AI Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish and operationalize an enterprise AI governance framework.
* Define policies, standards, controls, and approval processes for AI initiatives.
* Ensure alignment with security, privacy, legal, regulatory, and ethical AI requirements.
* Chair or participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARB) and AI Governance Councils.
* Create governance processes for AI lifecycle management, model monitoring, risk management, and compliance reviews.

**SAP BTP Platform Leadership**

* Define target-state SAP BTP architecture and platform strategy.
* Establish standards for:

+ SAP Integration Suite
+ SAP Build Process Automation
+ SAP Build Apps
+ SAP Build Work Zone
+ SAP Datasphere
+ SAP AI Core and AI Foundation
+ SAP Joule and AI Agents
+ Event Mesh and API Management

* Drive platform scalability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence.

**Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture**

* Define integration standards between SAP and non-SAP platforms.
* Collaborate with Data & Analytics teams to establish trusted data foundations for AI.
* Ensure data governance, master data consistency, and data quality standards.
* Promote reusable enterprise services, APIs, and event-driven architecture principles.

**Innovation & AI Enablement**

* Evaluate emerging AI and SAP technologies.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and innovation initiatives.
* Develop enterprise AI adoption roadmaps and maturity models.
* Educate business and technology teams on AI capabilities and governance requirements.
* Drive AI literacy and responsible AI practices across the organization.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Provide technical leadership for SAP, hyperscaler, and implementation partners.
* Evaluate vendor offerings, AI platforms, and architecture proposals.
* Establish technology guardrails and architectural governance for third-party solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of enterprise architecture, SAP architecture, or technology leadership experience.
* 7+ years of experience in SAP platforms and enterprise application architecture.
* 5+ years of experience with cloud-based integration, automation, and platform technologies.
* Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-scale technology platforms.
* Strong understanding of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Intelligent Automation technologies.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, governance boards, and enterprise standards development.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with:

+ SAP BTP
+ SAP S/4HANA
+ SAP Joule
+ SAP AI Core
+ SAP AI Foundation
+ SAP Datasphere
+ SAP Build
+ SAP Integration Suite
+ Microsoft Azure AI Services
+ Microsoft Copilot ecosystem

* Knowledge of AI governance frameworks, NIST AI RMF, and Responsible AI principles.
* Experience establishing enterprise AI Centers of Excellence (CoE).
* SAP BTP Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or relevant cloud certifications.

**Key Competencies**
**Leadership**

* Executive communication and stakeholder management
* Strategic thinking and innovation leadership
* Cross-functional influence without authority
* Change leadership and organizational transformation

**Technical**

* Enterprise Architecture
* AI Architecture
* SAP BTP Architecture
* Integration Architecture
* Data Architecture
* Cloud Platforms
* Security by Design

**Governance**

* Responsible AI
* Risk Management
* Technology Standards
* Architecture Review Processes
* Compliance and Regulatory Alignment

**Success Measures (First 12-18 Months)**

* Establish enterprise AI governance framework and operating model.
* Publish SAP BTP and AI architecture standards and reference architectures.
* Enable priority AI use cases across ERP, Supply Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, and Enterprise Applications.
* Launch reusable AI and agentic AI patterns within SAP BTP.
* Improve governance compliance, architecture consistency, and platform adoption.
* Create a scalable AI innovation pipeline with measurable business value realization.

**Leadership Scope**

* Enterprise-wide AI Architecture and Governance
* SAP BTP Platform Strategy
* AI Innovation & Enablement
* Architecture Review Board Participation

**Location**
- Bangalore (Hybrid)
  
  
**Travel**
- upto 20%
  
  
**Supporting Your Well-being**

title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
description:
About the TeamThe team builds and operates technology that helps Walmart understand and improve its physical environments, modernize manufacturing, and support the assets that keep stores running. Its work spans digital representations and simulations of stores and supply chain facilities, IoT and automation in meat and dairy plants, and GNFR systems connecting stores, service technicians, and distribution centers.
  
  
What You Will DoOwn Business Outcomes and Engineering Strategy· Start with operational problems: Work directly with store, energy, real estate, manufacturing, and GNFR partners to understand user workflows, operational constraints, and business priorities. Translate these into product requirements and engineering commitments.
  
  

* Set direction and prioritize investment: Define a multi-year technology roadmap with product and business leaders. Balance new capabilities, modernization, technical debt, operational resilience, and cost; make investment tradeoffs explicit.
* Measure value after launch: Establish business, functional, and engineering baselines before delivery. Review adoption and realized benefits with operating teams, and use evidence to adjust priorities and solution design.

Business and Domain ResponsibilitiesDigital Twins and Energy and Asset Intelligence· Connect Walmart’s digital twins: Deliver a federated ecosystem connecting 13+ digital twins through a unified connective layer for shared simulation, standardized data, and cross-domain intelligence. Preserve domain ownership while enabling information to work across business boundaries.
  
  

* Create a consistent operational model: Standardize the enterprise ontology for associates, products, spaces, and equipment. Define shared identifiers, relationships, and data contracts that reduce silos and shorten use-case onboarding from months to weeks.
* Turn simulation into operating decisions: Scale simulation for HVAC, lighting, and refrigeration energy efficiency; emergency routing; predictive equipment maintenance; and hazard detection across stores and the supply chain. Partner with business owners to validate results and incorporate them into operational workflows.
* Lead the technical design: Own architecture decisions for 3D engine integration, core service databases, spatial and equipment data, alarms, and event processing. Establish data freshness, interoperability, and simulation validation practices so users can trust the results.
* Scale efficiently: Set baselines for simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity. Improve compute and storage efficiency while maintaining the performance required by each business use case.

Modern Manufacturing Engineering· Modernize meat and dairy operations: Direct the engineering strategy and technical roadmap for Walmart’s proprietary processing and manufacturing plants. Partner with plant leaders to prioritize operational needs and sequence delivery around production requirements.
  
  

* Connect operational data and workflows: Lead IoT and automation solutions that bring equipment and production information into usable engineering and business applications. Define integrations, data ownership, and exception handling across connected systems.
* Improve plant visibility and execution: Enable timely insight into equipment condition and operational exceptions. Work with manufacturing teams to reduce manual intervention and improve the reliability and efficiency of technology-supported production processes.
* Deliver safely into live operations: Coordinate testing, site readiness, deployment windows, training, and support with plant and operations partners. Validate changes against operational requirements and establish clear recovery and escalation procedures.

GNFR Supply Chain and Store Asset Support· Own GNFR warehouse technology: Lead engineering and technical operations for Warehouse Management Systems across the GNFR network, with accountability for dependable inventory and fulfillment workflows.
  
  

* Deliver OneAtlas facility rollouts: Lead technical rollout and integration across upcoming GNFR facilities. Own integration readiness, data migration validation, end-to-end testing, cutover, stabilization, and handoff to operational support.
* Support store asset maintenance: Enhance ordering, inventory tracking, and fulfillment of maintenance and replacement parts for commercial HVAC, refrigeration systems, fixtures, and other store assets. Improve visibility for stores and service technicians from request through fulfillment.
* Connect procurement and fulfillment: Modernize asset procurement, catalog management, inventory visibility, and order routing between stores, service technicians, and GNFR distribution centers. Address inconsistent data and workflow gaps that delay fulfillment or require manual coordination.

Technical and Operational LeadershipArchitecture and Technical Depth· Own application and integration design: Guide domain modeling, service boundaries, APIs, event contracts, workflow orchestration, and data architecture across the portfolio. Make deliberate choices on scale, decoupling, extensibility, and maintainability.
  
  

* Engage in the hardest engineering decisions: Work directly with architects and engineers on complex design and production problems. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and explain tradeoffs in business and technical terms.
* Modernize with continuity: Define incremental migration and integration strategies for existing business systems. Protect data integrity and operational continuity through compatibility planning, reconciliation, controlled rollout, and tested rollback or recovery paths.
* Govern data quality and access: Establish clear ownership, validation, lineage, and access controls for equipment, location, catalog, inventory, and operational event data. Partner with security and relevant business teams on privacy, security, and compliance requirements.

Engineering Excellence and Production Ownership· Own the full development lifecycle: Set expectations for design reviews, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness. Cover integration, performance, resilience, and critical business workflows in validation.
  
  

* Run reliable business services: Define service-level objectives and agreements that reflect operational criticality. Establish end-to-end observability across applications, integrations, and business flows, including detection of stalled or incomplete processing.
* Lead incident prevention and recovery: Build clear on-call ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and recovery procedures. Review incidents with business partners, address recurring causes, and test continuity and disaster recovery plans.
* Improve performance and unit economics: Use telemetry, profiling, and capacity analysis to improve latency, throughput, and resource utilization. Manage cloud, storage, and software costs against the business value and workload served.
* Eliminate operational toil: Automate repetitive support, data validation, deployment, and recovery tasks. Measure reductions in manual effort and failure rates while retaining appropriate controls for actions affecting live operations.

Organizational Leadership and Execution· Build and develop the organization: Design teams with clear ownership and appropriate spans and layers. Hire and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors across software, data, IoT, and systems engineering.
  
  

* Set a high performance standard: Run consistent goal setting, coaching, calibration, promotion, and performance management. Build succession plans and strengthen both technical and people leadership.
* Establish execution mechanisms: Translate strategy into OKRs, milestones, dependency plans, and regular business reviews. Surface risks early, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain clear accountability for commitments and benefits.
* Influence across functions: Align executive stakeholders in Supply Chain, Real Estate, Store Operations, Manufacturing, Product, and Global Technology. Communicate decisions, investment needs, progress, and risks clearly to technical and business audiences.
* Model Walmart values: Respect the Individual, Act with Integrity, Serve our Customers and Members, and Strive for Excellence. Create an inclusive environment where associates can challenge assumptions, learn, and take ownership.

What You Will BringMinimum Qualifications· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  

* 15+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, including at least 5 years leading large-scale, multi-team engineering organizations at Director level or above.
* A proven record of delivering enterprise business applications and distributed systems, with experience in data integration or federation and complex cross-system workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in supply chain technologies, specifically Warehouse Management Systems and enterprise asset management.
* Experience leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical contributors, including hiring, organization design, talent development, and performance management.
* Evidence of translating business problems into technical requirements and delivering measurable improvements in operational outcomes, service reliability, performance, or cost.
* Strong architecture and engineering judgment across APIs, event-driven systems, databases, integration patterns, and the full software development lifecycle.
* Experience owning production services and major modernization programs, managing cross-functional dependencies, and communicating with senior business and technology leaders.

Preferred Qualifications· Experience architecting or operationalizing virtual stores/DC/FCs, simulation engines, enterprise ontologies, or 3D and spatial data solutions.
  
  

* Experience with IoT, equipment telemetry, automation, or technology delivery in manufacturing or industrial environments, especially meat or dairy processing.
* Experience with energy management, predictive maintenance, refrigeration or HVAC systems, or technology supporting physical asset operations.
* Experience rolling out WMS, asset management, procurement, or related business applications across large distribution, manufacturing, or retail networks.
* Experience connecting enterprise applications with operational technology and managing site readiness, cutover, stabilization, and business adoption.
* Strong financial and technical governance acumen, including cloud infrastructure budgets, vendor decisions, performance contracts, and total cost of ownership.

How Success Will Be MeasuredAgree baselines and targets with business owners for the scope of each initiative. Evaluate both business impact and engineering health rather than delivery volume alone.
  
  

* Business results: Energy efficiency and asset reliability; manufacturing operational efficiency and manual effort; GNFR inventory accuracy, ordering and fulfillment cycle times, and facility rollout readiness.
* Digital Twin effectiveness: Use-case onboarding time, simulation adoption and validated usefulness, data freshness and quality, simulation latency, query throughput, and concurrent scenario capacity.
* Engineering and organizational health: Availability, incident impact and recovery time, change quality, delivery predictability, cost efficiency, operational toil, and development of engineering talent.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. title: Identity for AI Service Architect
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Must Have Skills**

* Identity and access management architecture at design depth (authentication, authorisation, federation, lifecycle, governance), applied to AI systems and agents
* Architected and productised identity services (reference architecture, platform evaluation and selection, service definition), not implementation only
* AI agent identity lifecycle registration with a human sponsor, declared scope, short-lived credential issuance, revocation; hands-on with at least one of Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Okta cross-app access, SailPoint Agent Identity Security, Cisco/Astrix
* AI access governance bringing models, agents and datasets under the same entitlement model and access certification as applications, through SailPoint ISC or Saviynt at registry and API level, and SCIM 2.0
* Delegated authorisation at protocol depth how a user's authority becomes an agent's authority via OAuth 2.1, token exchange (RFC 8693) and on-behalf-of flows, sender-constrained tokens (DPoP, mTLS), OIDC claims and audiences
* Built or integrated an authorisation system in production (policy engine, authorisation service or token-level IdP integration)
* Policy as code for agent scopes and tool permissions OPA/Rego or Cedar
* Model Context Protocol and agent frameworks where identity is asserted in a tool call, tool allow-listing, per-task isolation
* Prompt-time entitlement enforcement RAG architecture with retrieval scoped to the asker's identity entitlements (permission filtering at retrieval, index scoping per asker)
* AI gateway / prompt control layer deployment (Microsoft Purview, Zenity, Lasso or open-source) integrated with the identity provider for the asker's token and the entitlement model for their rights
* Microsoft Entra ID or Okta at token issuance, conditional access and session level, where an agent's delegated authority originates and is revoked
* Non-human identity governance and SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity as the source of agent credentials

**Good to have**

* Microsoft, Google, AWS and Anthropic agent and model platforms; sovereign model hosting (Mistral, Aleph Alpha)
* Telemetry modelling in an open schema (OCSF)
* EU AI Act human-oversight obligations; GDPR and works-council constraints on prompt inspection
* Awareness of AI security and MITRE ATLAS (prompt injection, model safety), which is adjacent to this role rather than part of it

Candidates will rarely tick every must-have, and that is expected. The ones that should not be waived are
  
  

* the service-architecture experience on all three
* SOC fluency for ITE
* key ceremony and PKI design depth for Machine Identity, and
* the protocol-level authorisation experience and IAM architecture depth for Identity for AI

**Work Location Bangalore & Mumbai**
Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
  
  
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
  
  
**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II - State Street Investment Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
State Street Investment Management’s Data, Analytics & AI Services (DAAIS) team is seeking an experienced hands-on architect, engineer for building the multi-cloud open architecture-based data platform that delivers trusted data products to the business functions. This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in large-scale data platform architecture, distributed computing, data pipeline engineering, and modern cloud architecture and operational experience.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Investment Management, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Data Platform Engineer, Vice President II, you will -
  
  

* Validate target data platform architectures and design principles through hands-on engineering, technical spikes, and POCs for a unified, cloud-native Lakehouse.
* Partner with architects to translate reference architectures and data strategies into working prototypes, measurable validation criteria, and production-ready implementation patterns.
* Optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using Python/Scala, SQL, Spark, and modern orchestration frameworks.
* Engineer high-performance Iceberg-based data models and tables, including partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, metadata management, and multi-engine interoperability.
* Establish data engineering standards for data quality, lineage, observability, reliability, versioning, and backward-compatible data product contracts.
* Optimize platform, pipeline, and query performance through workload testing, partitioning and clustering, caching, concurrency management, and cost-aware lifecycle practices.
* Lead capabilities from POC to production by defining non-functional requirements, resolving engineering risks, integrating with platform services, and enabling operational support and SLA readiness.
* Engineer AI-ready data products with trusted, well-governed, semantically enriched data, incorporating context engineering, ontologies, embeddings, vector indexing, and RAG patterns.
* Build and productionize data services for Agentic and AI workloads, including MCP-enabled access, interoperable APIs, LLM gateways, multi-model routing, caching, observability, security, and cost optimization.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to the L2/L3 support teams for legacy platform to ensure SLA adherence, escalation discipline, and timely closure of production issues impacting business, clients, or regulators.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services.
* Expert-level hands-on programming in Python and SQL, with Java or Scala as a plus, and proven ability to design, debug, test, and optimize distributed data-processing solutions.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization.
* Proven experience building and operating enterprise Lakehouse and data platforms using Snowflake and Databricks, supporting high-concurrency analytical, near-real-time, and AI-ready workloads.
* Strong cloud engineering experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including cloud-native data services, security, networking, infrastructure automation, portability, and cost management.
* Working expertise with open data architectures and metadata ecosystems, including Apache Iceberg, schema evolution, table optimization, catalog federation, zero-copy sharing, data virtualization, and multi-engine access.
* Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns
* Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation).
* Expertise in AI-assisted coding using GitHub Copilot or Claude Code Assistant.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Software Engineering Architect
description:
**Description**
About Us

, a leading global provider of cloud-based, integrated reconciliation and financial close solutions for Finance & Accounting departments, helps organizations automate and manage high-volume transaction matching, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany accounting, journal entries, close management tasks, governance, risk, and compliance. Trintech’s portfolio includes the Cadency Platform for large enterprises and the Adra Suite for mid-market organizations. Over 4,200 clients worldwide, including the majority of the Fortune 100, rely on Trintech’s solutions to optimize data, control risk, drive efficiencies, and provide strategic insights.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Architect, Software Engineering is a senior technical individual contributor responsible for defining, guiding, and governing software architecture for mission-critical enterprise SaaS products. This role partners with engineering, product, security, DevOps, QA, and architecture stakeholders to design scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions across Java, .NET, web, API, data, and cloud technologies. The architect will also promote AI-native software engineering practices, including responsible use of LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to improve design quality, developer productivity, code review, testing, documentation, and modernization efforts.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture Strategy and Governance
  
  

* Define and evolve solution architecture for enterprise SaaS applications, including cloud-hosted and hybrid deployment models.
* Provide architectural direction for product areas, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles, security standards, scalability needs, and long-term product strategy.
* Contribute to Architecture Review Board activities and help establish practical architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails.
* Make or recommend key technical decisions, including technology selection, integration patterns, modernization approach, and build-versus-buy options.

Solution Design and Technical Leadership
  
  

* Architect end-to-end solutions using technologies such as Java/J2EE, .NET, REST and SOAP APIs, Angular or React, microservices, relational databases, messaging, caching, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Engineering Excellence and Modernization

AI-Native Software Engineering

Collaboration and Influence
  
  

* Collaborate with product managers, engineering managers, senior engineers, QA, DevOps, security, and support teams to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.

* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.

* Deep understanding of multi-tier web application architecture, distributed systems, SaaS, PaaS, cloud-native architecture, and high-scale enterprise application design.
* Proficiency with Java/J2EE technologies such as Servlets, JSP, JMS, Spring, Hibernate, SOA, and web services.
* Experience with .NET technologies and ability to operate in a multi-technology product environment.
* Experience with middleware technologies such as messaging, caching, service orchestration, API gateways, and integration frameworks.
* Solid understanding of relational database concepts and hands-on experience with SQL Server, Oracle, or similar enterprise databases.

description:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers!!
  
  
**ROLE SUMMARY:**
FTSE Russell (LSEG) is building the real-time platform that powers global index calculation across equity, fixed income, and multi-asset markets.
  
  
We’re looking for a hands-on
**Senior Technical**
**Lead**
to help modernise and scale this platform — a cloud-native, low-latency system that operates at global scale and underpins critical investment products used worldwide.
  
  
This is an
**individual contributor leadership role**
. You’ll lead through architecture, engineering quality, and delivery — designing resilient, event-driven systems, shaping technical direction, and raising standards across the team.
  
  
You’ll work on systems where
**performance, data quality, and reliability are non-negotiable**
, while leveraging modern cloud (AWS) and AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate delivery without compromising control.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

* Design and build real-time, event-driven systems that calculate and distribute index data with low latency and high reliability.
* Own platform architecture and engineering quality, leading through hands-on delivery, code review, and clear technical direction.
* Scale and operate a cloud-native platform on AWS, ensuring resilience, observability, and performance under real market conditions.
* Define and evolve data models and pipelines for market and reference data, with strong focus on accuracy, auditability, and control.
* Drive engineering standards and modernisation, using AI-assisted tooling and automation to improve delivery speed without compromising quality.

**Tech Stack**

* Development: Java, C#,, Python, SQL, OpenAPI.
* Cloud: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, SNS, Aurora, and others as required).
* Databases: Sybase ASE, Sybase IQ, Aurora Postgres.
* IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab.
* AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience designing and building distributed, event-driven systems.
* Proven ability to own system design and architecture, balancing performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Hands-on experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Solid understanding of data modelling and relational databases in production systems.
* Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and modern CI/CD practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through engineering quality — code reviews, testing strategy, and raising technical standards.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working on low-latency or real-time systems.
* Exposure to financial services, market data, or index products.
* Practical use of AI-assisted development tooling to improve engineering productivity.

**How We Work**
The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Staff Cloud Security Architect will serve as a critical subject matter expert, responsible for defining, designing, and implementing secure cloud architectures and solutions across our enterprise environments. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams across Rubrik to integrate security across all aspects of cloud deployment, operations, and management. Your strategic insights will help shape cloud security strategies, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Your deep technical expertise, ability to influence, build and establish best practices, and thought leadership will ensure the secure enablement of our cloud technologies across our hybrid and public cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role, and you will be expected to rely on your extensive cloud expertise to make an immediate impact on existing and new initiatives.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Define and implement cloud security architecture frameworks, principles, and guidelines to secure enterprise cloud environments and workloads.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure security maturity initiatives are prioritized effectively and addressed in a timely and sustainable manner.
* Partner with cloud security architects, developers, and engineers to design scalable solutions addressing complex infrastructure-related security challenges.
* Design, build proof of concept, tools, and platforms to proactively address and resolve security issues at scale.
* Conduct architecture reviews, security assessments, threat modeling, and risk analysis of cloud-native services and infrastructure.
* Establish secure reference architectures, reusable cloud security patterns, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency in cloud deployments at scale.
* Lead efforts related to strategic planning and continuous improvement of cloud security capabilities, including public cloud native security products and third-party cloud security tools.
* Partner with incident response teams and SOC analysts to ensure effective processes and technology are in place to quickly detect, investigate, and mitigate cloud security incidents.

**Experience You'll Need**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related fields.
* 15+ Years of experience securing complex on-prem or cloud deployments with a minimum of 6+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security architecture and design, including significant experience across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure environments.
* Deep technical understanding of core cloud service models, including compute, network, and storage technologies on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure platforms.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Java for automating and managing security tools and processes.
* Extensive working experience with containerized applications (Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architectures.
* 5+ years of experience with IAC (Infrastructure as a Code) deployments for complex systems [Terraform, Ansible etc]
* Demonstrated expertise in articulating complex technical issues clearly to both security specialists and non-technical stakeholders.

**Additional Skills**

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives.
* Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and lead in fast-paced and dynamic technical environments.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
  
  
Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

title: The Core Engineering-Bengaluru-Vice President-Software Engineering
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
The Core Engineering
  
  
The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
  
  

* Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

****What We Do****
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital, and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
  
  
The Core is responsible for financial control and regulatory obligations of the firm. They safeguard the assets of the firm through an independent scrutiny of the financial information and ensure accurate reporting to internal and external consumers. They provide critical metrics and related analysis to the firm’s and divisions’ leadership to navigate the evolving business strategy, including incumbent and strategic initiatives. Controllers play an important role in the changing landscape of the firm, including its new business ventures and acquisitions, and ensure that these new initiatives are in line with the regulatory expectations as well as controlled in terms of their incorporation into the firm
  
  
Engineers in The Core help ensure the firm meets all of its financial control and reporting obligations. Working in small and nimble teams, we build critical and complex software to calculate P&L, measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory filings across the globe.
  
  
**Our Impact**
The Core Engineering is responsible for designing and implementing solutions to manage firm’s profit and loss (P&L), measure and monitor the firm’s capital, balance sheet and liquidity metrics, and regulatory obligations. Our global agile teams (based across Americas, EMEA & Asia) develop and manage the platforms, calculation engines, and analytical tools that controllers, risk management, and deal-making teams use to project, monitor and report externally to regulators for both regular business activity and under stress scenarios.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge software and platforms that form the core of our key business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and process billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. This position provides a unique opportunity to gain subject matter expertise in both technology and finance, and to directly engage with colleagues and senior management from across the business, risk, finance, and technology.
  
  
**Why join the team**

* Tool & Technologies: You’ll program in Java and model data using Pure/Legend – a data management and data governance open source platform that we will teach you. Other technologies in use in our space: RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, HTML 5, AngularJs/ReactJs, IntelliJ, Gitlab, Jira, AWS solutions, AI platforms, Java, Python, RESTful services, Maven/Gradle, Apache Spark, BigData, ReactJs/NextJs, IntelliJ/VSCode, Gitlab, Kubernates/Terraform.
* Cloud Technologies: You’ll be involved in building the next generation of finance systems onto the cloud platforms, one of the key strategy for the division to in which you’ll get exposure to technologies like AWS S3,Snowflake, EMR etc.
* Autonomy: You’ll have significant autonomy in designing and writing solutions to help our stakeholders deliver for the firm’s clients.
* Creativity: You’ll be encouraged to suggest improvements to products and to propose ways, in which we can add value for our stakeholders.
* Interpersonal Communication: You’ll engage with data producers and consumers across all areas of the business to understand their requirements and to propose solutions tailored to their needs.
* Training: Your manager will support your professional development, allowing you time for training at work, helping you learn and grow within the organization, and providing opportunities for increasing responsibility.

****Responsibilities****

* In an Agile environment manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis to coding, testing, UAT, implementation and maintenance
* Develop high level/detailed technical designs, testing strategies, and implementation plans
* Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance
* Understand and respond to business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation
* Build strong relationships with business partners
* Identify opportunities for cross-divisional collaboration and reuse of common solutions
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI-powered automations, prompt engineering concepts.

****Skills & Experience We Are Looking For****

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
* Hands-on software development experience preferably in Java, C/C++, Python, or Scala, exposure to RDBMS and NoSQL datastores
* Strong programming and problem-solving skills
* A clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design and core programming concepts
* Strong full-stack technical design and development skills and experience
* Comfortable with multi-tasking, managing multiple stakeholders and working as part of a team
* Excellent communication skills including experience speaking to technical & business audiences and working globally
* Interest in finance

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
  
  
Please note that our firm has adopted a COVID-19 vaccination requirement for employees who work onsite at any of our U.S. locations to safeguard the health and well-being of all our employees and others who enter our U.S. offices. description:
