Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. * Knowledge of the memory system, caching, interconnects, DRAM controller, Memory management unit, performance modeling and analysis.

Think of this role as being the CTO’s technical right hand.

You’ll work closely with the CTO across engineering initiatives, new product ideas, architecture, AI experimentation, internal tooling, and strategic technical projects.

You’ll also act as a trusted liaison between the CTO and engineering teams, product stakeholders, technology partners, and external collaborators.

But here’s the important part: This is a hands-on engineering role, not a project management or coordination role.

We want someone who can write code, build prototypes, investigate problems, understand complex systems, challenge technical decisions, and independently take projects from an idea to a working solution.

One day you could be building an AI agent. The next, exploring a new backend architecture, debugging an integration, or representing the CTO in a technical discussion.

You’ll be involved in both the thinking and the doing.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Build, Code & Experiment**

\* Write production-quality code and build working prototypes.

\* Personally own and deliver engineering projects from concept to deployment.

\* Build internal tools, developer utilities, automations, and AI-powered workflows.

\* Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and emerging technologies.

\* Work across APIs, backend systems, integrations, SDKs, and occasionally frontend applications.

\* Debug complex technical problems, investigate issues, and propose practical solutions.

\* Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and experimentation.

**2. Work Directly with the CTO**

\* Be deeply involved in the CTO’s ongoing technical initiatives and special projects.

\* Translate early-stage ideas and loosely defined problems into working solutions.

\* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making.

\* Research new tools, frameworks, and technologies, and make informed recommendations.

\* Understand the broader engineering vision and help translate it into tangible outcomes.

\* Take ownership of initiatives without requiring constant direction or follow-ups.

**3. Act as a Technical Liaison**

\* Represent the CTO in selected engineering discussions, technical reviews, and partner conversations.

\* Work closely with engineering leads, product teams, and external stakeholders.

\* Bridge communication between the CTO and various engineering initiatives.

\* Understand technical blockers, dependencies, and implementation challenges.

\* Ensure important technical decisions translate into actual engineering progress.

\* Coordinate execution when needed, while remaining actively involved in the technical work.

**4. Drive Special Engineering Projects**

\* Take on experimental or high-impact initiatives that don’t naturally belong to an existing engineering team.

\* Build proof-of-concepts to validate new product ideas and technical approaches.

\* Explore platform improvements, architectural changes, performance optimization, and developer productivity.

\* Collaborate with different engineering pods to move initiatives forward.

\* Help evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and third-party technologies.

\* Take promising prototypes through technical validation and handover or production deployment.

**5. Explore What’s Next**

\* Stay ahead of developments in AI engineering, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software architecture.

\* Experiment with emerging technologies before they become mainstream.

\* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, automate work, and improve engineering velocity.

\* Bring fresh ideas to the CTO, backed by actual experimentation rather than presentations alone.

\* Help shape how OnArrival uses AI internally and builds AI-native travel experiences.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Technical Skills**

\* 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

\* Strong programming ability in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, such as Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, Python, or Go.

\* Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and modern backend architectures.

\* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

\* Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, debugging, deployment, and engineering workflows.

\* Familiarity with LLMs, AI development tools, and modern AI-assisted software engineering.

\* Ability to independently build, test, deploy, and demonstrate working solutions.

\* Broad technical curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar stacks quickly.

**Beyond Engineering**

\* Exceptional ownership: You don’t wait to be told every step. You figure things out and get them done.

\* Strong communication: You can explain complex technical ideas clearly to engineers, business stakeholders, and external partners.

\* High agency: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and making progress independently.

\* Structured thinking: You can break complex, loosely defined problems into manageable solutions.

\* Confidence: You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions, and engaging with senior technical stakeholders.

\* Resourcefulness: You know when to build, when to automate, when to use AI, and when an existing tool is sufficient.

\* Discretion and reliability: You can be trusted with sensitive technical discussions, strategic initiatives, and responsibilities.

**Bonus Points If You**

\* Have worked in an early-stage or rapidly scaling technology startup.

\* Have been a founding engineer or independently built and launched products.

\* Have experience with AI agents, MCP, developer tooling, or LLM-powered applications.

\* Understand travel technology, fintech, APIs, or embedded platforms.

\* Have worked closely with founders, CTOs, or senior engineering leaders.

\* Enjoy hackathons, side projects, open-source contributions, and experimentation.

\* Are comfortable interacting with partners, vendors, and developer communities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Within your first 3–6 months, we expect you to:**

\* Independently ship meaningful engineering projects and working prototypes.

\* Develop a strong understanding of OnArrival’s technology stack and engineering priorities.

\* Become a trusted technical extension of the CTO.

\* Take ownership of special projects with minimal supervision.

\* Build strong working relationships with engineering leads and product teams.

\* Help accelerate technical decisions, experimentation, and execution.

\* Free up the CTO’s bandwidth without introducing unnecessary coordination overhead.

**What This Role Is Not**

\* Not an executive assistant.

\* Not a traditional project manager or scrum master.

\* Not a role focused primarily on tracking tasks, preparing reports, or scheduling meetings.

\* Not a strategy-only position where engineering is delegated to other teams.

\* Not a role where you’ll spend all your time in meetings.

You’ll be expected to write code, solve technical problems, and ship actual software.

**Why Join?**

\* Direct founder exposure: Work alongside the CTO on some of the company’s most important technology initiatives.

\* Real engineering ownership: Build, experiment, architect, and ship without unnecessary layers.

\* Technical breadth: Work across AI, APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms.

\* Freedom to experiment: Explore new technologies and turn ideas into working products.

\* High-impact work: Your contributions can directly influence OnArrival’s architecture, engineering productivity, and future products.

\* Accelerated growth: Develop the technical, product, and leadership judgment required to become an exceptional engineering leader.

**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**

* You’re probably the person who builds things over the weekend because you’re curious.
* You enjoy coding, but you’re equally interested in understanding why something should be built.
* You can jump from a technical architecture discussion to writing an API, then explain the solution to a stakeholder without losing context.
* You don’t need perfectly written requirements to get started. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, and build something.
* You like being close to decisions, taking responsibility, and making things happen.

If you’re someone who loves engineering, enjoys working with founders, and wants to be involved in building what’s next, this role is for you.

**Join us in building the infrastructure for the future of travel.**

title: CPU Verification Infrastructure Tools Architect
description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
* You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 5+ years of experience
* Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python.
* Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
* Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
* Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i.e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC.
* A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
* Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.

**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
* Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
* Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**

**AgentOps Team**

**Why Join AgentOps?**

You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

title: Power Apps Tech Lead
description:
**Power Apps Tech Lead— Canvas Apps, Power Automate & Dataverse**
**Location**
Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience**
7–12 years in application development, with strong hands-on experience building intuitive Power Apps canvas apps, designing scalable Power Automate workflows, and implementing Dataverse solutions including the security model — plus working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities into Power Platform solutions
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is seeking a Power Apps Tech Lead to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. This is a hands-on build role for someone who takes a business process and turns it into a canvas app people find easy and fast to use, backed by a properly designed Dataverse model and automation that holds up in production.
  
  
You will own features end to end — data model, app, automation, integration and security — on delivery teams alongside architects, business analysts and client stakeholders. We also expect you to bring AI into the solution where it earns its place: embedding Copilot and agent capabilities in canvas apps and the wider Power Platform estate, rather than treating AI as a separate project.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build intuitive, user-friendly Power Apps canvas apps — screen and navigation design, responsive layouts, reusable components, delegation-aware data access and performance tuning.
* Turn business requirements and user journeys into working applications, taking ownership of usability and of how the app performs with real data volumes.
* Design and implement scalable Power Automate workflows — cloud flows, child flows, error handling and retry patterns, approvals, scheduled and event-driven processing, and concurrency and throughput considerations.
* Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Design and implement the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security — and validate that users see only what they should.
* Integrate AI agents and Copilot capabilities into canvas apps and related Power Platform solutions, including Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder models and prompt-based actions, with attention to grounding, accuracy and appropriate use.
* Integrate solutions with external systems and Microsoft 365 services using standard and custom connectors, Power Automate and APIs.
* Apply Power Platform ALM properly — solutions, managed and unmanaged layers, environment variables, connection references, and deployment through pipelines or Azure DevOps.
* Troubleshoot, tune and resolve defects across apps, flows and Dataverse, including performance and delegation issues.
* Follow Power Platform governance, licensing, data loss prevention and security best practice, and design within the client’s environment strategy.
* Produce technical documentation, solution designs and handover material, and support testing, UAT, deployment and release activities.
* Work with business stakeholders, architects and developers to shape practical solutions, and guide junior developers on the team.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7–12 years of overall application development experience, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Strong hands-on experience building Power Apps canvas apps that users find intuitive — component reuse, responsive design, Power Fx, collections and variables, delegation and performance optimisation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing scalable Power Automate workflows, including error handling, child flows, approvals and long-running or high-volume patterns.
* Proven Dataverse implementation experience: tables, columns and relationships, alternate keys, calculated and rollup fields, and business rules.
* Practical command of the Dataverse security model — security roles, teams, business units, and row-level and column-level security — and the ability to design it for a real organizational structure.
* Working knowledge of integrating AI agents and Copilot capabilities with canvas apps and Power Platform solutions (Copilot Studio, AI Builder or equivalent).
* Experience integrating with external systems and Microsoft 365 services through standard and custom connectors and APIs.
* Understanding of Power Platform ALM — solutions, environment variables, connection references and automated deployment.
* Awareness of Power Platform governance, licensing implications and DLP policies.
* Ability to debug and performance-tune apps and flows, and to resolve defects through to closure.
* Good client-facing communication — running requirement discussions and demos, and explaining design decisions clearly.

**Qualifications**
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience with model-driven apps, Power Pages or Power BI alongside canvas apps.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About the Company**

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers.

**The Problem**

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck.

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from.

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job.

**What You Will Build**

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences.

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely.

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many.

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

**Who You Are**

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones.

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is.

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them.

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there.

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work.

**Strong Signals**

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit.

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned.

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

**What It Is Honestly Like**

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front.

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something.

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information.

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job.

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

title: Staff Engineer ( Java )
description:
Job ID: R-2026-27-Q01-0011

Department: ETPL AI

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

**About ETPL**

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description:
**About The Role**
AI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.
* Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.
* Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.
* Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.
* Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.
* Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.
* Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.
* Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.
* Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.
* Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.
* Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.
* Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.
* Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).
* Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
* Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.
* Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).
* Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).
* Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).
* Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**
*We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.*

* LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).
* RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).
* ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.
* Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).
* Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.
* APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.
* Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.
* Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.
* Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.
* Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.

**How We Work**
You are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

title: Tech Lead

What You Bring:

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks
  
  
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**

title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description:
Bangalore or Hyderabad, India
  
  
Artificial intelligence is reshaping the re/insurance industry — and at Swiss Re, we're not just watching it happen. We're architecting it. If you're a seasoned Enterprise Architect with a passion for AI and a talent for turning complex strategy into scalable, production-ready reality, this is your opportunity to leave a lasting mark on one of the world's most innovative financial institutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Enterprise Architect within Swiss Re's Group Enterprise Architecture function, you will be at the heart of the company's AI transformation. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad enterprise exposure — working at the intersection of business ambition and technology delivery. Depending on your experience and business priorities, you may focus on
**Architecture Delivery**
(shaping and driving strategic AI initiatives end-to-end) or
**Enablement & Governance**
(building the enterprise capabilities, standards, and guardrails that allow AI to scale safely and consistently) — or contribute across both. Either way, you'll be a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and a key voice in shaping Swiss Re's AI architecture landscape globally.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Strategy, Use Cases & Target Architecture**

* Lead engagement with business areas and Domains on AI initiatives, shaping use cases, transformation roadmaps, target architectures, blueprints, and transition plans
* Contribute to Swiss Re's AI Strategy, ensuring architecture supports and accelerates the company's broader ambitions
* Design end-to-end AI solution architectures spanning business, application, data, model, integration, security, evaluation, observability, and production deployment dimensions
* Translate business strategy into coherent AI architectures, ensuring alignment between capabilities, application landscapes, data models, technology platforms, and operating models
* Drive standardization, simplification, and reuse, including rigorous assessment of build-versus-buy, model, and platform options across value, risk, scalability, performance, resilience, and total cost of ownership

**Enterprise Architecture Delivery & Production Readiness**

* Act as lead Enterprise Architect on selected large, complex programs (including AI) and take full architecture accountability for outcomes
* Provide architecture guidance from strategy and concept through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and operational ownership
* Ensure solution designs align with approved target architectures, AI standards, principles, reference architectures, and enterprise guardrails
* Challenge design decisions to protect architectural integrity, measurable business value, and sustainable delivery
* Support program and project leadership in managing architecture risks, dependencies, trade-offs, integration, resilience, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Maintain accurate enterprise inventories and governance records by contributing and validating information on delivered AI solutions

**Architecture Enablement, Standards & Reference Architectures**

* Provide leadership for enterprise AI architecture enablement, delivering intelligence and guidance to delivery teams, Domains, and architecture stakeholders
* Identify and act on enterprise patterns, gaps, risks, and opportunities across use cases and delivered solutions
* Define, own, and evolve AI standards, principles, reusable patterns, reference architectures, methods, and pragmatic guardrails
* Set direction for clear, actionable guidance that enables teams to make consistent, safe, and scalable architecture decisions
* Identify and promote reuse opportunities across Domains, leveraging AI inventory, GEAR, and enterprise intelligence

**Enterprise Architecture Governance, Inventory & Portfolio Insight**

* Lead and shape AI architecture governance and Design Authority, including review criteria, review gates, quality assurance, and compliance mechanisms
* Ensure AI solutions address Responsible AI, privacy, security, model risk, human oversight, auditability, regulatory, and enterprise risk considerations
* Promote consistent AI evaluation approaches covering quality, grounding, hallucination risk, robustness, latency, security, and cost
* Govern and evolve the AI inventory, using it to generate architecture insights, identify patterns and gaps, and support transparent decisions
* Provide portfolio-level insight and recommendations on deployed AI assets, reuse opportunities, architecture risks, standards adoption, and enterprise-wide implications

**Cross-Domain Collaboration & Influence**

* Collaborate closely with Domain Architects, business stakeholders, technology teams, risk and control partners, and other architecture disciplines to achieve enterprise alignment
* Resolve cross-domain dependencies and conflicts, balancing enterprise consistency with pragmatic Domain needs
* Champion a one-architecture mindset and contribute to the architecture community through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and coaching
* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on investment decisions and transformation roadmaps
* Deliver executive-ready, fact-based insights and recommendations that drive informed decisions

**About The Team**
The Group Enterprise Architecture team at Swiss Re is a globally connected community of architects operating at the forefront of the company's most strategic and complex transformation initiatives. The team plays a pivotal role in shaping how Swiss Re harnesses technology — including AI — to create sustainable business value, drive innovation, and manage enterprise risk responsibly.
  
  
Organized across two complementary functions —
**Delivery**
and
**Enablement & Governance**
— the team works in close partnership with business Domains, technology functions, and senior leadership to define target architectures, set enterprise standards, and ensure that solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with Swiss Re's long-term direction. Together, the team fosters a culture of architectural excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, with a strong commitment to responsible and inclusive innovation at enterprise scale.
  
  
**About You**
You are a strategic thinker and a pragmatic doer — someone who can hold the long view on enterprise architecture while rolling up your sleeves to guide complex delivery. You bring intellectual curiosity, strong systems thinking, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence. You communicate with clarity and conviction, whether you're advising a C-suite stakeholder or mentoring a fellow architect. You thrive in collaborative, matrixed environments and take genuine pride in raising the quality of architecture across the teams you work with.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, technology architecture, or transformation roles within complex, matrixed, or global organizations, with a proven track record of leading cross-domain initiatives
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI solutions beyond prompt-only agents, including practical knowledge of AI/GenAI architecture patterns such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agents and tool use, model selection, prompt and model lifecycle management, and AI evaluation
* Deep expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and design authority processes, including standards, principles, reference architectures, and operating models, with demonstrated experience influencing enterprise-level decisions at senior stakeholder level
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, AI security and privacy patterns, observability, model monitoring, and Responsible AI controls, with the ability to evaluate AI technology choices across quality, risk, scalability, latency, resilience, reuse, and cost
* Proven ability to use architecture inventories, repositories, and portfolio information to identify patterns, gaps, reuse opportunities, and governance insights, and to translate these into clear, actionable recommendations

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience in re/insurance or financial services environments
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
* Relevant AI, cloud, data, security, or architecture certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CDMP)
* Experience working in globally distributed, multicultural teams across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to AI in financial services
* Demonstrated experience mentoring architects and building architecture capability within a community of practice
* Strong facilitation skills, with experience leading design authority forums, architecture reviews, and governance boards

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: System on a Chip Architect
description:
**Wireless Communications Chip Architct and System Architect**

**About The Company**

**www.omnidesigntech.com**

**Omni Design is a leading provider of high-performance, ultra-low power IP solutions across advanced CMOS nodes, enabling differentiated SoC architectures for 5G, optical networks, LiDAR, radar, automotive networking, AI acceleration, imaging, and related high-growth markets. We partner with market leaders globally and are scaling rapidly. We are seeking senior technical leadership talent to define and guide the next generation of adaptive, multi-antenna wireless platforms.**

**Job Description**

**We are seeking a Principal / Lead Wireless Communications System Architect to own the definition and architectural direction of complex wireless and multi-antenna system platforms. This individual will serve as the primary technical interface with customer system teams, lead system modeling and performance analysis, drive architectural decisions across mixed-signal and digital subsystems, and define system-level specifications that translate into silicon implementations.**

**This is a senior leadership role with substantial influence across product definition, roadmap direction, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of communications theory, system decomposition across analog/digital boundaries, quantization/error propagation, MIMO signal processing architectures, and end-to-end error budgeting strategies in SDR-based environments.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership and Direction: Define system architecture for next-generation multi-antenna and SDR-based communication platforms, influencing product strategy and long-term roadmap planning.**

**Customer Technical Ownership: Lead technical engagement with strategic customers, representing system trade-offs, negotiating performance specifications, and aligning joint integration plans.**

**End-to-End System Modeling: Architect and maintain MATLAB and analytical models capturing the full signal chain, including channel modeling, quantization noise allocation, SNR budgeting, interplay of RF non-linearities, and DSP algorithm design constraints.**

**Block-Level Specification Ownership: Generate precise block-level specifications for digital baseband, calibration engines, channel processing, mixed-signal converters, and RF interfacing elements; ensure internal teams understand the architectural rationale behind these specifications.**

**Cross-Domain Integration: Drive alignment between digital architecture, signal processing algorithms, mixed-signal circuit selections, ADC/DAC dynamic range decisions, LO/subsystem noise considerations, and thermal/power constraints.**

**System Verification Alignment: Collaborate with validation and silicon bring-up teams to ensure post-silicon results trace back to modeled assumptions; define measurement-level KPIs and debug methodologies when deviations arise.**

**Mentorship & Team Development: Provide architectural guidance to system engineers, signal processing developers, and hardware design teams; develop reusable models, internal best practices, and system-level methodologies.**

**Thought Leadership: Participate in internal architecture reviews, contribute to core IP innovation strategy, and represent the company in technical engagements, standards-relevant discussions, and key customer milestones.**

**Qualifications**

**Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or related field; PhD strongly preferred.**

**15+years of experience in wireless communications system architecture for advanced SDR systems.**

**Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end communication signal chains, including cascaded error budgeting, quantization trade-offs, and performance modeling across RF, ADC/DAC, and DSP blocks.**

**Deep Expertise In**

**MIMO and multi-user spatial processing architectures,**

**Channel estimation,**

**SNR/phase-noise budgets and their mapping into mixed-signal design requirements**

**System-level modeling using MATLAB or Python,**

**Ability to articulate complex system decisions to both internal engineering teams and senior-level customers.**

**Proven leadership in defining specifications consumed by RTL design, mixed-signal design, verification, and system validation teams.**

**Strong customer communication skills and comfort presenting architectural trade-offs to VP- and CTO-level stakeholders.**

**Uday**

**Mulya Technologies**

title: Solution Architecture Manager
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
  
  
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
  
  
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
  
  
Architecture Design and Deployment
  
  
Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
  
  
Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
  
  
Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end-to-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
  
  
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
  
  
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
  
  
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.
  
  
Practice Development
  
  
Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Anticipates and addresses organization- and industry-wide gaps, patterns, and needs to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Leads and contributes to internal/external communities.
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Develops a deep network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers at high-impact customers/partners to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. Provides guidance to others in doing so. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
  
  
Coaches team to use evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Leverages network and industry experience to connect customers/partners with ideas, people, and resources to support their success. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.
  
  
Drives awareness across all levels of the organization of partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy. Holds team accountable for leading the adoption of Microsoft technologies.
  
  
Thought Leadership
  
  
Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team at the corporate level. Holds teams across all organizational levels accountable for sharing insights with virtual team members, including C-level leaders, to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.
  
  
Initiates and drives external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons). Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Serves as an industry-leading expert and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences and publishing white papers around key technical topics and/or architecture design templates.
  
  
**Other**
Embody our culture and values

Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security))
  
  
OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 10+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
  
  
OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

**About The Role**
We are seeking an accomplished
**Networking Architect**
with extensive expertise in Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) to design, architect, and lead the implementation of modern, intent-based access network solutions across enterprise environments. This strategic role is critical for transforming our campus and branch network infrastructure, enabling zero-trust security, network segmentation, and operational simplicity. The successful candidate will develop enterprise-wide SDA strategies, architect complex multi-site deployments, drive technical innovation, mentor senior engineers, and serve as the principal subject matter expert in SDA technologies and architectural best practices
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Architecture & Design

+ Develop comprehensive enterprise SDA architecture strategies aligned with business objectives, security requirements, and organizational growth
+ Design end-to-end Software-Defined Access solutions spanning campus, branch, and remote access environments
+ Architect multi-site SDA fabrics incorporating fabric edge, fabric core, and border nodes
+ Design network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies using SDA's policy-based approach
+ Create detailed architectural documentation, design specifications, and reference architectures
+ Conduct feasibility studies and provide recommendations for network modernization initiatives
+ Develop network migration strategies and roadmaps for legacy infrastructure to SDA
+ Design solutions supporting diverse environments (wired, wireless, branch, IoT, guest)

* SDA Implementation Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale SDA deployments across multiple sites
+ Architect Catalyst Center integration with SDA fabric management and provisioning
+ Design fabric topology including fabric edge, fabric core, border nodes, and control plane nodes
+ Architect IP address management (IPAM) and DHCP strategies for SDA environments
+ Design and implement SDA policy frameworks and scalable group tags (SGTs)
+ Lead integration of wireless networks (Catalyst 9000 series) with SDA fabric
+ Architect branch connectivity using SD-WAN integration with SDA
+ Design and implement SDA for IoT, guest, and BYOD access scenarios

* Zero-Trust Security Architecture

+ Architect comprehensive zero-trust security frameworks leveraging SDA capabilities
+ Design identity-based and device-based access policies using Cisco ISE integration
+ Architect microsegmentation strategies using Scalable Group Tags (SGTs) and Security Group ACLs (SGACLs)
+ Design threat-centric access control policies based on user, device, and application context
+ Architect integration with Cisco Secure Network Analytics (Stealthwatch) for threat detection
+ Design encryption and authentication strategies for SDA environments
+ Develop compliance frameworks aligned with industry standards (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, etc.)
+ Design audit and logging architectures for compliance and forensic analysis

* Network Segmentation & Policy Architecture

+ Design scalable network segmentation using Scalable Group Tags (SGTs)
+ Architect Security Group ACLs (SGACLs) for granular access control
+ Design policy-based access control frameworks translating business requirements into network policies
+ Architect VN (Virtual Network) designs for multi-tenancy and organizational separation
+ Design and implement advanced policy features including contract-based policies
+ Architect policy analytics and visibility for compliance and security monitoring
+ Design policy governance and change management processes

* Catalyst Center & Automation Architecture

+ Architect Catalyst Center integration with SDA fabric management and provisioning
+ Design network automation and orchestration strategies leveraging Catalyst Center APIs
+ Develop Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) strategies for SDA configuration management
+ Design REST API integration strategies with third-party applications and orchestration platforms
+ Architect monitoring, assurance, and analytics policies using Catalyst Center capabilities
+ Design and implement advanced automation workflows for SDA operations
+ Architect integration with ITSM and IPAM platforms

* Wireless & Access Architecture

+ Design enterprise wireless architectures integrated with SDA fabric
+ Architect Catalyst 9000 series access points and controllers for SDA environments
+ Design wireless segmentation and policy enforcement strategies
+ Architect guest access, BYOD, and IoT connectivity within SDA framework
+ Design roaming and mobility strategies for wireless devices
+ Architect wireless security policies and encryption strategies
+ Design wireless assurance and performance monitoring

* Branch & Remote Access Architecture

+ Design SD-WAN integration with SDA for branch connectivity
+ Architect branch fabric edge nodes and connectivity strategies
+ Design secure remote access solutions (VPN, zero-trust remote access)
+ Architect branch segmentation and policy enforcement
+ Design failover and redundancy strategies for branch connectivity
+ Architect branch assurance and performance monitoring
+ Design solutions for remote workers and distributed workforces

* Data Center & Cloud Integration

+ Design SDA solutions for data center and cloud integration scenarios
+ Architect connectivity between SDA fabric and data center networks (ACI, traditional)
+ Design hybrid cloud networking strategies leveraging SDA
+ Architect cloud-based identity and access management integration
+ Design solutions supporting containerized environments and Kubernetes
+ Architect multi-cloud connectivity and policy enforcement

* Leadership & Strategic Influence

+ Mentor senior network engineers and architects on SDA best practices and advanced concepts
+ Lead architectural review boards and design governance processes
+ Contribute to industry thought leadership through presentations, whitepapers, and technical publications
+ Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies
+ Establish network architecture standards and best practices across the organization
+ Participate in vendor relationships and influence product roadmap discussions
+ Drive continuous improvement and innovation in network architecture practices
+ Build and maintain relationships with Cisco technical teams and partners

* Stakeholder Management & Communication

+ Present architectural recommendations and technical findings to executive leadership
+ Translate business requirements and security mandates into technical architecture
+ Collaborate with security, infrastructure, application, and cloud teams
+ Manage architectural reviews and provide technical guidance on design decisions
+ Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
+ Participate in strategic planning and IT governance processes
+ Conduct training and knowledge transfer sessions on SDA technologies

* Be AmbITious: This opportunity is not just about what you do today but also about where you can go tomorrow. When you bring your hunger, heart, and harmony to Insight, your potential will be met with continuous opportunities to upskill, earn promotions, and elevate your career.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* Experience:

+ Minimum 12+ years of enterprise network architecture and engineering experience
+ Minimum 7+ years of hands-on Cisco SDA design, implementation, and administration
+ Minimum 5+ years of experience with Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) and intent-based networking
+ Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying large-scale, multi-site SDA fabrics
+ Proven track record of leading complex network transformation and modernization projects
+ Experience designing enterprise campus and branch network architectures
+ Demonstrated expertise in network security architecture and microsegmentation
+ Experience with zero-trust security architecture design

* Certifications:

+ Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) Routing & Switching or Enterprise Infrastructure
+ Cisco Certified Specialist - Enterprise Network Core (CCNP Enterprise) or equivalent
+ Cisco Certified Specialist - SDA (CCNA Security or CCNP Security with SDA focus)
