title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
to work directly with frontier AI labs to solve their most complex engineering challenges.
  
  
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments—from understanding technical requirements to architecting, building, and scaling production systems that improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack, partnering closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in both India and the US to deliver solutions for our most strategic customers.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep software engineering with customer partnership, helping shape how Handshake AI delivers solutions to the world's leading AI labs.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Partner directly with frontier AI labs to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems
* Own technical architecture for customer deployments with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on solutions based on customer feedback
* Build reusable tools, frameworks, and deployment patterns that improve delivery across customer engagements
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Help establish a strong engineering culture as we continue building our India engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Experience leading technically complex customer-facing, solutions engineering, or forward deployed engineering projects
* Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures
* Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), system design, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to solve complex engineering problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered products, LLM infrastructure, or machine learning platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers or strategic technical partners
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience supporting applied AI or ML research teams
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Technical solutions become reusable across multiple customer engagements
* Deployments are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Customer feedback directly informs platform improvements and future product capabilities
* You become a trusted technical partner across customers and engineering teams in both India and the US

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

* Use feedback from delivery teams and clients to continuously improve solution design, standards, and assumptions

title: Java Technical Architect
description:
**About the Role**

* We are hiring for a Principal Architect to define and govern the application and service architecture of a mature Java enterprise platform being modernized toward Spring Boot services and Angular. The role works across all pods and is a peer to the Principal Engineer for Data and Platform Architecture.
* You will define the target architecture, establish decision guardrails, and prove critical patterns with reference implementations. You will not act as a central approval queue. Engineering Leads retain pod delivery ownership, while you guide decisions that affect multiple domains, shared contracts, or the long-term platform shape.

**What You Will Own**

* Define the target application, service, API, integration, security, and deployment architecture.
* Establish incremental migration patterns from Java EE, Wildfly, and JSF to Spring Boot and Angular.
* Create reference implementations and architecture decision records for high-impact patterns.
* Review cross-domain and irreversible design decisions with Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers.
* Define standards for service boundaries, API contracts, resilience, observability, and backward compatibility.
* Partner with the Data and Platform Principal on data ownership, migration sequencing, and shared platform concerns.
* Maintain a pragmatic technical debt and decommissioning strategy for the existing platform.

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years of software engineering and 4+ years in architecture roles on enterprise platforms.
* Deep Java and Spring Boot architecture experience, including REST services and distributed-system patterns.
* Strong understanding of Java EE application servers, Hibernate or JPA, and incremental modernization.
* Working knowledge of modern Angular architecture and frontend-backend contract design.
* Experience with containers, CI/CD, security, observability, and production reliability.
* Ability to communicate architecture through code, diagrams, decision records, and direct coaching.

**What Sets You Apart**

* You have led the architecture of a live Java EE to Spring Boot modernization without a big-bang rewrite.
* Your standards are specific enough to guide teams and flexible enough to handle real product constraints.
* You influence senior engineers through technical credibility rather than organizational authority.

**Success in This Role**

* Pods make consistent architecture decisions without waiting for routine approvals.
* Modernization reduces coupling and operational risk in measurable increments.
* Cross-pod designs have clear ownership, documented trade-offs, and working reference patterns.

**About The Role And Team**
Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Staff Backend Engineer, you will lead the architecture and implementation of next-generation distributed systems that power the bedrock of Uber. This is a high-stakes, high-impact role where you'll tackle some of the most complex infrastructure challenges in the industry: building sub-50ms latency systems that handle 1M+ requests per second, and designing resilient platforms that power tens of billions of dollars in global marketplace transactions across 70+ countries.
  
  
This isn't just about writing code; it's about setting the technical direction for an entire organization in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment. You will need to move the needle for the business by building systems that are not only highly available and reliable but also developer-friendly, enabling rapid innovation across ML and Product teams. If you think in systems, stay calm under the pressure of global scale, and are motivated by the "messy" reality of solving hard problems-this is where you'll grow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead the design and implementation of highly available, resilient, and cost-efficient distributed systems that serve millions of users with strict sub-50ms latency requirements.
* Architect systems capable of handling 1M+ requests per second while maintaining 99.99% availability and strong consistency guarantees for critical financial and pricing flows.
* Drive technical strategy for platform evolution, microservices architecture, and API design to simplify integration for new lines of business and third-party partners.
* Build platform abstractions and developer tools that hide massive underlying complexity, enabling ML and product teams to iterate rapidly on core algorithms.
* Spearhead architectural transitions toward "Dual-rail" resiliency, ensuring every mission-critical payment or pricing flow has redundant processing options to maximize reliability.
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Ops at the Director and VP levels to translate commercial requirements into scalable, hardened platform solutions.
* Own technical excellence by driving architecture reviews, identifying and reducing systemic technical debt, and raising the bar for observability and incident response across the organization.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional experience in backend development and building world-class distributed systems in large-scale production environments.
* Proven ability to solve strategically important problems by leading organization-wide development and adoption of key frameworks and coding best practices.
* Experience foreseeing architectural problems or opportunities a year in advance and working with leadership to address them before they impact the business.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale engineering projects through all lifecycle stages, from inception and requirement gathering to global productionization.
* Expertise in defining standards for testing, monitoring, and alerting systems, while overseeing the execution of complex incident management at an organizational level.
* Proven experience in identifying architectural gaps and creating org-wide frameworks that improve developer velocity and reduce systemic technical debt.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a technical brand ambassador, serving as a representative for the organization to the broader internal and external technical community.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Principal Architect, Data Architecture & Design
description:
**Principal Architect, Data Architecture and Design**
The Principal Technical Architect provides technical leadership for complex data and analytics solutions across multiple programs and business domains. This role is responsible for translating business strategy into scalable, secure, and maintainable technology solutions while partnering closely with engineering, product, governance, and business teams. The architect combines strong solution design expertise with practical technical depth to ensure architecture standards, patterns, and best practices are successfully implemented in delivery.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Define and drive solution architecture strategies, standards, and reference patterns for enterprise Data & Analytics initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader technology and business objectives.
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions, producing architecture blueprints, technical designs, integration frameworks, and data models that accelerate delivery and adoption.
* Establish reusable architecture patterns and reference implementations for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption to improve consistency, reduce technical debt, and enhance engineering productivity.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into practical technical roadmaps, solution designs, and phased implementation plans.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches, providing expert recommendations that drive innovation and long-term business value.
* Conduct architecture, design, and technical quality reviews to ensure solutions meet enterprise requirements for scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate with Data Governance and Security teams to embed data privacy, compliance, access controls, and risk management principles into solution architectures.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and technology evaluations for advanced analytics, cloud platforms, AI-driven capabilities, and next-generation data architectures to determine business and technical fit.
* Provide hands-on leadership in resolving complex technical challenges related to performance, integration, scalability, reliability, and operational support across enterprise platforms.
* Mentor engineers and architects, champion architectural best practices, and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across the organization.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; Cloud Architecture (Azure, AWS, GCP) and TOGAF certifications are highly desirable.
* 10-14 years of experience in Data Engineering, Solution Architecture, or Technical Architecture roles, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale, enterprise data and analytics platforms.
* Deep expertise in modern cloud data ecosystems, including Azure, Databricks, Lakehouse architectures, and enterprise-scale data platforms, with the ability to guide teams through complex technical challenges.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL, Python, data modeling, ETL/ELT, CDC, dimensional modeling, and scalable data architecture patterns, with a focus on performance, resilience, and maintainability.
* Experience integrating complex enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, Salesforce, or similar ERP platforms, spanning commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and operational data domains.
* Demonstrated ability to design governed, consumption-ready data products with robust data quality, lineage, security, semantic modeling, and analytics capabilities.
* Strong understanding of API-driven, event-based, and cloud-native architectures, including DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and modern engineering practices.
* Proven ability to influence architectural decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and build consensus across engineering, product, governance, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

You will define and drive the application architecture for our platform — designing scalable, resilient systems in .NET and Angular/React — while embedding quality engineering into every architectural decision. You'll champion AI-powered development practices across the entire SDLC, set the technical vision for quality at the architecture level, and mentor engineering teams on building software that is correct by construction, not just tested after the fact. We're looking for someone who sees quality not as a phase but as an architectural property, who leads through technical excellence, and who thrives at the intersection of product engineering, quality engineering, and AI-driven innovation.

* Education: BE, B. Tech, M. Tech Only

* Strong architecture documentation skills — ADRs, system design documents, sequence diagrams, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Proven ability to mentor and lead engineers across multiple teams; strong track record of raising the technical and quality bar.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own and evolve the application architecture for full-stack systems built on .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular/React, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality by design.

* Mentor and coach senior and mid-level engineers on architecture principles, quality engineering practices, AI tool adoption, and full-stack development excellence.

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI
description:
**Job Description**
A.P. Moller - Maersk is an integrated container logistics company and member of the A.P. Moller Group. Connecting and simplifying trade to help our customers grow and thrive. With a dedicated team of over 80,000, operating in 130 countries; we go all the way to enable global trade for a growing world. We leverage cutting-edge technology to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth. We are seeking a Lead Engineer - Data & AI to join our team and play a pivotal role.
  
  
**About The Role**
Maersk moves a significant share of the world's containerized trade and is a major player in the logistics and services space. The data is large, complex and consequential. This role offers real architectural ownership of a platform that matters, with the freedom to build it yourself, within a team that treats AI tooling as a serious part of engineering practice.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who designs and builds the most critical parts of our systems. You will partner in setting the architecture for our data and AI platform, decide how the major pieces fit together, and then write and deploy the code that proves the design works. Design documents and diagrams are part of the job, but they are the beginning of the work rather than the output. The engineers who do well in this role are the ones whose designs are trusted because they have shipped the hard parts themselves.
  
  
The scope spans the full stack of a data and AI platform: storage and table formats, pipelines, services, applications, and the agentic systems built on top. You will make the calls on open standards and interoperability, on build against buy, and on how we sequence a migration without disrupting what is already running. You will also set how this organization uses agentic coding, which at this level means building the tooling and the standards that other engineers work within.
  
  
The role carries no direct reports. Influence comes from the quality of your designs, the code you ship, and the engineers who get better by working alongside you.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture for major platform components and data products, from storage layer through to the application and agent layer.
* Define target architectures and the migration paths to reach them, with attention to open standards, interoperability and long-term flexibility.
* Write and deploy production code. You will personally build the difficult components and the reference implementations others extend.
* Make build against buy decisions with clear reasoning on cost, operational load and dependency risk.
* Design the platform foundations that other teams rely on: data contracts, lineage, schema evolution, access control and cost management.
* Set the agentic engineering practice across the group, including internal tooling, MCP servers, reusable skills, evaluation harnesses and the standards for reviewing generated code.
* Take on the technical problems that are genuinely hard or genuinely ambiguous, and bring them to a working resolution.
* Raise the engineering bar through design review, code review and mentoring.
* Partner with Product, Business stakeholders and Engineering Managers on sequencing, trade-offs and technical risk.

**Core Skills:**

* Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL.
* AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data
* Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making
* Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models.
* Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments.

**Required skills:**
**Architecture and system design**

* Has designed and delivered systems that multiple teams build on, and has lived with the consequences of those decisions.
* Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals, including partitioning, consistency models, delivery guarantees, backpressure and schema evolution.
* Designs for the non-functional requirements from the start: reliability, recovery, latency, cost, security and operability.
* Has migrated live systems to a new architecture while keeping them running.
* Writes design documents that another engineer can build from without further explanation.

**Data engineering**

* Platform-level design of table formats and catalogs, covering Iceberg, Delta Lake or Hudi, along with partitioning, clustering, compaction and file layout strategy.
* Both batch and streaming architectures, including change data capture and event-driven ingestion.
* Transformation frameworks at scale, such as dbt, together with semantic layer design.
* Data modelling depth sufficient to set standards that other teams follow.
* Performance and cost tuning at platform level, including query engines, storage layout and compute sizing.
* Multi-tenant governance, data quality frameworks and lineage.

**Software engineering**

* Deep expertise in at least one language and working fluency in others.
* Service and API design, including versioning, backwards compatibility and contract management across teams.
* Observability as a design concern: instrumentation, tracing, structured logging and meaningful alerting.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or equivalent, and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Security practice covering authentication, authorisation, secrets management and data protection.
* Front-end capability sufficient to build a usable interface when a product needs one.

**AI and agentic engineering**

* Expert-level use of agentic coding tools. You work through agents for a large share of your output and can explain your harness, your context strategy, how you run work in parallel and how you keep quality high.
* Has built tooling that extends what agents can do, such as MCP servers, custom skills, spec-driven workflows or evaluation harnesses.
* Has taken large language model systems to production, covering retrieval design, structured output, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, and human review where it belongs.
* Clear judgement on where a model belongs in a system and where deterministic code is the better answer.
* Sets the standard for how generated code is reviewed and how agentic work is verified.

**Open source**

* Meaningful exposure to open source, whether through contributions to established projects, maintaining a project with real users, or substantial public work of your own.
* Familiarity with the open standards in this space and a considered view on interoperability.
* Public artefacts such as repositories, technical writing or conference talks are a strong signal.

We would be interested to understand from you genuine depth in a minimum two or three of above areas and strong working command across the rest.
  
  
**What makes you a strong candidate?**
Demonstrated work carries the most weight in this role. The strongest candidates can point to systems they designed and built that are running in production, and can explain the decisions behind them, including the ones they would make differently now.
  
  
Additional indicators of a strong fit:
  
  

* A track record as a Staff, Principal or Lead engineer who remained hands-on, or as an architect who still writes and deploys code.
* Experience being the technical anchor on a platform or product that other teams depended on.
* A public body of work: an active GitHub profile with substantial projects, open source contributions, technical writing or talks.
* Has introduced a significant technical change into an organisation and carried it through to adoption.
* Comfort moving between architectural thinking and detailed implementation within the same week.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.
* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.
* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.
* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.
* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.
* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.
* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.
* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.
* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.
* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).
* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.
* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.
* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.
* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.
* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.
* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.
* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

title: Software Development Engineer 5
description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
**Position Summary**
As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.
  
  
Is this role for you?
  
  

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

**Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus)**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years, SOC transformation
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) Security Services is a global team of elite security practitioners, architects, and trusted advisors who help our largest enterprise and service provider customers defend against sophisticated threats, achieve operational cyber resilience, and accelerate digital transformation. As part of our specialized Security Operations Center (SOC) Transformation & Advanced Analytics practice, you will work alongside top-tier consulting engineers, automation developers, and solution architects to design and deliver next-generation SOC architectures, SIEM modernization, behavioral analytics, and end-to-end security automation.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Security Consulting Architect for SOC Transformation & Splunk, you will be the chief technical authority and visionary guiding our enterprise customers through complex SOC modernization journeys. You will translate customer business outcomes, risk profiles, and operational strategies into scalable, high-fidelity security architectures powered by Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), Splunk SOAR, User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), Cribl Stream, and modern object storage (MinIO).
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will engage with customer CISOs, SOC Directors, and Enterprise Architects to define target operating models and modernization roadmaps, while also leading implementation pods, troubleshooting deep technical roadblocks, optimizing search pipelines, and setting the engineering standards for multi-terabyte security analytics.
  
  

* Target SOC Architecture & Transformation Strategy: Lead the architectural design, Target Operating Model (TOM), and delivery strategy for multi-tier enterprise SOCs, SIEM modernizations, and security automation frameworks aligned with MITRE ATT&CK and Cisco Validated Designs.
* Splunk Cloud & Enterprise Security (ES) Mastery: Architect enterprise-scale Splunk Cloud deployments; design Risk-Based Alerting (RBA) frameworks, Data Model Acceleration (DMA) strategies, optimized | tstats search pipelines, Asset & Identity (A&I) contextual enrichment, and ESCU detection updates to eliminate alert fatigue.
* Modern Telemetry Ingestion & Storage Architecture: Architect high-throughput, resilient security data collection pipelines leveraging Cribl Stream for edge transformation, filtering, and routing, combined with MinIO / S3-compatible object storage for high-performance SmartStore tiering and compliance data archiving.
* Security Automation & SOAR Engineering: Define incident triage and response workflows, designing modular, production-grade Python playbooks in Splunk SOAR for automated threat enrichment (Talos, VirusTotal), endpoint containment (EDR isolation), firewall mitigation, and bidirectional ITSM (ServiceNow) synchronization.
* Technical Pod Leadership & Governance: Provide technical direction, architectural governance, and mentorship to specialized engineering execution pods (Data Ingestion/GDI, Detection Engineering, UEBA, SOAR); serve as the hands-on escalation authority for complex SPL optimization, CIM normalization, and API integrations.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical cybersecurity engineering and architecture experience designing and deploying enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) environments and SIEM/SOAR platforms.
* 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on architecture and engineering experience with Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Cloud, and Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), including correlation search engineering, Data Model Acceleration, and Risk-Based Alerting (RBA).
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in security telemetry pipeline engineering, including log routing and normalization with Cribl Stream, data parsing (props.conf / transforms.conf), and object storage/SmartStore tiering with MinIO or S3-compatible cloud storage.
* 3+ years of security orchestration and automation experience designing and building automated response playbooks using Splunk SOAR (Phantom), REST APIs, and Python
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical industry engineering experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Splunk & Pipeline Certifications: Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, Splunk SOAR Certified Automation Developer, or Cribl Certified Observability Engineer (CCOE).
* Industry Security Credentials: CISSP, CCIE Security, CISM, or GIAC certifications (GCIH, GCIA, GDSA, GMON).
* Advanced Behavioral Analytics & Threat Modeling: Practical experience deploying Splunk UEBA, implementing machine learning models for anomaly detection, and conducting atomic detection testing against the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.
* Executive Advisory & Technical Consulting: Exceptional C-suite consulting, presentation, and technical leadership skills with a proven track record of advising CISOs, leading technical workshops, and driving organizational change.
* Hybrid Cloud & Multi-Vendor Ecosystem Integration: Deep knowledge of multi-cloud security logging, Next-Gen Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco Secure Firewall), EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender), and Cisco Security Cloud integrations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

description:

maintaining top-tier security. That’s where Omnissa comes in.

adapts to the way people work, delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth—and this is just the beginning of our journey!

**Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency,**
and

—all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team.
  
  
As a global private company with over 4,000 employees, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**What is the opportunity?**
Join the
**Omnissa Horizon**
platform team and play a key role in shaping the future of digital workspaces. Our team is responsible for building, deploying, and managing the AWS-based Workspace ONE Intelligence cloud service. With a focus on transforming how customers engage with digital workspaces, we leverage analytics, machine learning, and AI to deliver innovative solutions that drive critical decision-making, enhance end user experience, ensure security, and automate IT processes and remediation. We are passionate about rapidly developing high-quality software and applying automation and software engineering best practices to everything we do. We work with the latest AWS technologies and open-source components.
  
  
We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next-generation capabilities within the
**Omnissa Horizon**
platform, including AI-powered user experiences, intelligent operations, and automation services. * Drive improvements in DevOps, Agile, and CI/CD processes that enable the team to work more efficiently.

* Support the team's on-call responsibilities and look for opportunities to make it more efficient.
* Train and mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and direction.
* Own engineering initiatives and champion a culture of high ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

* Proficiency in Java and the Spring Framework.
* Experience with microservice architectures and high-performance, high-scale systems.
* Experience with cloud services, preferably AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, Redshift, RDS, and more).
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, technical leadership, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and improvement.
* Proficiency in DevOps, Agile, and CI/CD processes.
* Familiarity with development tools such as Git, Jira, and Jenkins.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Location Type:**
HYBRID / ONSITE
  
  
**What is the leadership like for this role?**
**What is the structure and culture of the team like?**
This role will be reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, Engineering. Our team’s focus is on challenging the status quo by innovating but at the same time getting stuff done. We believe in building trust amongst all our stakeholders and committing to make our customers successful.

title: Staff Software Infrastructure Test Architect
description:
**About us:**

  

Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.

  
  

**Role Overview:**

  

You will drive the architecture and development of software infrastructure used for testing LiDAR firmware, perception software and associated artifacts. You will also drive strategic technology management and future software solutions architecture that meets automotive compliance requirements.

**What you'll do**
  

  
* Architect, design, and develop a robust and scalable Python based test automation framework for performing fully automated tests for embedded devices and providing traceable matrix for requirements to test-case to defect tracking. Develop automation features that allow end-to-end test coverage for all software and system components
  
* Mentor a team of skilled engineers dedicated to developing test cases, following standard coding practices. Drive code reviews to ensure consistent coding standards across all team members
  
* Develop, implement, and optimize test strategies and plans for automotive software, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing
  
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Firmware, digital signal processing algorithms, and Quality Assurance) to define test requirements and review product specifications
  
* Collaborating with the product owners, architects and other stakeholders to understand the business requirements and plan the quality assurance strategies accordingly
  
  

  
**What you'll have**
  

  
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
  
* 8 - 12 years of experience in software testing of embedded devices, preferably in the automotive industry
  
* Expert proficiency in Python and C++ programming and relevant libraries/frameworks for test automation
  
* Prior experience architecting test frameworks
  
* Proficiency in test-case development with docker/Kubernetes
  
* Practical knowledge of verification and validation means using testbeds and simulators as well as experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) and software in the loop (SIL) test environments
  
* Knowledge of Embedded device testing, REST APIs, UI testing, Selenium/Playwright, Embedded Linux, Docker, SSH, Shell scripting, Linux services, Computer networks
  
* Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices using Jenkins, Jira, Bitbucket, Agile methodologies, following sprint cycle for test-case development, system and integration testing
  
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and break down into simple sprint stories
  
* You have a problem-solving mindset and, able to mentor and guide juniors in solving daily development challenges
  
* Proven ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
  
  

  
**What's in it for you**
  

  
* Knowledge of automotive testing standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE, etc
  
* Understanding of automotive software systems, including embedded systems, ADAS, infotainment, or electric vehicle control software
  
* Experience with JAMA for requirements management software (or equivalent)
  
* Experience with JIRA for defect tracking and familiar with Agile methodologies

description:

The Automation Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the design, development, and deployment of next-generation AI-enabled solutions that transform how business processes operate across GSC. The role combines expertise in Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, and Process Transformation to create scalable, intelligent, and autonomous business capabilities.
  
  
The role serves as a technical leader, solution architect, and innovation catalyst, partnering with business stakeholders, Product Owners, technology teams and SMEs to translate business challenges into AI-powered enterprise solutions. The position is expected to lead complex automation and AI initiatives while mentoring teams and establishing best practices for enterprise AI adoption.

**AI & Intelligent Automation Strategy**

* Drive adoption of AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities across business processes.
* Identify opportunities to transform manual and rule-based activities into intelligent autonomous workflows.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend enterprise adoption strategies.
* Contribute to the AI and automation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases and business transformation opportunities.

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect enterprise-grade automation and AI solutions using Power Platform, Python, Azure AI Services, Copilot Studio, OpenAI, and related technologies.
* Design scalable AI architectures including RAG, multi-agent systems, autonomous AI workflows, intelligent document processing, conversational AI, and process intelligence solutions.

* Establish coding standards, AI development standards, reusable frameworks, and quality engineering practices.

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, and Technology Teams

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.

* 7+ years of experience delivering AI, ML, GenAI, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale automation and AI initiatives.
* Experience working with global stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and business transformation programs.

title: Solution Architect - Network Performance
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Join our dynamic team at Ericsson as a Solution Architect. In this pivotal role, we want tech enthusiasts who are genuinely passionate about delivering cutting-edge solutions to global customers. If you're detail-oriented, thrive in fast-paced environments, and love putting customers first—this could be your next move. Soft skills matter just as much as technical chops here. You'll collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the organization, so being a strong communicator and team player is key.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
As an Packet Core Performance Consultant, you'll dive deep into customer challenges and ambitions, leverage your expertise in Ericsson's portfolio (and third-party products), and craft end-to-end strategies that optimize network performance and customer experience.
  
  
**Your mission:**
Deliver innovative, cost-effective solutions that create real business value. You'll need to adapt quickly to change and show leadership across both Ericsson and customer teams.
  
  
**The Impact:**
You'll be at the center of major network transformation projects for Ericsson's biggest customers. This means collaborating closely with Product Units, Customer teams, Technical groups, and Marketing/Business Development.
  
  
You'll design and deploy solutions that enhance network capacity, functionality, and end-user services—working across IMS and Packet Core portfolios with a focus on leading the charge into 5G Core and in the E2E chain.
  
  
**Why This Role Rocks:**

* Work on next-gen 5G technology and beyond
* Global customer exposure
* Drive real transformation project
* Shape innovative solutions from the ground up

**Join our Team**
****What will you bring:****
**People & Communication**

* Customer relationship pro who can build trust and drive conversations
* Craft and deliver compelling technical presentations and proposals
* Strong consultative mindset—you see the forest and the trees
* Bridge the gap between engineers, developers, and sales teams

**Mindset & Approach**

* Innovative, creative spirit with a healthy appetite for risk-taking
* Strategic thinker who can pivot to tactical execution when needed
* Thrive under pressure and tight deadlines
* Open to traveling (25%+)

**Technical Chops**

* Solid experience delivering end-to-end solutions in domains like Packet Core, TCP Optimization and Routing.
* Expert-level knowledge in some of the following Core Network Functions: AMF, SMF, MME, SGW/PGW-C/U, UPF, DNS
* Deep understanding of 4G/5G mobile networks, E2E optimization, and network design
* Strong grasp of 3GPP standards—and how to apply them in real-world implementations

**Networking & Protocols**

* Signaling-Plane and User-Plane analysis (familiar with major monitoring systems and Wireshark)
* TCP/QUIC protocol knowledge
* Routing and switching expertise

**Data & Analysis**

* Data analytics skills: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Parquet, etc), MySQL, Excel, Tableau
* Comfortable translating data into actionable insights

**Collaboration & Growth**

* Work closely with R&D—provide feedback and spark new ideas
* Stay current on emerging tech and share knowledge to build customer competence
* Active participant in knowledge transfer and documentation

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience defining new business models
* Design Thinking knowledge and rapid prototyping experience
* Hands-on experience building cloud infrastructure and NFV (Network Function Virtualization)
* 5+ years in technology leadership roles
* Background in system testing & troubleshooting
* Knowledge Cloud & Virtualization,
* Knowledge of virtualization techniques
* Routing and Switching Certifications (Ericsson or Cisco)
* AI/ML & Automation: Familiarity with AIOps, machine learning for network optimization, and intelligent automation tools
* Python/Scripting: Programming skills for automation and data analysis
* Cloud-Native Expertise: Experience with multi-cloud environments, microservices, and cloud-native network functions (CNF)
* Emerging Tech: Knowledge of network slicing, edge computing, and intent-based networking
* Security Forward: Understanding of Zero Trust architectures and modern security frameworks
* Continuous Learner: Demonstrated ability to quickly adopt new technologies and methodologies

title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
Sr Staff Solutions Architect (Design Partner Program)
  
  
The Challenge
  
  
We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our R&D Customer Engineering organisation and partner with strategic Design Partner customers. This is a highly customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, product strategy, and enterprise governance.
  
  
You will work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, regulatory considerations, and strategic objectives. Acting as the bridge between customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you will help shape product direction, influence roadmap investments, and design scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role means helping customers operationalise trust, governance, privacy, risk management, consent, and responsible data use while accelerating adoption, improving implementation outcomes, and driving long-term platform value.
  
  
**Your Mission**

* Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and strategic priorities.
* Lead discovery workshops, architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technical design sessions.
* Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures, implementation strategies, and reusable design patterns.
* Bridge customer requirements with Product Management and Engineering teams by identifying product gaps, influencing roadmap priorities, and driving platform improvements.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise solutions across workflows, integrations, APIs, data models, governance processes, and operational architectures.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through successful adoption, implementation quality, operational efficiency, governance maturity, and long-term platform value.
* Create reference architectures, best practices, implementation standards, and reusable solution patterns that improve customer success and scalability.

**You Are**

* A customer-facing technical leader who operates at the intersection of solution architecture, business strategy, and enterprise technology.
* Comfortable engaging with executives, architects, engineers, product leaders, privacy, risk, compliance, security, governance, identity, marketing, and business stakeholders.
* Able to translate complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.
* A systems thinker who designs for scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, and long-term platform success.
* Influential without direct authority and effective at driving alignment across cross-functional teams.

**Your Experience Includes**

* 10+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Technical Product Leadership, Customer Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles within enterprise SaaS organisations.
* Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers to gather requirements, lead discovery, shape technical strategy, design solutions, and drive adoption.
* Strong solution architecture experience, including APIs, integrations, workflow design, data models, enterprise platforms, governance controls, security, and scalable implementation patterns.
* Experience partnering with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence product direction and solve complex customer challenges.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Experience designing reusable frameworks, reference architectures, implementation patterns, best practices, and solution standards.

Domain Experience
  
  
Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
**Privacy, Risk & Governance, Compliance, Security Governance, Data Governance, Consent & Preference Management, Identity, MarTech, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or related enterprise SaaS domains.**
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Senior Technical Architect
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Senior Technical Architect on our Advanced Services team, you will bridge pre-sales strategy and post-sales delivery to architect enterprise data migration, disaster recovery, and hybrid-cloud storage solutions. In this dual consultative and hands-on role, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, and enterprise customers to translate complex business needs into resilient, automated IT infrastructure. You will drive revenue growth and project success by serving as the trusted technical authority across high-impact data center transformations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Architect & Scope High-Impact Solutions: Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and customer leadership to evaluate complex enterprise environments, design high-availability storage architectures (replication, clustering, cloud integration), and scope Professional Services engagements that drive sales conversion and solution adoption.
* Lead Enterprise Data Migrations & Implementations: Own end-to-end technical execution of complex data center consolidations and block/file migrations using specialized appliances (e.g., Cirrus Data) and native toolsets, ensuring seamless cutovers with zero data loss and minimal operational disruption.
* Automate & Modernize Storage Operations: Develop custom scripts (Python, PowerShell, Shell) and integration workflows to automate replication, disaster recovery, and cloud-bursting processes within client environments, drastically reducing delivery timelines and human error.
* Direct Consultative Project Delivery & Risk Management: Deliver post-sales technical engagements as a lead subject matter expert, managing technical scope changes, mitigating delivery risks, and ensuring projects complete on time and within budget to maximize customer ROI and satisfaction.

**What You Bring**

* Storage Architecture & Disaster Recovery Expertise: Mastery of enterprise storage infrastructure (SAN, NAS, block, file), high-availability clustering, replication technologies, and disaster recovery/business continuity framework design.
* Data Migration & Toolsets Mastery: Deep hands-on experience executing large-scale data center migrations using appliance-based tools (e.g., Cirrus Data) and host-level migration utilities across multi-vendor OS environments (Linux, UNIX, Windows).
* Automation & Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Demonstrated skill in authoring automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Shell) to integrate storage environments, automate migrations, and orchestrate hybrid-cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, VMware).
* Consultative & Technical Leadership: Strong pre-sales and post-sales advisory capabilities, with proven ability to manage project scope, mitigate delivery risks, and effectively articulate complex technical solutions to enterprise stakeholders.
* We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Pure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

**What You Can Expect From Us**

* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
  
  
**Accommodations And Accessibility**
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
  
  
**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
  
  
Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
  
  
**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Guidewire Architect- Intergration
description:
**Summary**
Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to deliver complex cloud implementations that reduce effort, accelerate time‑to‑value, and unlock measurable business outcomes through our InsuranceSuite platform and AI‑enabled services.
  
  
We work as one global team, combining deep insurance domain expertise, modern delivery methods, and a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and curiosity in how we serve customers.
  
  
As a Guidewire Integration Architect, you will lead end‑to‑end solution architecture across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter for strategic customer programs, primarily on Guidewire Cloud. You will shape technical direction, mentor delivery teams, and embed automation and AI‑powered methods to cut implementation effort and time while ensuring scalable, maintainable, and upgrade‑ready solutions.
  
  
This role sits at the heart of Guidewire’s mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business by making cloud and AI adoption faster, safer, and more valuable.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**
Serve as the lead architect for complex InsuranceSuite implementations, defining target architectures and integration patterns across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter, and surrounding systems.
  
  
Translate business and product requirements into cloud‑ready, scalable, and upgrade‑safe solution designs, balancing configuration, integration, and extension options on Guidewire Cloud.
  
  
Provide design authority on programs (including SI‑led deliveries), ensuring alignment to Guidewire best practices, reference architectures, and Professional Services priorities to reduce implementation effort and time and improve delivery quality.
  
  
Partner with customer architects, product teams, and delivery leads to embed AI‑ and automation‑enabled methods, accelerators, and repeatable offerings throughout the implementation lifecycle, improving productivity and time‑to‑value.
  
  
Review and govern critical design decisions, code approaches, performance considerations, and data models to ensure quality, resilience, security, and operational efficiency in production.
  
  
Mentor and coach consultants and engineers on InsuranceSuite architecture, cloud patterns, and modern engineering practices, helping build AI‑enabled delivery capability across Professional Services.
  
  
Contribute to the evolution of standard assets, templates, and methodologies that can be reused across customers to scale services‑led innovation, support revenue growth, and improve margins.
  
  
At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data‑driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.
  
  
**Required**
**What you’ll bring**
Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data‑driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Extensive hands‑on experience architecting and delivering Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and/or ClaimCenter solutions, ideally including cloud implementations and large‑scale transformations.
  
  
Strong background in enterprise application architecture, integration patterns (REST APIs, messaging, batch), and secure, scalable design in a SaaS or cloud environment.
  
  
Ability to lead technical direction on large, multi‑stakeholder programs, influencing decisions through clear reasoning, structured trade‑offs, and collaborative problem solving.
  
  
Proficiency in core technologies used with InsuranceSuite (e.g., Java, Gosu, relational databases, integration middleware) and familiarity with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
Proven track record of mentoring and upskilling engineers or consultants, with an emphasis on quality, automation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to convey complex technical concepts in accessible language to technical and non‑technical audiences.
  
  
**Preferred**
10+ years of overall software/solution architecture experience, including significant time on Guidewire implementations; prior experience in a consulting or Professional Services context is a plus.
  
  
Experience applying AI‑ or automation‑based accelerators (e.g., code generation, intelligent testing tools, migration scripts) within delivery projects to reduce effort and improve reliability.
  
  
Knowledge of P&C insurance domains (policy administration, billing, claims) and related industry standards or regulatory environments.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you will immerse yourself in Guidewire’s architecture patterns, Professional Services delivery methodology, and AI‑enabled services strategy, then take ownership of solution architecture for one or more strategic customer programs in the region.
  
  
You will define target architectures, guide critical design decisions, and help teams adopt repeatable patterns that reduce implementation effort by up to 50% and time by 30%, directly supporting cloud adoption and measurable customer value for insurers.
  
  
As you grow in the role, your work will influence how insurers modernize their core platforms, how our partners deliver implementations, and how Guidewire advances its wider mission to transform P&C insurance through trusted cloud and AI‑powered platforms.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
  
Flexible work environment.
  
  
Health and wellness benefits.
  
  
Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
  
  
Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
  
  
Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.
  
  
All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.
  
  
**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

description:
